===== FILE 6: generate_module.py =====

import os
import sys

# ───────────────────────────────
# 🧠 Helper: PascalCase conversion
# ───────────────────────────────
def to_pascal_case(s):
    return ''.join(word.capitalize() for word in s.split('-'))

# ───────────────────────────────
# 🚀 Main Generator
# ───────────────────────────────
def generate_module(module_path):
    # Determine module name and target directory
    module_path = os.path.abspath(module_path)
    module_name = os.path.basename(module_path)
    pascal_name = to_pascal_case(module_name)

    base_dir = module_path
    dtos_dir = os.path.join(base_dir, "dtos")

    os.makedirs(dtos_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # ─────────────── File Templates ───────────────
    files = {
        f"{base_dir}/{module_name}.controller.ts": f"""import {{ Controller }} from '@nestjs/common';

@Controller('{module_name}')
export class {pascal_name}Controller {{}}""",

        f"{base_dir}/{module_name}.service.ts": f"""import {{ Injectable }} from '@nestjs/common';

@Injectable()
export class {pascal_name}Service {{}}""",

        f"{base_dir}/{module_name}.module.ts": f"""import {{ Module }} from '@nestjs/common';
import {{ {pascal_name}Controller }} from './{module_name}.controller';
import {{ {pascal_name}Service }} from './{module_name}.service';

@Module({{
  controllers: [{pascal_name}Controller],
  providers: [{pascal_name}Service],
}})
export class {pascal_name}Module {{}}""",

        f"{base_dir}/{module_name}.entity.ts": f"""import {{ Entity, PrimaryGeneratedColumn, Column }} from 'typeorm';

@Entity('{module_name}')
export class {pascal_name} {{
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id: number;

  @Column()
  name: string;
}}""",

        f"{base_dir}/{module_name}.mapper.ts": f"""export class {pascal_name}Mapper {{}}"""
    }

    # ─────────────── DTO Templates ───────────────
    dtos = {
        f"{dtos_dir}/{module_name}.dto.ts": f"""export class {pascal_name}Dto {{}}""",

        f"{dtos_dir}/create-{module_name}.dto.ts": f"""export class Create{pascal_name}Dto {{}}""",

        f"{dtos_dir}/update-{module_name}.dto.ts": f"""export class Update{pascal_name}Dto {{}}""",

        f"{dtos_dir}/query-{module_name}.dto.ts": f"""export class Query{pascal_name}Dto {{}}"""
    }

    # ─────────────── Write Files ───────────────
    all_files = {**files, **dtos}
    for filepath, content in all_files.items():
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(filepath), exist_ok=True)
        with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(content)

    print(f"✅ Module '{module_name}' generated successfully at:\n   {base_dir}")

# ───────────────────────────────
# 🏁 Entry Point
# ───────────────────────────────
if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("❌ Please provide a module name or path.\n"
              "   Example:\n"
              "     python3 generate_module.py water-resource\n"
              "     python3 generate_module.py src/modules/water-resource")
        sys.exit(1)

    module_path = sys.argv[1]
    generate_module(module_path)

===== FILE 11: project.py =====

import os

# مجلد المشروع الأساسي
PROJECT_ROOT = "D:\\anter\\red-sea\\redSea-backend-nestjs"  # غيّر ده لمسار مشروعك
OUTPUT_FILE = "full_project_dump_with_index.txt"

# المجلدات المهمة أولًا
PRIORITY_FOLDERS = ["entities", "ledger", "expenses", "journey"]

# الملفات أو المجلدات اللي عايزين نتجاهل
IGNORE = [".env", "node_modules", "__pycache__", ".git", "dist", "venv"]

def should_ignore(path):
    for ignore_item in IGNORE:
        if ignore_item in path:
            return True
    return False

# جمع الملفات مع ترتيب المجلدات المهمة أولًا
all_files = []

# أولًا، المجلدات ذات الأولوية
for folder in PRIORITY_FOLDERS:
    folder_path = os.path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, folder)
    if os.path.exists(folder_path):
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(folder_path):
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not should_ignore(d)]
            for file in files:
                if not should_ignore(file):
                    all_files.append(os.path.join(root, file))

# بعد كده باقي الملفات في المشروع
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(PROJECT_ROOT):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not should_ignore(d) and d not in PRIORITY_FOLDERS]
    for file in files:
        full_path = os.path.join(root, file)
        if not should_ignore(file) and full_path not in all_files:
            all_files.append(full_path)

# كتابة الفهرس + كل الملفات في ملف نصي واحد
with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out_file:
    # كتابة الفهرس
    out_file.write("===== PROJECT FILE INDEX =====\n")
    for idx, file_path in enumerate(all_files, start=1):
        out_file.write(f"{idx}. {os.path.relpath(file_path, PROJECT_ROOT)}\n")
    out_file.write("\n\n===== START OF FILES =====\n\n")

    # كتابة كل الملفات مع الفاصل والـ index
    for idx, file_path in enumerate(all_files, start=1):
        out_file.write(f"\n\n===== FILE {idx}: {os.path.relpath(file_path, PROJECT_ROOT)} =====\n\n")
        try:
            with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                out_file.write(f.read())
        except Exception as e:
            out_file.write(f"[ERROR READING FILE: {e}]\n")

print(f"✅ Done! Full project with index dumped into '{OUTPUT_FILE}'")

## Description

[Nest](https://github.com/nestjs/nest) framework TypeScript starter repository.

## Project setup

```bash
$ pnpm install
```

## Compile and run the project

```bash
# development
$ pnpm run start

# watch mode
$ pnpm run start:dev

# production mode
$ pnpm run start:prod
```

## Run tests

```bash
# unit tests
$ pnpm run test

# e2e tests
$ pnpm run test:e2e

# test coverage
$ pnpm run test:cov
```

## Deployment

When you're ready to deploy your NestJS application to production, there are some key steps you can take to ensure it runs as efficiently as possible. Check out the [deployment documentation](https://docs.nestjs.com/deployment) for more information.

If you are looking for a cloud-based platform to deploy your NestJS application, check out [Mau](https://mau.nestjs.com), our official platform for deploying NestJS applications on AWS. Mau makes deployment straightforward and fast, requiring just a few simple steps:

```bash
$ pnpm install -g @nestjs/mau
$ mau deploy
```

With Mau, you can deploy your application in just a few clicks, allowing you to focus on building features rather than managing infrastructure.

## Resources

Check out a few resources that may come in handy when working with NestJS:

- Visit the [NestJS Documentation](https://docs.nestjs.com) to learn more about the framework.
- For questions and support, please visit our [Discord channel](https://discord.gg/G7Qnnhy).
- To dive deeper and get more hands-on experience, check out our official video [courses](https://courses.nestjs.com/).
- Deploy your application to AWS with the help of [NestJS Mau](https://mau.nestjs.com) in just a few clicks.
- Visualize your application graph and interact with the NestJS application in real-time using [NestJS Devtools](https://devtools.nestjs.com).
- Need help with your project (part-time to full-time)? Check out our official [enterprise support](https://enterprise.nestjs.com).
- To stay in the loop and get updates, follow us on [X](https://x.com/nestframework) and [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/nestjs).
- Looking for a job, or have a job to offer? Check out our official [Jobs board](https://jobs.nestjs.com).

import os
import sys
from textwrap import dedent

def generate_module(name: str, output_dir="output"):
    name = name.lower()
    class_name = name.capitalize()
    dto_name = f"{class_name}DTO"
    create_dto = f"Create{class_name}DTO"
    update_dto = f"Update{class_name}DTO"
    service_name = f"{class_name}Service"
    controller_name = f"{class_name}Controller"
    module_name = f"{class_name}Module"
    mapper_func = f"map{class_name}To{class_name}DtoSelective"

    module_dir = os.path.join(output_dir, name)
    dtos_dir = os.path.join(module_dir, "dtos")
    os.makedirs(dtos_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # 1️⃣ Entity
    entity = dedent(f"""
    import {{ Entity, Column, ManyToOne }} from 'typeorm';
    import {{ BaseEntity }} from 'src/core/utils/base.entity';

    @Entity('{name}')

    }}
    """).strip()

    export class {dto_name} extends BaseDTO {{
     
    }}
    """).strip()

    import {{ ApiProperty, OmitType }} from '@nestjs/swagger';

    ] as const) {{
      
    }}

    update_dto_code = dedent(f"""

    import {{ {dto_name} }} from './{name}.dto';

    export class {update_dto} extends PartialType({dto_name}) {{}}
    """).strip()

    # 3️⃣ Mapper
    mapper = dedent(f"""
    import {{ {class_name} }} from './{name}.entity';
    import {{ {dto_name} }} from './dtos/{name}.dto';
    import {{ BaseDTO }} from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
    import {{ {update_dto} }} from './dtos/update-{name}.dto';

    const allowed{class_name}DtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof {dto_name} | keyof BaseDTO> = [
    
    ];

    export function {mapper_func}(
      entity: {class_name},
      keys?: (keyof {dto_name} | keyof BaseDTO)[]
    ): {update_dto};
    export function {mapper_func}(
      entities: {class_name}[],
      keys?: (keyof {dto_name} | keyof BaseDTO)[]
    ): {update_dto}[];
    export function {mapper_func}(
      input: {class_name} | {class_name}[],
      keys?: (keyof {dto_name} | keyof BaseDTO)[]
    ): {update_dto} | {update_dto}[] {{
      const mapSingle = (entity: {class_name}): {update_dto} => {{
        const resultDto: {update_dto} = {{}};
        const keysToMap = (keys || allowed{class_name}DtoKeys).filter((key) =>
          (allowed{class_name}DtoKeys as Array<keyof {dto_name} | keyof BaseDTO>).includes(key)
        );

        keysToMap.forEach((key) => {{
          if (key in entity && entity[key as keyof {class_name}] !== undefined) {{
            (resultDto as any)[key] = entity[key as keyof {class_name}];
          }}
        }});
        return resultDto;
      }};

      return Array.isArray(input) ? input.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(input);
    }}
    """).strip()

    # 4️⃣ Controller
    controller = dedent(f"""
    import {{
      Controller,
      Logger,
      UseGuards,
      Post,
      Put,
      Delete,
      Body,
      Param,
      NotFoundException,
      BadRequestException,
    }} from '@nestjs/common';
    import {{
      ApiBearerAuth,
      ApiOperation,
      ApiResponse,
      ApiTags,
    }} from '@nestjs/swagger';
    import {{ AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser }} from 'src/core/security';
    import {{ {dto_name} }} from './dtos/{name}.dto';
    import {{ UserRole }} from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
    import {{ {update_dto} }} from './dtos/update-{name}.dto';
    import {{ {create_dto} }} from './dtos/create-{name}.dto';
    import {{ {service_name} }} from './{name}.service';

    @Controller('api/{name}s')
    @ApiBearerAuth()
    @UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
    @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
    @ApiTags('{name}s-module')
    export class {controller_name} {{
      logger = new Logger('{class_name}sController');

      constructor(private readonly {name}Service: {service_name}) {{}}

      @Post('/')
      @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
      @ApiOperation({{ summary: 'Create a new {name}' }})
      @ApiResponse({{ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: {dto_name} }})
      async create(@Body() dto: {create_dto}, @AuthUser() user: any): Promise<{dto_name}> {{
        const existing = await this.{name}Service.findByFields({{ where: {{ url: dto.url }} }});
        if (existing) throw new BadRequestException(`{class_name} with URL ${{dto.url}} already exists`);
        return this.{name}Service.save(dto, user?.email);
      }}

      @Put('/:id')
      @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
      @ApiOperation({{ summary: 'Update existing {name}' }})
      @ApiResponse({{ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: {dto_name} }})
      async update(@Param('id') id: number, @Body() dto: {update_dto}, @AuthUser() user: any): Promise<{update_dto}> {{
        const existing = await this.{name}Service.findById(id);
        if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`{class_name} with id ${{id}} not found`);
        dto.id = id;
        return this.{name}Service.update(dto, user?.email);
      }}

      @Delete('/:id')
      @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
      @ApiOperation({{ summary: 'Delete {name}' }})
      async delete(@Param('id') id: number): Promise<void> {{
        const existing = await this.{name}Service.findById(id);
        if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`{class_name} with id ${{id}} not found`);
        await this.{name}Service.delete(id);
      }}
    }}
    """).strip()

    # 5️⃣ Service
    service = dedent(f"""

    @Injectable()
    export class {service_name} {{
      constructor(@InjectRepository({class_name}) private repo: Repository<{class_name}>) {{}}

      findByFields(options: any) {{
        return this.repo.findOne(options);
      }}

      findById(id: number) {{
        return this.repo.findOne({{ where: {{ id }} }});
      }}

      async save(data: any, userEmail: string) {{
        return this.repo.save(data);
      }}

      async update(data: any, userEmail: string) {{
        return this.repo.save(data);
      }}

      async delete(id: number) {{
        await this.repo.delete(id);
      }}
    }}
    """).strip()

    # 6️⃣ Module
    module = dedent(f"""
    import {{ Module }} from '@nestjs/common';
    import {{ TypeOrmModule }} from '@nestjs/typeorm';
    import {{ {controller_name} }} from './{name}.controller';
    import {{ {service_name} }} from './{name}.service';
    import {{ {class_name} }} from './{name}.entity';
    import {{ UserModule }} from '../user/user.module';

    @Module({{
      imports: [TypeOrmModule.forFeature([{class_name}]), UserModule],
      controllers: [{controller_name}],
      providers: [{service_name}],
    }})

    """).strip()

    # Write all files
    files = {
        f"{module_dir}/{name}.entity.ts": entity,
        f"{module_dir}/{name}.controller.ts": controller,
        f"{module_dir}/{name}.service.ts": service,
        f"{module_dir}/{name}.mapper.ts": mapper,
        f"{module_dir}/{name}.module.ts": module,

    for path, content in files.items():
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(content)

    print(f"✅ Generated NestJS module '{name}' at: {module_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: python nestjs_module_generator.py <module_name>")
        sys.exit(1)
    generate_module(sys.argv[1])

===== FILE 18: scripts\generate-entity-mermaid.cjs =====

// Generates a Mermaid classDiagram for TypeORM-like entities under src/app/modules
// Usage: node scripts/generate-entity-mermaid.cjs

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

let ts;
try {
  ts = require('typescript');
} catch (e) {
  console.error('Missing dependency: typescript. Install deps first (pnpm install).');
  process.exit(1);
}

const WORKSPACE_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const MODULES_ROOT = path.join(WORKSPACE_ROOT, 'src', 'app', 'modules');

const AUDIT_FIELD_NAMES = new Set([
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
  'deletedAt',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'deletedBy',
  'created_at',
  'updated_at',
  'deleted_at',
  'created_by',
  'updated_by',
  'deleted_by',
]);

const ENTITY_DECORATORS = new Set(['Entity', 'ChildEntity', 'ViewEntity']);

function walkDir(dir) {
  const out = [];
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  for (const ent of entries) {
    const p = path.join(dir, ent.name);
    if (ent.isDirectory()) out.push(...walkDir(p));
    else out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}

function getDecoratorName(decorator) {
  const expr = decorator.expression;
  if (ts.isCallExpression(expr)) {
    const callee = expr.expression;
    if (ts.isIdentifier(callee)) return callee.text;
    if (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(callee)) return callee.name.text;
  }
  if (ts.isIdentifier(expr)) return expr.text;
  return undefined;
}

function getDecoratorCall(decorator) {
  const expr = decorator.expression;
  return ts.isCallExpression(expr) ? expr : undefined;
}

function isEntityClass(node) {
  if (!ts.isClassDeclaration(node) || !node.name) return false;
  const decorators = ts.canHaveDecorators(node) ? ts.getDecorators(node) : undefined;
  if (!decorators) return false;
  return decorators.some((d) => ENTITY_DECORATORS.has(getDecoratorName(d) || ''));
}

function isPlainClass(node) {
  return ts.isClassDeclaration(node) && !!node.name;
}

function getHeritageExtendsName(cls) {
  if (!cls.heritageClauses) return undefined;
  for (const h of cls.heritageClauses) {
    if (h.token !== ts.SyntaxKind.ExtendsKeyword) continue;
    const t = h.types?.[0];
    if (!t) continue;
    const expr = t.expression;
    if (ts.isIdentifier(expr)) return expr.text;
    if (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(expr)) return expr.name.text;
  }
  return undefined;
}

function unwrapTypeText(typeNode) {
  if (!typeNode) return 'any';
  if (ts.isArrayTypeNode(typeNode)) return `${unwrapTypeText(typeNode.elementType)}[]`;
  if (ts.isTypeReferenceNode(typeNode)) {
    const tn = typeNode.typeName;
    if (ts.isIdentifier(tn)) return tn.text;
    if (ts.isQualifiedName(tn)) return tn.right.text;
  }
  switch (typeNode.kind) {
    case ts.SyntaxKind.StringKeyword:
      return 'string';
    case ts.SyntaxKind.NumberKeyword:
      return 'number';
    case ts.SyntaxKind.BooleanKeyword:
      return 'boolean';
    case ts.SyntaxKind.DateKeyword:
      return 'Date';
    case ts.SyntaxKind.AnyKeyword:
      return 'any';
    case ts.SyntaxKind.UnknownKeyword:
      return 'unknown';
    case ts.SyntaxKind.BigIntKeyword:
      return 'bigint';
    case ts.SyntaxKind.ObjectKeyword:
      return 'object';
    case ts.SyntaxKind.VoidKeyword:
      return 'void';
    case ts.SyntaxKind.NullKeyword:
      return 'null';
    case ts.SyntaxKind.UndefinedKeyword:
      return 'undefined';
    default:
      break;
  }

  try {
    return typeNode.getText();
  } catch {
    return 'any';
  }
}

function getRelationTargetFromArg(arg) {
  // Expected: () => TargetEntity OR () => TargetEntity[]
  if (!arg) return undefined;
  if (ts.isArrowFunction(arg) || ts.isFunctionExpression(arg)) {
    const body = arg.body;
    if (ts.isIdentifier(body)) return body.text;
    if (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(body)) return body.name.text;
    if (ts.isParenthesizedExpression(body)) {
      const e = body.expression;
      if (ts.isIdentifier(e)) return e.text;
      if (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(e)) return e.name.text;
    }
    if (ts.isBlock(body)) {
      for (const st of body.statements) {
        if (ts.isReturnStatement(st) && st.expression) {
          const e = st.expression;
          if (ts.isIdentifier(e)) return e.text;
          if (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(e)) return e.name.text;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

function parseObjectLiteralToMap(node) {
  const map = new Map();
  if (!node || !ts.isObjectLiteralExpression(node)) return map;
  for (const prop of node.properties) {
    if (!ts.isPropertyAssignment(prop)) continue;
    const key = ts.isIdentifier(prop.name)
      ? prop.name.text
      : ts.isStringLiteral(prop.name)
        ? prop.name.text
        : undefined;
    if (!key) continue;
    map.set(key, prop.initializer);
  }
  return map;
}

function getStringLiteralValue(node) {
  if (!node) return undefined;
  if (ts.isStringLiteral(node) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(node)) return node.text;
  return undefined;
}

function inferColumnTypeFromDecoratorArgs(callExpr) {
  // @Column('int') OR @Column({ type: 'int' }) OR @Column({ enum: X })
  const args = callExpr?.arguments || [];
  if (args.length === 0) return undefined;
  const a0 = args[0];
  const s0 = getStringLiteralValue(a0);
  if (s0) return s0;
  const m0 = parseObjectLiteralToMap(a0);
  const typeNode = m0.get('type');
  const typeStr = getStringLiteralValue(typeNode);
  if (typeStr) return typeStr;
  if (m0.has('enum')) return 'enum';
  return undefined;
}

function findDecorator(member, name) {
  const decorators = ts.canHaveDecorators(member) ? ts.getDecorators(member) : undefined;
  if (!decorators) return undefined;
  return decorators.find((d) => getDecoratorName(d) === name);
}

function collectEntities(entityFiles) {
  const entityFileSet = new Set(entityFiles.map((p) => path.normalize(p).toLowerCase()));

  // Add core base entity to improve PK/audit inference when entities extend it.
  const baseEntityPath = path.join(WORKSPACE_ROOT, 'src', 'core', 'utils', 'base.entity.ts');
  const extraFiles = fs.existsSync(baseEntityPath) ? [baseEntityPath] : [];
  for (const f of extraFiles) {
    entityFileSet.add(path.normalize(f).toLowerCase());
  }

  const rootNames = [...new Set([...entityFiles, ...extraFiles])];

  const program = ts.createProgram({
    rootNames,
    options: {
      target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020,
      module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS,
      experimentalDecorators: true,
      emitDecoratorMetadata: false,
      skipLibCheck: true,
      strict: false,
    },
  });

  const entities = new Map(); // name -> { name, file, base, fields: [], relations: [] }
  const neededBaseNames = new Set();

  for (const sf of program.getSourceFiles()) {
    if (!entityFileSet.has(path.normalize(sf.fileName).toLowerCase())) continue;

    ts.forEachChild(sf, (node) => {
      if (!isEntityClass(node)) return;
      const name = node.name.text;
      const base = getHeritageExtendsName(node);
      if (base) neededBaseNames.add(base);

      const fields = [];
      const relations = [];

      for (const member of node.members) {
        if (!ts.isPropertyDeclaration(member) || !member.name) continue;
        const propName = ts.isIdentifier(member.name)
          ? member.name.text
          : ts.isStringLiteral(member.name)
            ? member.name.text
            : undefined;
        if (!propName) continue;
        if (AUDIT_FIELD_NAMES.has(propName)) continue;

        const decorators = ts.canHaveDecorators(member) ? ts.getDecorators(member) : undefined;
        const decNames = new Set(
          (decorators || []).map((d) => getDecoratorName(d)).filter(Boolean),
        );

        const isPrimary =
          decNames.has('PrimaryGeneratedColumn') ||
          decNames.has('PrimaryColumn') ||
          decNames.has('PrimaryGeneratedColumnUUID') ||
          decNames.has('PrimaryGeneratedColumn') ||
          decNames.has('ObjectIdColumn');

        const isColumn =
          isPrimary ||
          decNames.has('Column') ||
          decNames.has('CreateDateColumn') ||
          decNames.has('UpdateDateColumn') ||
          decNames.has('DeleteDateColumn');

        const relDecoratorName = ['OneToOne', 'OneToMany', 'ManyToOne', 'ManyToMany'].find((n) =>
          decNames.has(n),
        );

        if (relDecoratorName) {
          const relDec = findDecorator(member, relDecoratorName);
          const relCall = relDec ? getDecoratorCall(relDec) : undefined;
          const target = relCall ? getRelationTargetFromArg(relCall.arguments[0]) : undefined;

          const joinTableDec = findDecorator(member, 'JoinTable');
          const joinColDec = findDecorator(member, 'JoinColumn');

          let joinTableName;
          if (joinTableDec) {
            const call = getDecoratorCall(joinTableDec);
            const opts = call?.arguments?.[0];
            const m = parseObjectLiteralToMap(opts);
            joinTableName = getStringLiteralValue(m.get('name'));
          }

          let joinColumnName;
          if (joinColDec) {
            const call = getDecoratorCall(joinColDec);
            const opts = call?.arguments?.[0];
            const m = parseObjectLiteralToMap(opts);
            joinColumnName = getStringLiteralValue(m.get('name'));
          }

          const typeText = unwrapTypeText(member.type);
          const isArray = typeText.endsWith('[]');

          relations.push({
            prop: propName,
            kind: relDecoratorName,
            target,
            isArray,
            joinTableName,
            joinColumnName,
            file: sf.fileName,
          });
          continue;
        }

        if (isColumn) {
          // ignore audit column decorators unless field name is not a standard audit field (already filtered above)
          if (
            decNames.has('CreateDateColumn') ||
            decNames.has('UpdateDateColumn') ||
            decNames.has('DeleteDateColumn')
          ) {
            // Non-standard name; keep it.
          }

          let colType;
          const primaryGen = findDecorator(member, 'PrimaryGeneratedColumn');
          const primaryCol = findDecorator(member, 'PrimaryColumn');
          const colDec = findDecorator(member, 'Column');

          const primaryCall = primaryGen
            ? getDecoratorCall(primaryGen)
            : primaryCol
              ? getDecoratorCall(primaryCol)
              : undefined;
          const colCall = colDec ? getDecoratorCall(colDec) : undefined;

          colType =
            inferColumnTypeFromDecoratorArgs(primaryCall) ||
            inferColumnTypeFromDecoratorArgs(colCall);

          const tsType = unwrapTypeText(member.type);
          const type = colType || tsType || 'any';

          fields.push({
            name: propName,
            type,
            isPrimary,
          });
        }
      }

      entities.set(name, {
        name,
        file: sf.fileName,
        base,
        fields,
        relations,
      });
    });
  }

  // Second pass: include abstract/base classes referenced via extends, even if not decorated with @Entity.
  if (neededBaseNames.size > 0) {
    for (const sf of program.getSourceFiles()) {
      if (!entityFileSet.has(path.normalize(sf.fileName).toLowerCase())) continue;

      ts.forEachChild(sf, (node) => {
        if (!isPlainClass(node) || !node.name) return;
        const name = node.name.text;
        if (!neededBaseNames.has(name)) return;
        if (entities.has(name)) return;

        const base = getHeritageExtendsName(node);
        if (base) neededBaseNames.add(base);

        const fields = [];
        const relations = [];

        for (const member of node.members) {
          if (!ts.isPropertyDeclaration(member) || !member.name) continue;
          const propName = ts.isIdentifier(member.name)
            ? member.name.text
            : ts.isStringLiteral(member.name)
              ? member.name.text
              : undefined;
          if (!propName) continue;
          if (AUDIT_FIELD_NAMES.has(propName)) continue;

          const decorators = ts.canHaveDecorators(member) ? ts.getDecorators(member) : undefined;
          const decNames = new Set(
            (decorators || []).map((d) => getDecoratorName(d)).filter(Boolean),
          );

          const isPrimary =
            decNames.has('PrimaryGeneratedColumn') ||
            decNames.has('PrimaryColumn') ||
            decNames.has('PrimaryGeneratedColumnUUID') ||
            decNames.has('PrimaryGeneratedColumn') ||
            decNames.has('ObjectIdColumn');

          const isColumn =
            isPrimary ||
            decNames.has('Column') ||
            decNames.has('CreateDateColumn') ||
            decNames.has('UpdateDateColumn') ||
            decNames.has('DeleteDateColumn');

          if (!isColumn) continue;

          let colType;
          const primaryGen = findDecorator(member, 'PrimaryGeneratedColumn');
          const primaryCol = findDecorator(member, 'PrimaryColumn');
          const colDec = findDecorator(member, 'Column');

          const primaryCall = primaryGen
            ? getDecoratorCall(primaryGen)
            : primaryCol
              ? getDecoratorCall(primaryCol)
              : undefined;
          const colCall = colDec ? getDecoratorCall(colDec) : undefined;

          colType =
            inferColumnTypeFromDecoratorArgs(primaryCall) ||
            inferColumnTypeFromDecoratorArgs(colCall);

          const tsType = unwrapTypeText(member.type);
          const type = colType || tsType || 'any';

          fields.push({
            name: propName,
            type,
            isPrimary,
          });
        }

        entities.set(name, {
          name,
          file: sf.fileName,
          base,
          fields,
          relations,
        });
      });
    }
  }

  return entities;
}

function normalizeEntityName(name) {
  if (!name) return undefined;
  // Prefer stripping trailing Entity if used.
  if (name === 'BaseEntity') return 'BaseEntity';
  return name.endsWith('Entity') ? name.slice(0, -6) : name;
}

function buildMermaid(entities) {
  // Map original class name -> display name
  const nameMap = new Map();
  for (const [k, v] of entities) {
    nameMap.set(k, normalizeEntityName(v.name));
  }

  const classes = [];
  const inherits = [];
  const edges = new Map(); // key -> line

  // Precompute owning-side pairs to avoid drawing inverse duplicates.
  const manyToOnePairs = new Set(); // `${from}::${to}` in display names
  const manyToManyOwningPairs = new Set();
  for (const ent of entities.values()) {
    const from = nameMap.get(ent.name) || ent.name;
    for (const rel of ent.relations) {
      if (!rel.target) continue;
      const to = nameMap.get(rel.target) || normalizeEntityName(rel.target) || rel.target;
      if (!to) continue;
      if (rel.kind === 'ManyToOne') manyToOnePairs.add(`${from}::${to}`);
      if (rel.kind === 'ManyToMany' && rel.joinTableName) {
        manyToManyOwningPairs.add(`${from}::${to}`);
      }
    }
  }

  // Build class blocks
  for (const ent of entities.values()) {
    const display = nameMap.get(ent.name) || ent.name;

    const lines = [];
    // Sort: primary keys first
    const sortedFields = [...ent.fields].sort(
      (a, b) => (b.isPrimary ? 1 : 0) - (a.isPrimary ? 1 : 0),
    );
    for (const f of sortedFields) {
      if (AUDIT_FIELD_NAMES.has(f.name)) continue;
      const prefix = f.isPrimary ? '+(PK) ' : '+';
      lines.push(`  ${prefix}${f.name}: ${f.type}`);
    }

    classes.push(`class ${display} {\n${lines.join('\n')}\n}`);

    if (ent.base) {
      const baseDisplay = normalizeEntityName(ent.base);
      inherits.push(`${baseDisplay} <|-- ${display}`);
    }
  }

  function addEdge(from, fromCard, to, toCard, label) {
    const key = `${from}|${fromCard}|${to}|${toCard}|${label || ''}`;
    if (edges.has(key)) return;
    const relLabel = label ? ` : ${label}` : '';
    edges.set(key, `${from} "${fromCard}" --> "${toCard}" ${to}${relLabel}`);
  }

  // Build edges
  // Strategy: prefer owning sides
  for (const ent of entities.values()) {
    const from = nameMap.get(ent.name) || ent.name;

    for (const rel of ent.relations) {
      const targetRaw = rel.target;
      if (!targetRaw) continue;
      const toName = nameMap.get(targetRaw) || normalizeEntityName(targetRaw) || targetRaw;

      if (!toName) continue;

      if (rel.kind === 'ManyToOne') {
        const lbl = rel.joinColumnName ? `${rel.prop} (fk: ${rel.joinColumnName})` : rel.prop;
        addEdge(from, '*', toName, '1', lbl);
      } else if (rel.kind === 'OneToOne') {
        // owning side if JoinColumn exists, otherwise still include
        const lbl = rel.joinColumnName ? `${rel.prop} (fk: ${rel.joinColumnName})` : rel.prop;
        addEdge(from, '1', toName, '1', lbl);
      } else if (rel.kind === 'ManyToMany') {
        // Prefer owning side that has @JoinTable (join table is defined there)
        if (manyToManyOwningPairs.size > 0 && !rel.joinTableName) continue;
        const lbl = rel.joinTableName ? `${rel.prop} (join: ${rel.joinTableName})` : rel.prop;
        addEdge(from, '*', toName, '*', lbl);
      } else if (rel.kind === 'OneToMany') {
        // Inverse side; omit if corresponding ManyToOne exists (child -> parent)
        if (manyToOnePairs.has(`${toName}::${from}`)) continue;
        addEdge(from, '1', toName, '*', rel.prop);
      }
    }
  }

  // Ensure base classes exist if referenced by inheritance
  const allClassNames = new Set(classes.map((c) => c.match(/^class\s+(\w+)/)?.[1]).filter(Boolean));
  for (const inh of inherits) {
    const m = inh.match(/^(\w+)\s+<\|--\s+(\w+)$/);
    if (!m) continue;
    const base = m[1];
    if (!allClassNames.has(base)) {
      classes.unshift(`class ${base} {\n}`);
      allClassNames.add(base);
    }
  }

  const out = [];
  out.push('classDiagram');
  // Put classes first
  out.push(...classes);
  // Inheritance
  out.push(...inherits);
  // Relations
  out.push(...Array.from(edges.values()));

  return out.join('\n');
}

function main() {
  if (!fs.existsSync(MODULES_ROOT)) {
    console.error('Modules root not found:', MODULES_ROOT);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const outArgIndex = process.argv.indexOf('--out');
  const outPath =
    outArgIndex >= 0 && process.argv[outArgIndex + 1]
      ? path.resolve(WORKSPACE_ROOT, process.argv[outArgIndex + 1])
      : path.join(WORKSPACE_ROOT, 'entity-diagram.txt');

  const allFiles = walkDir(MODULES_ROOT);
  const entityFiles = allFiles.filter((f) => f.endsWith('.entity.ts'));

  const entities = collectEntities(entityFiles);
  const mermaid = buildMermaid(entities);

  // Write to txt for easy copy/paste, and also print to stdout.
  fs.writeFileSync(outPath, mermaid, 'utf8');
  process.stdout.write(mermaid);
}

main();

===== FILE 20: src\seed.ts =====

import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { SeederModule } from './database/seeders/seeder.module';
import { Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Seeder } from './database/seeders/seeder';

function bootstrap() {
  NestFactory.createApplicationContext(SeederModule)
    .then(async (appContext) => {
      const logger = appContext.get(Logger);
      const seeder = appContext.get<{ seed: () => Promise<void> }>(Seeder);
      try {
        await seeder.seed();
        logger.debug('Seeding complete!');
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Seeding failed!');
        throw error;
      } finally {
        await appContext.close();
      }
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      throw error;
    });
}
bootstrap();

import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  Logger,
  NotFoundException,
  Param,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Post,
  Put,
  Query,
  Req,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, AuthUser, Roles, RolesGuard } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import { FindOptionsWhere } from 'typeorm';

import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';
import { AccountService } from './account.service';
import { AccountDTO } from './dtos/account.dto';
import { CreateAccountDTO } from './dtos/create-account.dto';
import { UpdateAccountDTO } from './dtos/update-account.dto';
import { AccountQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-account.dto';
import { Account } from './account.entity';
import {
  mapAccountToAccountDtoSelective,
  mapCreateAccountDtoToEntity,
  mapUpdateAccountDtoToEntity,
} from './account.mapper';

@Controller('api/accounts')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('accounts-module')
export class AccountController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('AccountController');

  constructor(private readonly accountService: AccountService) {}

  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of accounts paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'List of accounts', type: AccountDTO, isArray: true })
  async getAll(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: AccountQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<AccountDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const where: FindOptionsWhere<Account> = {};
    if (query.type) where.type = query.type;
    if (query.ownerType) where.ownerType = query.ownerType;
    if (query.status) where.status = query.status;

    const [results, count] = await this.accountService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      where,
    });

    const dtos = mapAccountToAccountDtoSelective(results);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get account by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Account found', type: AccountDTO })
  async getById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<AccountDTO> {
    const existing = await this.accountService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Account with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapAccountToAccountDtoSelective(existing) as AccountDTO;
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new account' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: AccountDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateAccountDTO, @AuthUser() user: UserDTO): Promise<AccountDTO> {
    const entity = mapCreateAccountDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.accountService.save(entity, user?.email);
    return mapAccountToAccountDtoSelective(saved) as AccountDTO;
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update account' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: AccountDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateAccountDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<AccountDTO> {
    const existing = await this.accountService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Account with id ${id} not found`);

    const entity = mapUpdateAccountDtoToEntity(dto, existing);
    const updated = await this.accountService.update(entity, user?.email);
    return mapAccountToAccountDtoSelective(updated) as AccountDTO;
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete account' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.accountService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Account with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.accountService.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 24: src\app\modules\account\account.mapper.ts =====

import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { Account } from './account.entity';
import { AccountDTO } from './dtos/account.dto';
import { CreateAccountDTO } from './dtos/create-account.dto';
import { UpdateAccountDTO } from './dtos/update-account.dto';

const allowedAccountDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof AccountDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'type',
  'ownerType',
  'ownerId',
  'status',
  'currency',
  'metadata',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
] as const;

export function mapAccountToAccountDtoSelective(
  account: Account,
  keys?: (keyof AccountDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<AccountDTO>;

export function mapAccountToAccountDtoSelective(
  accounts: Account[],
  keys?: (keyof AccountDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<AccountDTO>[];

export function mapAccountToAccountDtoSelective(
  data: Account | Account[],
  keys?: (keyof AccountDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<AccountDTO> | Partial<AccountDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (account: Account): Partial<AccountDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<AccountDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedAccountDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      (allowedAccountDtoKeys as readonly string[]).includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in account && account[key as keyof Account] !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = account[key as keyof Account];
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(data) ? data.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(data);
}

export const mapCreateAccountDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateAccountDTO): Account => {
  const entity = new Account();

  entity.type = dto.type;
  entity.ownerType = dto.ownerType;
  entity.ownerId = dto.ownerId;
  entity.status = dto.status;
  entity.currency = dto.currency;
  entity.metadata = dto.metadata;

  return entity;
};

export const mapUpdateAccountDtoToEntity = (dto: UpdateAccountDTO, existing: Account): Account => {
  const entity = new Account();

  entity.id = existing.id;
  entity.createdAt = existing.createdAt;

  entity.type = dto.type ?? existing.type;
  entity.ownerType = dto.ownerType ?? existing.ownerType;
  entity.ownerId = dto.ownerId ?? existing.ownerId;
  entity.status = dto.status ?? existing.status;
  entity.currency = dto.currency ?? existing.currency;
  entity.metadata = dto.metadata ?? existing.metadata;

  return entity;
};

===== FILE 26: src\app\modules\account\account.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Account } from './account.entity';

@Injectable()
export class AccountService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Account)
    private readonly accountRepository: Repository<Account>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<Account | undefined> {
    const result = await this.accountRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<Account>): Promise<Account | undefined> {
    const result = await this.accountRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<Account>): Promise<Account[] | undefined> {
    const result = await this.accountRepository.find(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<Account>): Promise<[Account[], number]> {
    return this.accountRepository.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(account: Account, creator?: string): Promise<Account> {
    const now = new Date();

    account.createdAt = account.createdAt ?? now;
    account.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      account.createdBy = account.createdBy ?? creator;
      account.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.accountRepository.save(account);
  }

  async update(account: Account, updater?: string): Promise<Account> {
    const now = new Date();

    account.updatedAt = now;
    if (updater) account.updatedBy = updater;

    return await this.accountRepository.save(account);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.accountRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('areas-module')
export class AreaController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('AreaController');

  constructor(
    private readonly areaService: AreaService,
    private readonly governmentService: GovernmentService,
  ) {}

  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of areas paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'List of areas', type: AreaDTO, isArray: true })
  async getAllAreas(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: AreaQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<AreaDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const whereConditions: FindOptionsWhere<Area> = {};
    if (query.governmentId) {
      whereConditions.government = { id: query.governmentId };
    }

    const [results, count] = await this.areaService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      relations: ['government'],
      where: whereConditions,
    });

    const dtos = mapAreaToAreaDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'government',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get area by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Area found', type: AreaDTO })
  async getAreaById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<AreaDTO> {
    const existing = await this.areaService.findByFields({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['government'],
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Area with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapAreaToAreaDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'government',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]) as AreaDTO;
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new area' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: AreaDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateAreaDTO, @AuthUser() user: UserDTO): Promise<AreaDTO> {
    const governmentId = (dto as any).governmentId as number | undefined;
    if (!governmentId) {
      throw new BadRequestException('governmentId is required');
    }

    const government = await this.governmentService.findById(governmentId);
    if (!government) throw new NotFoundException(`Government with id ${governmentId} not found`);

    const entity = mapCreateAreaDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.areaService.save(entity, user?.email);
    return mapAreaToAreaDtoSelective(saved) as AreaDTO;
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update area' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: AreaDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateAreaDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<AreaDTO> {
    const existing = await this.areaService.findByFields({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['government'],
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Area with id ${id} not found`);

    const entity = mapUpdateAreaDtoToEntity(dto, existing);
    const updated = await this.areaService.update(entity, user?.email);
    return mapAreaToAreaDtoSelective(updated) as AreaDTO;
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete area' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.areaService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Area with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.areaService.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 33: src\app\modules\area\area.mapper.ts =====

import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { Area } from './area.entity';
import { AreaDTO } from './dtos/area.dto';
import { CreateAreaDTO } from './dtos/create-area.dto';
import { UpdateAreaDTO } from './dtos/update-area.dto';
import { Government } from '../government/government.entity';

const allowedAreaDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof AreaDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'name',
  'government',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
] as const;

export function mapAreaToAreaDtoSelective(
  area: Area,
  keys?: (keyof AreaDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<AreaDTO>;

export function mapAreaToAreaDtoSelective(
  areas: Area[],
  keys?: (keyof AreaDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<AreaDTO>[];

export function mapAreaToAreaDtoSelective(
  data: Area | Area[],
  keys?: (keyof AreaDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<AreaDTO> | Partial<AreaDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (area: Area): Partial<AreaDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<AreaDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedAreaDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      (allowedAreaDtoKeys as readonly string[]).includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in area && area[key as keyof Area] !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = area[key as keyof Area];
      }
    });

    if (area.government) {
      (dto as any).government = {
        id: area.government.id,
        name: area.government.name,
      };
    }

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(data) ? data.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(data);
}

export const mapCreateAreaDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateAreaDTO): Area => {
  const entity = new Area();

  entity.name = dto.name;

  if (dto.governmentId !== undefined) entity.government = { id: dto.governmentId } as Government;

  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) entity.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return entity;
};

export const mapUpdateAreaDtoToEntity = (dto: UpdateAreaDTO, existing: Area): Area => {
  const entity = new Area();

  entity.id = existing.id;
  entity.createdAt = existing.createdAt;

  entity.name = dto.name ?? existing.name;

  return entity;
};

===== FILE 35: src\app\modules\area\area.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { Area } from './area.entity';

@Injectable()
export class AreaService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Area)
    private readonly areaRepository: Repository<Area>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<Area | undefined> {
    const result = await this.areaRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<Area>): Promise<Area | undefined> {
    const result = await this.areaRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<Area>): Promise<Area[] | undefined> {
    const result = await this.areaRepository.find(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<Area>): Promise<[Area[], number]> {
    return this.areaRepository.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(area: Area, creator?: string): Promise<Area> {
    const now = new Date();

    area.createdAt = area.createdAt ?? now;
    area.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      area.createdBy = area.createdBy ?? creator;
      area.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.areaRepository.save(area);
  }

  async update(area: Area, updater?: string): Promise<Area> {
    const now = new Date();

    area.updatedAt = now;
    if (updater) area.updatedBy = updater;

    return await this.areaRepository.save(area);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.areaRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

import { Body, Controller, Logger, Post, Res } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Response } from 'express';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { AuthLoginDTO } from './dto/auth-login.dto';
import { UserService } from '../user/user.service';

@Controller('api/auth')
export class AuthController {
  logger = new Logger('AuthController');

  constructor(
    private readonly authService: AuthService,
    private readonly userService: UserService,
  ) {}

  @Post('/login')
  async authorize(@Body() userDTO: AuthLoginDTO, @Res() res: Response): Promise<void> {
    const jwt = await this.authService.login(userDTO);
    const user = await this.userService.findByFields({
      where: {
        email: userDTO.email,
      },
    });
    res.json({
      user,
      token: jwt.access_token,
    });
  }
}

===== FILE 42: src\app\modules\auth\auth.service.ts =====

import { HttpException, HttpStatus, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import { Equal } from 'typeorm';
import { UserService } from 'src/app/modules/user/user.service';
import { AuthLoginDTO } from './dto/auth-login.dto';
import { JwtPayload } from 'src/core/security/interfaces/jwt-payload.interface';
import { UserDTO } from 'src/app/modules/user/dtos/user.dto';
import { GeneratedToken } from 'src/core/security/interfaces/token.interface';

@Injectable()
export class AuthService {
  constructor(
    private readonly userService: UserService,
    private readonly jwtService: JwtService,
  ) {}

  async login(userLogin: AuthLoginDTO): Promise<GeneratedToken> {
    const loginEmail = userLogin.email;
    const loginPassword = userLogin.password;

    const userFind = await this.userService.findByFields({
      where: { email: Equal(loginEmail) },
    });
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-call
    const validPassword = !!userFind && (await bcrypt.compare(loginPassword, userFind.password));
    if (!userFind || !validPassword) {
      throw new HttpException('Invalid login email or password!', HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
    }

    if (userFind && !userFind.activated) {
      throw new HttpException('Your account is not been activated!', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    return this.generateToken(userFind);
  }

  async validateUser(payload: JwtPayload) {
    return await this.userService.findByFields({
      where: { id: Equal(payload.id) },
    });
  }

  generateToken(user: UserDTO): GeneratedToken {
    const payload: JwtPayload = {
      id: user.id,
      username: user.username,
      role: user.role,
    };
    return {
      access_token: this.jwtService.sign(payload),
    };
  }
}

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Bulk create axle records' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Records created', type: [AxleDTO] })
  async bulkCreate(@Body() dtos: CreateAxleDTO[], @AuthUser() user: UserDTO): Promise<AxleDTO[]> {
    if (!Array.isArray(dtos) || dtos.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Request body must be a non-empty array');
    }

    const results: Axle[] = [];

    for (const dto of dtos) {
      // Validate either carId or trailerId
      if (!dto.carId && !dto.trailerId) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Each axle must include either carId or trailerId');
      }

      if (dto.carId && dto.trailerId) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Axle cannot be assigned to both car and trailer');
      }

      // Validate parent entity exists
      if (dto.carId) {
        const car = await this.carService.findByFields({
          where: { id: dto.carId },
        });
        if (!car) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`Car with id ${dto.carId} does not exist`);
        }
      }

      if (dto.trailerId) {
        const trailer = await this.trailerService.findByFields({
          where: { id: dto.trailerId },
        });
        if (!trailer) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`Trailer with id ${dto.trailerId} does not exist`);
        }
      }

      // Map DTO → entity
      const mappedAxle = mapCreateAxleDtoToEntity(dto) as Axle;
      results.push(mappedAxle);
    }

    // Save all records
    return this.axleService.saveBulk(results, user?.email);
  }

  @Put('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Bulk update axle records' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Records updated', type: [AxleDTO] })
  async bulkUpdate(@Body() dtos: UpdateAxleDTO[], @AuthUser() user: any): Promise<AxleDTO[]> {
    if (!Array.isArray(dtos) || dtos.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Request body must be a non-empty array');
    }

    const results: Axle[] = [];

    for (const dto of dtos) {
      if (!dto.id) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Each axle must include an id for update');
      }

      const existing = await this.axleService.findById(dto.id);
      if (!existing) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`Axle with id ${dto.id} not found`);
      }

      const mappedAxle = mapUpdateAxleDtoToEntity(dto);
      results.push(mappedAxle);
    }

    return this.axleService.updateBulk(results, user?.email);
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update existing axle record' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: AxleDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id') id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateAxleDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<UpdateAxleDTO> {
    const existing = await this.axleService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Axle with id ${id} not found`);

    dto.id = id;

    const mappedAxle = mapUpdateAxleDtoToEntity(dto);

    return this.axleService.update(mappedAxle, user?.email);
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete axle record' })
  async delete(@Param('id') id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.axleService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Axle with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.axleService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

import { Entity, Column, ManyToOne, OneToMany, JoinColumn } from 'typeorm';
import { BaseEntity } from 'src/core/utils/base.entity';
import { Car } from '../car/car.entity';
import { Trailer } from '../trailer/trailer.entity';
import { Tire } from '../tire/tire.entity';

@Entity('axles')
export class Axle extends BaseEntity {
  @Column({ type: 'int' })
  number: number;

  // Many-to-One with Car
  @ManyToOne(() => Car, (car) => car.axles, { nullable: true })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'carId' })
  car?: Car;

  // Many-to-One with Trailer
  @ManyToOne(() => Trailer, (trailer) => trailer.axles, { nullable: true })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'trailerId' })
  trailer?: Trailer;

  // One-to-Many with Tires
  @OneToMany(() => Tire, (tire) => tire.axle, { cascade: true })
  tires?: Tire[];
}


===== FILE 46: src\app\modules\axle\axle.mapper.ts =====

// src/axle/axle.mapper.ts
import { Axle } from './axle.entity';
import { AxleDTO } from './dtos/axle.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { CreateAxleDTO } from './dtos/create-axle.dto';
import { UpdateAxleDTO } from './dtos/update-axle.dto';
import { Car } from '../car/car.entity';
import { Trailer } from '../trailer/trailer.entity';
import { Tire } from '../tire/tire.entity';

const allowedAxleDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof AxleDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'number',
  'car',
  'trailer',
  'tires',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
  'deletedAt',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'deletedBy',
] as const;

/**
 * Entity → DTO (selective mapping)
 */
export function mapAxleToAxleDtoSelective(
  entity: Axle,
  keys?: (keyof AxleDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): UpdateAxleDTO;
export function mapAxleToAxleDtoSelective(
  entities: Axle[],
  keys?: (keyof AxleDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): UpdateAxleDTO[];
export function mapAxleToAxleDtoSelective(
  input: Axle | Axle[],
  keys?: (keyof AxleDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): UpdateAxleDTO | UpdateAxleDTO[] {
  const mapSingle = (entity: Axle): UpdateAxleDTO => {
    const dto = {} as UpdateAxleDTO;
    const useKeys = keys?.length
      ? keys.filter((k) => allowedAxleDtoKeys.includes(k))
      : allowedAxleDtoKeys;

    useKeys.forEach((key) => {
      if (entity[key as keyof Axle] !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = entity[key as keyof Axle];
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(input) ? input.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(input);
}

/**
 * CreateAxleDTO → Axle Entity (supports nested tire creation)
 */
export function mapCreateAxleDtoToEntity(dto: CreateAxleDTO | CreateAxleDTO[]): Axle | Axle[] {
  const mapSingle = (item: CreateAxleDTO): Axle => {
    const axle = new Axle();
    axle.number = item.number;

    // Link to parent (car or trailer) via ID
    if (item.carId !== undefined) {
      axle.car = Object.assign(new Car(), { id: item.carId });
    }
    if (item.trailerId !== undefined) {
      axle.trailer = Object.assign(new Trailer(), { id: item.trailerId });
    }

    // Nested tire creation — this is the new powerful part
    if (item.tires && item.tires.length > 0) {
      axle.tires = item.tires.map((tireDto) => {
        const tire = new Tire();
        tire.serialNumber = tireDto.serialNumber;
        tire.type = tireDto.type;
        tire.healthPercentage = tireDto.healthPercentage;
        tire.location = tireDto.location;
        tire.createdDate = tireDto.createdDate;
        // tire.axle will be auto-filled by TypeORM thanks to cascade: true
        return tire;
      });
    }

    return axle;
  };

  return Array.isArray(dto) ? dto.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(dto);
}

/**
 * UpdateAxleDTO → Axle Entity (for PATCH/PUT)
 * Note: Nested updates (tires) are not supported here unless you extend UpdateAxleDTO
 */
export function mapUpdateAxleDtoToEntity(dto: UpdateAxleDTO, existingAxle?: Axle): Axle;
export function mapUpdateAxleDtoToEntity(dto: UpdateAxleDTO[], existingAxles?: Axle[]): Axle[];
export function mapUpdateAxleDtoToEntity(
  dto: UpdateAxleDTO | UpdateAxleDTO[],
  existing?: Axle | Axle[],
): Axle | Axle[] {
  const mapOne = (item: UpdateAxleDTO, existingAxle?: Axle): Axle => {
    const axle = existingAxle ?? new Axle();

    if (item.id !== undefined) axle.id = item.id;
    if (item.number !== undefined) axle.number = item.number;

    // These are full objects — only use if sent (usually not in update)
    if (item.car !== undefined) axle.car = item.car as Car;
    if (item.trailer !== undefined) axle.trailer = item.trailer as Trailer;
    if (item.tires !== undefined) axle.tires = item.tires as Tire[];

    return axle;
  };

  if (Array.isArray(dto)) {
    return Array.isArray(existing)
      ? dto.map((item, i) => mapOne(item, existing[i]))
      : dto.map((item) => mapOne(item));
  }
  return mapOne(dto, existing as Axle);
}

===== FILE 48: src\app\modules\axle\axle.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Axle } from './axle.entity';
import { UpdateAxleDTO } from './dtos/update-axle.dto';
import { AxleDTO } from './dtos/axle.dto';

@Injectable()
export class AxleService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Axle)
    private axleRepository: Repository<Axle>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<AxleDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.axleRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<UpdateAxleDTO>): Promise<AxleDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.axleRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<UpdateAxleDTO>): Promise<Axle[] | undefined> {
    const result = await this.axleRepository.find(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<AxleDTO>): Promise<[Axle[], number]> {
    return await this.axleRepository.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(axle: Axle, creator?: string): Promise<Axle> {
    const now = new Date();

    axle.createdAt = axle.createdAt ?? now;
    axle.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      axle.createdBy = axle.createdBy ?? creator;
      axle.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.axleRepository.save(axle);
  }
  async saveBulk(axles: Axle[], creator?: string): Promise<Axle[]> {
    const now = new Date();

    const preparedAxles = axles.map((axle) => {
      axle.createdAt = axle.createdAt ?? now;
      axle.updatedAt = now;

      if (creator) {
        axle.createdBy = axle.createdBy ?? creator;
        axle.updatedBy = creator;
      }

      return axle;
    });

    return await this.axleRepository.save(preparedAxles);
  }

  async update(axle: Axle, updater?: string): Promise<Axle> {
    const now = new Date();
    if (updater) axle.updatedBy = updater;
    axle.updatedAt = now;

    return await this.axleRepository.save(axle);
  }

  async updateBulk(axles: Axle[], updater?: string): Promise<Axle[]> {
    const now = new Date();

    const preparedAxles = axles.map((axle) => {
      axle.updatedAt = now;
      if (updater) axle.updatedBy = updater;
      return axle;
    });

    return await this.axleRepository.save(preparedAxles);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.axleRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

// src/branch/branch.controller.ts
import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  Get,
  Req,
  Query,
  ParseIntPipe,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';

import { BranchService } from './branch.service';
import { BranchDTO } from './dtos/branch.dto';
import { CreateBranchDTO } from './dtos/create-branch.dto';
import { UpdateBranchDTO } from './dtos/update-branch.dto';

import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';

import {
  mapCreateBranchDtoToEntity,
  mapBranchToBranchDtoSelective,
  mapUpdateBranchDtoToEntity,
} from './branch.mapper';

import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';
import { BranchQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-branch.dto';

@Controller('api/branches')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('branches-module')
export class BranchController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('BranchController');

  constructor(private readonly branchService: BranchService) {}

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET ALL (paginated)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of branches paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List of branches',
    type: BranchDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAllBranches(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: BranchQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<BranchDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const [results, count] = await this.branchService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
    });

    const dtos = mapBranchToBranchDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET BY ID
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get branch by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Branch found', type: BranchDTO })
  async getBranchById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<BranchDTO> {
    const existing = await this.branchService.findByFields({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Branch with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapBranchToBranchDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]) as BranchDTO;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new branch' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Branch created', type: BranchDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateBranchDTO, @AuthUser() user: UserDTO): Promise<BranchDTO> {
    // Optional: prevent duplicate branch names (or make it unique in DB)
    const existing = await this.branchService.findByFields({
      where: { name: dto.name },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new BadRequestException(`Branch with name "${dto.name}" already exists`);
    }

    const entity = mapCreateBranchDtoToEntity(dto);
    return this.branchService.save(entity, user?.email);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update branch' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Branch updated', type: BranchDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateBranchDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<BranchDTO> {
    const existing = await this.branchService.findByFields({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Branch with id ${id} not found`);

    // Prevent changing to a name that already exists (except current record)
    if (dto.name) {
      const nameExists = await this.branchService.findByFields({
        where: { name: dto.name },
      });

      if (nameExists && nameExists.id !== id) {
        throw new BadRequestException(`Branch with name "${dto.name}" already exists`);
      }
    }

    dto.id = id;
    const entity = mapUpdateBranchDtoToEntity(dto);
    return this.branchService.update(entity, user?.email);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete branch' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 204, description: 'Branch deleted' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.branchService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Branch with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.branchService.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 54: src\app\modules\branch\branch.mapper.ts =====

import { Branch } from './branch.entity';
import { BranchDTO } from './dtos/branch.dto';
import { CreateBranchDTO } from './dtos/create-branch.dto';
import { UpdateBranchDTO } from './dtos/update-branch.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';

const allowedBranchDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof BranchDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'name',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
] as const;

/**
 * Selective mapper: maps Branch → BranchDTO (single or array)
 */
export function mapBranchToBranchDtoSelective(
  branch: Branch,
  keys?: (keyof BranchDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<BranchDTO>;

export function mapBranchToBranchDtoSelective(
  branches: Branch[],
  keys?: (keyof BranchDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<BranchDTO>[];

export function mapBranchToBranchDtoSelective(
  branchOrBranches: Branch | Branch[],
  keys?: (keyof BranchDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<BranchDTO> | Partial<BranchDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (branch: Branch): Partial<BranchDTO> => {
    const resultDto: Partial<BranchDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedBranchDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      (allowedBranchDtoKeys as readonly string[]).includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in branch && branch[key as keyof Branch] !== undefined) {
        (resultDto as any)[key] = branch[key as keyof Branch];
      }
    });

    return resultDto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(branchOrBranches)
    ? branchOrBranches.map(mapSingle)
    : mapSingle(branchOrBranches);
}

/**
 * Create DTO → Entity
 */
export const mapCreateBranchDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateBranchDTO): Branch => {
  const entity = new Branch();

  entity.name = dto.name;

  // If you later add createdAt from DTO (optional)
  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) {
    entity.createdAt = dto.createdAt;
  }

  return entity;
};

/**
 * Update DTO → Entity (partial update)
 */
export const mapUpdateBranchDtoToEntity = (dto: UpdateBranchDTO): Branch => {
  const entity = new Branch();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) entity.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.name !== undefined) entity.name = dto.name;
  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) entity.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return entity;
};

    branch.createdAt = branch.createdAt ?? now;
    branch.updatedAt = now;

  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new car' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Car created', type: CarDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateCarDTO, @AuthUser() user: any): Promise<CarDTO> {
    // UNIQUE: chassis number
    const existingChassis = await this.carService.findByFields({
      where: { chassisNumber: dto.chassisNumber },
    });
    if (existingChassis)
      throw new BadRequestException(`Car with chassis number ${dto.chassisNumber} already exists`);

    // UNIQUE: plateNumber + plateLetters
    const existingPlate = await this.carService.findByFields({
      where: { plateNumber: dto.plateNumber, plateLetters: dto.plateLetters },
    });
    if (existingPlate)
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Car with plate ${dto.plateLetters} ${dto.plateNumber} already exists`,
      );

    const mapped = mapCreateCarDtoToEntity(dto);
    return this.carService.save(mapped, user?.email);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update car' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Car updated', type: CarDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateCarDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<CarDTO> {
    const existing = await this.carService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Car with id ${id} not found`);

    dto.id = id;

    // UNIQUE CHECKS (only if changing values)
    if (dto.code && dto.code !== existing.code) {
      const codeCheck = await this.carService.findByFields({ where: { code: dto.code } });
      if (codeCheck) throw new BadRequestException(`Car with code ${dto.code} already exists`);
    }

    if (dto.chassisNumber && dto.chassisNumber !== existing.chassisNumber) {
      const chassisCheck = await this.carService.findByFields({
        where: { chassisNumber: dto.chassisNumber },
      });
      if (chassisCheck)
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Car with chassis number ${dto.chassisNumber} already exists`,
        );
    }

    if (
      (dto.plateNumber && dto.plateNumber !== existing.plateNumber) ||
      (dto.plateLetters && dto.plateLetters !== existing.plateLetters)
    ) {
      const plateCheck = await this.carService.findByFields({
        where: { plateNumber: dto.plateNumber, plateLetters: dto.plateLetters },
      });
      if (plateCheck)
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Car with plate ${dto.plateLetters} ${dto.plateNumber} already exists`,
        );
    }

    const mapped = mapUpdateCarDtoToEntity(dto);
    return this.carService.update(mapped, user?.email);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete car' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.carService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Car with id ${id} not found`);
    await this.carService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}
