import { Entity, Column, Index, OneToMany, JoinColumn } from 'typeorm';
import { BaseEntity } from 'src/core/utils/base.entity';
import { CarAttachment } from '../car-attachment/car-attachment.entity';
import { Axle } from '../axle/axle.entity';
import { OwnerShipType } from 'src/core/enums/ownerShip-types';
import { RelCarOwner } from '../rel-car-owner/rel-car-owner.entity';
import { VeachleStatus } from 'src/core/enums/veachle-status';

@Entity('cars')
export class Car extends BaseEntity {
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 50 })
  code: string;

  // Manufacturer brand (Mercedes, BMW, Toyota...)
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100 })
  manufacturer: string;

  // Active / Inactive status
  @Column({ type: 'enum', enum: VeachleStatus, default: VeachleStatus.AVILABLE })
  status: VeachleStatus;

  // Car model (X5, Actros, Track 123...)
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100 })
  model: string;

  // Manufacturing year
  @Column({ type: 'int' })
  manufactureYear: number;

  // Car color
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 30 })
  color: string;

  // Number of cylinders
  @Column({ type: 'int' })
  cylinders: number;

  // Engine horsepower
  @Column({ type: 'int' })
  horsepower: number;

  // Number of axles (2, 3, 4...)
  @Column({ type: 'int', name: 'axleCount' })
  axleCount: number;

  // Maximum weight in KG or tons (your choice)
  @Column({ type: 'int' })
  maxWeight: number;

  // Car license plate number
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 20 })
  plateNumber: string;

  // Car license plate letters (ABC, DEF...)
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 10 })
  plateLetters: string;

  // Chassis number / VIN
  @Index({ unique: true })
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 50 })
  chassisNumber: string;

  // Car license number
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 50 })
  licenseNumber: string;

  // License expiration date
  @Column({ type: 'date' })
  licenseExpiryDate: Date;

  // Additional notes
  @Column({ type: 'text', nullable: true })
  notes?: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 50, nullable: true })
  ownerShip: OwnerShipType;

  @OneToMany(() => CarAttachment, (carAttachment) => carAttachment, {
    cascade: true,
    onDelete: 'CASCADE',
    eager: true,
  })
  // Car attachments
  @OneToMany(() => CarAttachment, (carAttachment) => carAttachment.car, {
    cascade: true,
    eager: true,
  })
  carAttachments?: CarAttachment[];

  // Car Axles
  @OneToMany(() => Axle, (axle) => axle.car, { cascade: true, eager: true })
  @JoinColumn()
  axles?: Axle[];

  @OneToMany(() => RelCarOwner, (rel) => rel.car, {
    cascade: true,
    eager: true,
  })
  Ownerships?: RelCarOwner[];
}


===== FILE 63: src\app\modules\car\car.mapper.ts =====

import { Car } from './car.entity';
import { CarDTO } from './dtos/car.dto';
import { CreateCarDTO } from './dtos/create-car.dto';
import { UpdateCarDTO } from './dtos/update-car.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';

/**
 * Allowed DTO keys for selective mapping.
 * Ensures security and prevents exposing extra fields.
 */
const allowedCarDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof CarDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'code',
  'manufacturer',
  'status',
  'model',
  'manufactureYear',
  'color',
  'cylinders',
  'horsepower',
  'axleCount',
  'maxWeight',
  'plateNumber',
  'plateLetters',
  'chassisNumber',
  'licenseNumber',
  'licenseExpiryDate',
  'ownerShip',
  'axles',
  'Ownerships',
  'carAttachments',
  'notes',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
];

/**
 * Selective Car → CarDTO mapper
 */
export function mapCarToCarDtoSelective(
  car: Car,
  keys?: (keyof CarDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<CarDTO>;
export function mapCarToCarDtoSelective(
  cars: Car[],
  keys?: (keyof CarDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<CarDTO>[];
export function mapCarToCarDtoSelective(
  carOrCars: Car | Car[],
  keys?: (keyof CarDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<CarDTO> | Partial<CarDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (car: Car): Partial<CarDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<CarDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedCarDtoKeys).filter((key) => allowedCarDtoKeys.includes(key));

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in car && car[key as keyof Car] !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = car[key as keyof Car];
      }

      if (key === 'axles' && car.axles) {
        (dto as any).axles = car.axles;
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(carOrCars) ? carOrCars.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(carOrCars);
}
/**
 * CreateCarDTO → Car Entity
 */
export const mapCreateCarDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateCarDTO): Car => {
  const car = new Car();

  car.code = dto.code;
  car.manufacturer = dto.manufacturer;
  car.status = dto.status;
  car.model = dto.model;
  car.manufactureYear = dto.manufactureYear;
  car.color = dto.color;
  car.cylinders = dto.cylinders;
  car.horsepower = dto.horsepower;
  car.axleCount = dto.axleCount;
  car.maxWeight = dto.maxWeight;
  car.plateNumber = dto.plateNumber;
  car.plateLetters = dto.plateLetters;
  car.chassisNumber = dto.chassisNumber;
  car.licenseNumber = dto.licenseNumber;
  if (dto.ownerShip !== undefined) car.ownerShip = dto.ownerShip;
  car.licenseExpiryDate = new Date(dto.licenseExpiryDate);
  car.notes = dto.notes;

  return car;
};

/**
 * UpdateCarDTO → Car Entity
 */
export const mapUpdateCarDtoToEntity = (dto: UpdateCarDTO): Car => {
  const car = new Car();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) car.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.code !== undefined) car.code = dto.code;
  if (dto.manufacturer !== undefined) car.manufacturer = dto.manufacturer;
  if (dto.status !== undefined) car.status = dto.status;
  if (dto.model !== undefined) car.model = dto.model;
  if (dto.manufactureYear !== undefined) car.manufactureYear = dto.manufactureYear;
  if (dto.color !== undefined) car.color = dto.color;
  if (dto.cylinders !== undefined) car.cylinders = dto.cylinders;
  if (dto.horsepower !== undefined) car.horsepower = dto.horsepower;
  if (dto.axleCount !== undefined) car.axleCount = dto.axleCount;
  if (dto.maxWeight !== undefined) car.maxWeight = dto.maxWeight;
  if (dto.plateNumber !== undefined) car.plateNumber = dto.plateNumber;
  if (dto.plateLetters !== undefined) car.plateLetters = dto.plateLetters;
  if (dto.chassisNumber !== undefined) car.chassisNumber = dto.chassisNumber;
  if (dto.licenseNumber !== undefined) car.licenseNumber = dto.licenseNumber;
  if (dto.ownerShip !== undefined) car.ownerShip = dto.ownerShip;
  if (dto.licenseExpiryDate !== undefined) {
    car.licenseExpiryDate = new Date(dto.licenseExpiryDate);
  }
  if (dto.notes !== undefined) car.notes = dto.notes;

  return car;
};

===== FILE 65: src\app\modules\car\car.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Car } from './car.entity';
import { CarDTO } from './dtos/car.dto';
import { UpdateCarDTO } from './dtos/update-car.dto';
import { generateUniqueCode } from 'src/core/utils/generator';
import { GeneratorTypes } from 'src/core/enums/generator-types';

@Injectable()
export class CarService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Car)
    private carRepository: Repository<Car>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<CarDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.carRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<UpdateCarDTO>): Promise<CarDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.carRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<UpdateCarDTO>): Promise<Car | undefined> {
    const result = await this.carRepository.findOne(options);

    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<CarDTO>): Promise<[Car[], number]> {
    return await this.carRepository.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(car: Car, creator?: string): Promise<Car> {
    const now = new Date();
    car.code = await generateUniqueCode(this.carRepository, GeneratorTypes.CAR);

    car.createdAt = car.createdAt ?? now;
    car.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      car.createdBy = car.createdBy ?? creator;
      car.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.carRepository.save(car);
  }

  async update(car: Car, updater?: string): Promise<Car> {
    const now = new Date();

    if (updater) {
      car.updatedBy = updater;
    }

    car.updatedAt = now;

    return await this.carRepository.save(car);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.carRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';

import { CarAttachmentService } from './car-attachment.service';
import { CarService } from '../car/car.service';

import { CarAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/car-attachment.dto';
import { CreateCarAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/create-car-attachment.dto';
import { UpdateCarAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/update-car-attachment.dto';

import {
  mapCarAttachmentToDtoSelective,
  mapCreateCarAttachmentDtoToEntity,
  mapUpdateCarAttachmentDtoToEntity,
} from './car-attachment.mapper';

@Controller('api/car-attachments')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('car-attachments-module')
export class CarAttachmentController {
  logger = new Logger('CarAttachmentController');

  constructor(
    private readonly attachmentService: CarAttachmentService,
    private readonly carService: CarService,
  ) {}

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET BY ID
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get car attachment by ID' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Car attachment found', type: CarAttachmentDTO })
  async getById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<Partial<CarAttachmentDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Car attachment with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapCarAttachmentToDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'car',
      'type',
      'documentExpiryDate',
      'url',
      'notes',
      'createdAt',
      'createdBy',
    ]);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new car attachment' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: 'Car attachment created',
    type: CarAttachmentDTO,
  })
  async create(
    @Body() dto: CreateCarAttachmentDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<CarAttachmentDTO>> {
    const car = await this.carService.findByFields({ where: { id: dto.carId } });
    if (!car) throw new NotFoundException(`Car with id ${dto.carId} not found`);

    const mapped = mapCreateCarAttachmentDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.attachmentService.save(mapped, user?.email);

    return mapCarAttachmentToDtoSelective(saved);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update car attachment' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Car attachment updated',
    type: CarAttachmentDTO,
  })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateCarAttachmentDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<CarAttachmentDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Car attachment with id ${id} not found`);

    dto.id = id;
    const mapped = mapUpdateCarAttachmentDtoToEntity(dto);
    const updated = await this.attachmentService.update(mapped, user?.email);

    return mapCarAttachmentToDtoSelective(updated);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete car attachment' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Car attachment with id ${id} not found`);
    await this.attachmentService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

import { CarAttachment } from './car-attachment.entity';
import { CreateCarAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/create-car-attachment.dto';
import { CarAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/car-attachment.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { UpdateCarAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/update-car-attachment.dto';
import { Car } from '../car/car.entity';

const allowedCarAttachmentDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof CarAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'car',
  'type',
  'documentExpiryDate',
  'url',
  'notes',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
];

export function mapCarAttachmentToDtoSelective(
  attachment: CarAttachment | CarAttachmentDTO,
  keys?: (keyof CarAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<CarAttachmentDTO>;

export function mapCarAttachmentToDtoSelective(
  attachments: (CarAttachment | CarAttachmentDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof CarAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<CarAttachmentDTO>[];

export function mapCarAttachmentToDtoSelective(
  attachmentOrAttachments: CarAttachment | CarAttachmentDTO | (CarAttachment | CarAttachmentDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof CarAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<CarAttachmentDTO> | Partial<CarAttachmentDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (attachment: CarAttachment | CarAttachmentDTO): Partial<CarAttachmentDTO> => {
    const resultDto: Partial<CarAttachmentDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedCarAttachmentDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedCarAttachmentDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      const value = (attachment as any)[key];
      if (value !== undefined) {
        (resultDto as any)[key] = value;
      }
    });

    return resultDto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(attachmentOrAttachments)
    ? attachmentOrAttachments.map(mapSingle)
    : mapSingle(attachmentOrAttachments);
}

export const mapCreateCarAttachmentDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateCarAttachmentDTO): CarAttachment => {
  const attachment = new CarAttachment();
  if (dto.carId) {
    attachment.car = new Car();
    attachment.car.id = dto.carId;
  }
  attachment.type = dto.type;
  attachment.documentExpiryDate = dto.documentExpiryDate;
  attachment.url = dto.url;
  attachment.notes = dto.notes;
  attachment.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return attachment;
};

export const mapUpdateCarAttachmentDtoToEntity = (dto: UpdateCarAttachmentDTO): CarAttachment => {
  const attachment = new CarAttachment();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) attachment.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.type !== undefined) attachment.type = dto.type;
  if (dto.documentExpiryDate !== undefined) attachment.documentExpiryDate = dto.documentExpiryDate;
  if (dto.url !== undefined) attachment.url = dto.url;
  if (dto.notes !== undefined) attachment.notes = dto.notes;

  return attachment;
};

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { CarAttachment } from './car-attachment.entity';
import { CarAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/car-attachment.dto';
import { UpdateCarAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/update-car-attachment.dto';

@Injectable()
export class CarAttachmentService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(CarAttachment)
    private attachmentRepository: Repository<CarAttachment>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<CarAttachmentDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(
    options: FindOneOptions<UpdateCarAttachmentDTO>,
  ): Promise<CarAttachmentDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<UpdateCarAttachmentDTO>): Promise<CarAttachment | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async save(attachment: CarAttachment, creator?: string): Promise<CarAttachment> {
    const now = new Date();
    attachment.createdAt = attachment.createdAt ?? now;
    attachment.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      attachment.createdBy = attachment.createdBy ?? creator;
      attachment.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.attachmentRepository.save(attachment);
  }

  async update(attachment: CarAttachment, updater?: string): Promise<CarAttachment> {
    const now = new Date();

    if (updater) {
      attachment.updatedBy = updater;
    }

    attachment.updatedAt = now;

    return await this.attachmentRepository.save(attachment);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.attachmentRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 79: src\app\modules\car-manufacturer\car-manufacturer.controller.ts =====

import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  Get,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Query,
  Req,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';

import { CarManufacturerService } from './car-manufacturer.service';

import { CarManufacturerDTO } from './dtos/car-manufacturer.dto';
import { CreateCarManufacturerDTO } from './dtos/create-car-manufacturer.dto';

import {
  mapCarManufacturerToDtoSelective,
  mapCreateManufacturerDtoToEntity,
} from './car-manufacturer.mapper';

import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { CarManufacturerQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-car-manufacturer.dto';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';

@Controller('api/car-manufacturers')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('car-manufacturers-module')
export class CarManufacturerController {
  logger = new Logger('CarManufacturerController');

  constructor(private readonly manufacturerService: CarManufacturerService) {}

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET ALL (paginated)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of car manufacturers paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List of car manufacturers',
    type: CarManufacturerDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAllManufacturers(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: CarManufacturerQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<CarManufacturerDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const [results, count] = await this.manufacturerService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
    });

    const dtos = mapCarManufacturerToDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new car manufacturer' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: 'Car manufacturer created',
    type: CarManufacturerDTO,
  })
  async create(
    @Body() dto: CreateCarManufacturerDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<CarManufacturerDTO>> {
    const mapped = mapCreateManufacturerDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.manufacturerService.save(mapped, user?.email);

    return mapCarManufacturerToDtoSelective(saved);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete car manufacturer' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.manufacturerService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Car manufacturer with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.manufacturerService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

===== FILE 81: src\app\modules\car-manufacturer\car-manufacturer.mapper.ts =====

import { CarManufacturer } from './car-manufacturer.entity';
import { CreateCarManufacturerDTO } from './dtos/create-car-manufacturer.dto';
import { UpdateCarManufacturerDTO } from './dtos/update-car-manufacturer.dto';
import { CarManufacturerDTO } from './dtos/car-manufacturer.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';

const allowedCarManufacturerDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof CarManufacturerDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'name',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
];

/**
 * MAP TO DTO (Selective)
 */
export function mapCarManufacturerToDtoSelective(
  manufacturer: CarManufacturer | CarManufacturerDTO,
  keys?: (keyof CarManufacturerDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<CarManufacturerDTO>;

export function mapCarManufacturerToDtoSelective(
  manufacturers: (CarManufacturer | CarManufacturerDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof CarManufacturerDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<CarManufacturerDTO>[];

export function mapCarManufacturerToDtoSelective(
  manufacturerOrList:
    | CarManufacturer
    | CarManufacturerDTO
    | (CarManufacturer | CarManufacturerDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof CarManufacturerDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<CarManufacturerDTO> | Partial<CarManufacturerDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (
    manufacturer: CarManufacturer | CarManufacturerDTO,
  ): Partial<CarManufacturerDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<CarManufacturerDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedCarManufacturerDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedCarManufacturerDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      const value = (manufacturer as any)[key];
      if (value !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = value;
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(manufacturerOrList)
    ? manufacturerOrList.map(mapSingle)
    : mapSingle(manufacturerOrList);
}

/**
 * CREATE MAPPER
 */
export const mapCreateManufacturerDtoToEntity = (
  dto: CreateCarManufacturerDTO,
): CarManufacturer => {
  const entity = new CarManufacturer();

  entity.name = dto.name;
  entity.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return entity;
};

/**
 * UPDATE MAPPER
 */
export const mapUpdateManufacturerDtoToEntity = (
  dto: UpdateCarManufacturerDTO,
): CarManufacturer => {
  const entity = new CarManufacturer();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) entity.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.name !== undefined) entity.name = dto.name;

  return entity;
};

// src/car-manufacturer/car-manufacturer.service.ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions } from 'typeorm';

import { CarManufacturer } from './car-manufacturer.entity';

@Injectable()
export class CarManufacturerService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(CarManufacturer)
    private readonly manufacturerRepository: Repository<CarManufacturer>,
  ) {}

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // FIND BY ID
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async findById(id: number): Promise<CarManufacturer | undefined> {
    const result = await this.manufacturerRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result ?? undefined;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // FIND BY FIELDS (Where)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async findByFields(
    options: FindOneOptions<CarManufacturer>,
  ): Promise<CarManufacturer | undefined> {
    const result = await this.manufacturerRepository.findOne(options);
    return result ?? undefined;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // FIND LIST
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async find(options: FindManyOptions<CarManufacturer>): Promise<CarManufacturer[]> {
    return this.manufacturerRepository.find(options);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // FIND & COUNT (pagination)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async findAndCount(
    options: FindManyOptions<CarManufacturer>,
  ): Promise<[CarManufacturer[], number]> {
    return this.manufacturerRepository.findAndCount(options);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async save(entity: CarManufacturer, creator?: string): Promise<CarManufacturer> {
    const now = new Date();

    entity.createdAt = entity.createdAt ?? now;
    entity.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      entity.createdBy = entity.createdBy ?? creator;
      entity.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.manufacturerRepository.save(entity);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async update(entity: CarManufacturer, updater?: string): Promise<CarManufacturer> {
    const now = new Date();

    entity.updatedAt = now;
    if (updater) entity.updatedBy = updater;

    return await this.manufacturerRepository.save(entity);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.manufacturerRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

import { Controller, Get, Post, Delete, Param, Query, Body, Req } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { CarModelService } from './car-model.service';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import { Roles } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import { CarModelDTO } from './dtos/car-model.dto';
import { CarModelQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-car-model.dto';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { CreateCarModelDTO } from './dtos/create-car-model.dto';
import { mapCarModelToDtoSelective } from './car-model.mapper';

@ApiTags('Car Models')
@Controller('api/car-models')
export class CarModelController {
  constructor(private readonly carModelService: CarModelService) {}

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET ALL PAGINATED
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of car models paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    type: CarModelDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAll(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: CarModelQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<CarModelDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const where: any = {};

    if (query.name) where.name = query.name;
    if (query.manufacturerId) where.manufacturer = { id: query.manufacturerId };

    const [results, count] = await this.carModelService.findAndCount({
      where,
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
    });

    const dtos = mapCarModelToDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'manufacturer',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
    ]);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a car model' })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateCarModelDTO, @Req() req: Request) {
    return await this.carModelService.create(
      {
        name: dto.name,
        manufacturer: { id: dto.manufacturerId } as any,
      },
      req.user?.username,
    );
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  async delete(@Param('id') id: number) {
    await this.carModelService.delete(id);
    return { message: 'Car model deleted' };
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, FindManyOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { CarModel } from './car-model.entity';

@Injectable()
export class CarModelService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(CarModel)
    private readonly carModelRepo: Repository<CarModel>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<CarModel | undefined> {
    return (await this.carModelRepo.findOne({ where: { id } })) ?? undefined;
  }

  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<CarModel>): Promise<[CarModel[], number]> {
    return await this.carModelRepo.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async create(data: Partial<CarModel>, creator?: string): Promise<CarModel> {
    const now = new Date();
    const entity = this.carModelRepo.create({
      ...data,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      createdBy: creator,
      updatedBy: creator,
    });
    return await this.carModelRepo.save(entity);
  }

  async update(model: CarModel, updater?: string): Promise<CarModel> {
    model.updatedAt = new Date();
    if (updater) model.updatedBy = updater;
    return await this.carModelRepo.save(model);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.carModelRepo.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 97: src\app\modules\contact\contact.controller.ts =====

import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { ContactDTO } from './dtos/contact.dto';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import { UpdateContactDTO } from './dtos/update-contact.dto';
import { CreateContactDTO } from './dtos/create-contact.dto';
import { ContactService } from './contact.service';
import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';
import { mapCreateContactDtoToEntity, mapUpdateContactDtoToEntity } from './contact.mapper';
import { UserService } from '../user/user.service';
import { Contact } from './contact.entity';

@Controller('api/contacts')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('contacts-module')
export class ContactController {
  logger = new Logger('ContactsController');

  constructor(
    private readonly contactService: ContactService,
    private readonly userService: UserService,
  ) {}

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create multiple contacts' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Records created', type: ContactDTO, isArray: true })
  async create(
    @Body() createContactDTOs: CreateContactDTO[],
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<ContactDTO[]> {
    await Promise.all(
      createContactDTOs?.map(async (dto) => {
        const existing = await this.contactService.findByFields({
          where: { phone: dto.phone },
        });
        if (existing) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`Contact with phone ${dto.phone} already exists`);
        }

        const existingUser = await this.userService.findByFields({
          where: { id: dto.userId },
        });
        if (!existingUser) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`User with id ${dto.userId} does not exist`);
        }
      }),
    );

    const mappedContacts = mapCreateContactDtoToEntity(createContactDTOs);

    const savedContacts = (await this.contactService.save(
      mappedContacts,
      user?.email,
    )) as ContactDTO[];

    return savedContacts;
  }

  @Put('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update one or multiple contacts' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Record(s) updated successfully',
    type: ContactDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async update(
    @Body() dto: UpdateContactDTO | UpdateContactDTO[],
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<ContactDTO | ContactDTO[]> {
    const dtos = Array.isArray(dto) ? dto : [dto];

    // Validate each contact before updating
    for (const item of dtos) {
      if (!item.id) throw new BadRequestException('Each contact must include an id.');
      const existing = await this.contactService.findById(item.id);
      if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Contact with id ${item.id} not found`);
    }

    // Map and update
    const mappedContacts = mapUpdateContactDtoToEntity(dtos) as Contact[];

    return this.contactService.update(mappedContacts, user?.email);
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete contact' })
  async delete(@Param('id') id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.contactService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Contact with id ${id} not found`);
    await this.contactService.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 99: src\app\modules\contact\contact.mapper.ts =====

import { Contact } from './contact.entity';
import { ContactDTO } from './dtos/contact.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { CreateContactDTO } from './dtos/create-contact.dto';
import { UpdateContactDTO } from './dtos/update-contact.dto';
import { User } from '../user/user.entity';

/**
 * Defines allowed keys for mapping from Contact entity to DTO.
 * Include all simple scalar fields and metadata fields.
 */
const allowedContactDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof ContactDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'user',
  'phone',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
];

/**
 * Maps a Contact entity or array of entities to ContactDTO(s),
 * allowing selective inclusion of properties based on allowed keys.
 */
export function mapContactToContactDtoSelective(
  entity: Contact,
  keys?: (keyof ContactDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): UpdateContactDTO;
export function mapContactToContactDtoSelective(
  entities: Contact[],
  keys?: (keyof ContactDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): UpdateContactDTO[];
export function mapContactToContactDtoSelective(
  input: Contact | Contact[],
  keys?: (keyof ContactDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): UpdateContactDTO | UpdateContactDTO[] {
  const mapSingle = (entity: Contact): UpdateContactDTO => {
    const resultDto: UpdateContactDTO = {} as UpdateContactDTO;

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedContactDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedContactDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in entity && entity[key as keyof Contact] !== undefined) {
        (resultDto as any)[key] = entity[key as keyof Contact];
      }
    });

    return resultDto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(input) ? input.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(input);
}

/**
 * Maps a CreateContactDTO to a new Contact entity.
 * Used when creating new records before saving to DB.
 */
export function mapCreateContactDtoToEntity(
  dto: CreateContactDTO | CreateContactDTO[],
): Contact | Contact[] {
  const mapSingle = (item: CreateContactDTO): Contact => {
    const contact = new Contact();
    contact.phone = item.phone;
    contact.isPrimary = item.isPrimary ?? false;

    if (item.userId) {
      contact.user = new User();
      contact.user.id = item.userId;
    }

    return contact;
  };

  return Array.isArray(dto) ? dto.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(dto);
}

/**
 * Maps an UpdateContactDTO to an existing Contact entity.
 * Only defined fields in the DTO will update the entity.
 */
export function mapUpdateContactDtoToEntity(
  dto: UpdateContactDTO | UpdateContactDTO[],
): Contact | Contact[] {
  const mapOne = (item: UpdateContactDTO): Contact => {
    const contact = new Contact();

    if (item.id !== undefined) contact.id = item.id;
    if (item.phone !== undefined) contact.phone = item.phone;
    if (item.isPrimary !== undefined) contact.isPrimary = item.isPrimary;

    return contact;
  };

  if (Array.isArray(dto)) {
    return dto.map(mapOne);
  }

  return mapOne(dto);
}

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Contact } from './contact.entity';
import { ContactDTO } from './dtos/contact.dto';
import { UpdateContactDTO } from './dtos/update-contact.dto';

@Injectable()
export class ContactService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Contact)
    private readonly contactRepository: Repository<Contact>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<ContactDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.contactRepository.findOne({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['user'],
    });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<ContactDTO>): Promise<ContactDTO | null> {
    return this.contactRepository.findOne(options);
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<ContactDTO>): Promise<ContactDTO[] | null> {
    return this.contactRepository.find(options);
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<ContactDTO>): Promise<[ContactDTO[], number]> {
    return this.contactRepository.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(contact: Contact | Contact[], creator?: string): Promise<ContactDTO | ContactDTO[]> {
    const contacts = Array.isArray(contact) ? contact : [contact];

    const entities = contacts.map((c) =>
      this.contactRepository.create({
        ...c,
        createdBy: creator,
        updatedBy: creator,
        createdAt: new Date(),
      }),
    );

    const saved = await this.contactRepository.save(entities);

    return Array.isArray(contact) ? saved : saved[0];
  }

  async update(
    updateContactDTO: UpdateContactDTO | UpdateContactDTO[],
    updater?: string,
  ): Promise<ContactDTO | ContactDTO[]> {
    const contacts = Array.isArray(updateContactDTO) ? updateContactDTO : [updateContactDTO];

    const entities = contacts.map((c) =>
      this.contactRepository.create({
        ...c,
        updatedBy: updater,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      }),
    );

    const updated = await this.contactRepository.save(entities);

    return Array.isArray(updateContactDTO) ? updated : updated[0];
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.contactRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  Logger,
  NotFoundException,
  Param,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Post,
  Put,
  Query,
  Req,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, AuthUser, Roles, RolesGuard } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import { FindOptionsWhere } from 'typeorm';

import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';
import { CostCenterService } from './cost-center.service';
import { CostCenterDTO } from './dtos/cost-center.dto';
import { CreateCostCenterDTO } from './dtos/create-cost-center.dto';
import { UpdateCostCenterDTO } from './dtos/update-cost-center.dto';
import { CostCenterQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-cost-center.dto';
import { CostCenter } from './cost-center.entity';
import {
  mapCostCenterToDtoSelective,
  mapCreateCostCenterDtoToEntity,
  mapUpdateCostCenterDtoToEntity,
} from './cost-center.mapper';

@Controller('api/cost-centers')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('cost-centers-module')
export class CostCenterController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('CostCenterController');

  constructor(private readonly costCenterService: CostCenterService) {}

  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of cost centers paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List of cost centers',
    type: CostCenterDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAll(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: CostCenterQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<CostCenterDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const where: FindOptionsWhere<CostCenter> = {};
    if (query.isActive !== undefined) where.isActive = query.isActive;

    const [results, count] = await this.costCenterService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      where,
    });

    const dtos = mapCostCenterToDtoSelective(results);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get cost center by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'CostCenter found', type: CostCenterDTO })
  async getById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<CostCenterDTO> {
    const existing = await this.costCenterService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`CostCenter with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapCostCenterToDtoSelective(existing) as CostCenterDTO;
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new cost center' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: CostCenterDTO })
  async create(
    @Body() dto: CreateCostCenterDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<CostCenterDTO> {
    const entity = mapCreateCostCenterDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.costCenterService.save(entity, user?.email);
    return mapCostCenterToDtoSelective(saved) as CostCenterDTO;
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update cost center' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: CostCenterDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateCostCenterDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<CostCenterDTO> {
    const existing = await this.costCenterService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`CostCenter with id ${id} not found`);

    const entity = mapUpdateCostCenterDtoToEntity(dto, existing);
    const updated = await this.costCenterService.update(entity, user?.email);
    return mapCostCenterToDtoSelective(updated) as CostCenterDTO;
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete cost center' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.costCenterService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`CostCenter with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.costCenterService.delete(id);
  }
}

import { ApiProperty, ApiPropertyOptional } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { IsBoolean, IsObject, IsOptional, IsString } from 'class-validator';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';

export class CostCenterDTO extends BaseDTO {
  @ApiProperty({ example: 'OPS' })
  @IsString()
  code: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'Operations' })
  @IsString()
  name: string;

  @ApiProperty({ default: true })
  @IsBoolean()
  isActive: boolean;

  @ApiPropertyOptional()

  @IsObject()
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

import {
  BadRequestException,
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  Logger,
  NotFoundException,
  Param,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Post,
  Put,
  Query,
  Req,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, AuthUser, Roles, RolesGuard } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';

import { DeliveryPriceService } from './delivery-price.service';
import { DeliveryPriceDTO } from './dtos/delivery-price.dto';
import { CreateDeliveryPriceDTO } from './dtos/create-delivery-price.dto';
import { UpdateDeliveryPriceDTO } from './dtos/update-delivery-price.dto';
import { DeliveryPriceQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-delivery-price.dto';
import { BulkCreateDeliveryPriceDTO } from './dtos/bulk-create-delivery-price.dto';
import {
  mapCreateDeliveryPriceDtoToEntity,
  mapDeliveryPricesGrouped,
  mapDeliveryPriceToDeliveryPriceDtoSelective,
  mapUpdateDeliveryPriceDtoToEntity,
} from './delivery-price.mapper';
import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';
import { ClientService } from '../factory/client.service';
import { AreaService } from '../area/area.service';
import { PriceTypeService } from '../price-type/price-type.service';

@Controller('api/delivery-prices')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('delivery-prices-module')
export class DeliveryPriceController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('DeliveryPriceController');

  constructor(
    private readonly deliveryPriceService: DeliveryPriceService,
    private readonly clientService: ClientService,
    private readonly areaService: AreaService,
    private readonly priceTypeService: PriceTypeService,
  ) {}

  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of delivery prices grouped by government and area' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Delivery prices grouped by government and area',
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAll(@Req() req: Request, @Query() query: DeliveryPriceQueryDTO): Promise<any> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1), // zero-based for skip
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    // Fetch delivery prices with QueryBuilder
    const [results, count] = await this.deliveryPriceService.findAndCount(
      query,
      pageRequest.page,
      pageRequest.size,
      query.sortField,
      (query.sortOrder as 'ASC' | 'DESC') || 'ASC',
    );

    // Add pagination headers to the response
    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return mapDeliveryPricesGrouped(results);
  }

  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get delivery price by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Delivery price found', type: DeliveryPriceDTO })
  async getDeliveryPriceById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<DeliveryPriceDTO> {
    const existing = await this.deliveryPriceService.findByFields({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['client', 'area', 'priceType'],
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`DeliveryPrice with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapDeliveryPriceToDeliveryPriceDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'client',
      'area',
      'priceType',
      'basePrice',
      'additionalFees',
      'taxPrice',
      'totalPrice',
      'validFrom',
      'validTo',
      'notes',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]) as DeliveryPriceDTO;
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new delivery price' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: DeliveryPriceDTO })
  async create(
    @Body() dto: CreateDeliveryPriceDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<DeliveryPriceDTO> {
    if (!dto.clientId) {
      throw new BadRequestException('clientId is required');
    }
    if (!dto.areaId) {
      throw new BadRequestException('areaId is required');
    }

    const client = await this.clientService.findById(dto.clientId);
    if (!client) throw new NotFoundException(`Client with id ${dto.clientId} not found`);

    const area = await this.areaService.findById(dto.areaId);
    if (!area) throw new NotFoundException(`Area with id ${dto.areaId} not found`);

    if (dto.priceTypeId !== undefined) {
      const priceType = await this.priceTypeService.findById(dto.priceTypeId);
      if (!priceType) throw new NotFoundException(`PriceType with id ${dto.priceTypeId} not found`);
    }

    const entity = mapCreateDeliveryPriceDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.deliveryPriceService.save(entity, user?.email);
    return mapDeliveryPriceToDeliveryPriceDtoSelective(saved) as DeliveryPriceDTO;
  }

  @Post('/bulk')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create multiple delivery prices for the same client' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: 'Records created',
    type: DeliveryPriceDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async bulkCreate(
    @Body() dto: BulkCreateDeliveryPriceDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<DeliveryPriceDTO[]> {
    if (!dto.clientId) {
      throw new BadRequestException('clientId is required');
    }
    if (!dto.items || dto.items.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('items must contain at least one entry');
    }

    const client = await this.clientService.findById(dto.clientId);
    if (!client) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Client with id ${dto.clientId} not found`);
    }

    // Validate referenced areas and price types
    for (const item of dto.items) {
      const area = await this.areaService.findById(item.areaId);
      if (!area) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`Area with id ${item.areaId} not found`);
      }

      if (item.priceTypeId !== undefined) {
        const priceType = await this.priceTypeService.findById(item.priceTypeId);
        if (!priceType) {
          throw new NotFoundException(`PriceType with id ${item.priceTypeId} not found`);
        }
      }
    }

    const entities = dto.items.map((item) =>
      mapCreateDeliveryPriceDtoToEntity({
        clientId: dto.clientId,
        areaId: item.areaId,
        priceTypeId: item.priceTypeId,
        basePrice: item.basePrice,
        additionalFees: item.additionalFees,
        validFrom: item.validFrom,
        validTo: item.validTo,
        notes: item.notes,
      } as any),
    );

    const saved = await this.deliveryPriceService.saveMany(entities, user?.email);
    return mapDeliveryPriceToDeliveryPriceDtoSelective(saved, [
      'id',
      'client',
      'area',
      'priceType',
      'basePrice',
      'additionalFees',
      'taxPrice',
      'totalPrice',
      'validFrom',
      'validTo',
      'notes',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]) as DeliveryPriceDTO[];
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update delivery price' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: DeliveryPriceDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateDeliveryPriceDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<DeliveryPriceDTO> {
    const existing = await this.deliveryPriceService.findByFields({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['client', 'area', 'priceType'],
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`DeliveryPrice with id ${id} not found`);

    if (dto.clientId !== undefined) {
      const client = await this.clientService.findById(dto.clientId);
      if (!client) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`Client with id ${dto.clientId} not found`);
      }
    }

    if (dto.areaId !== undefined) {
      const area = await this.areaService.findById(dto.areaId);
      if (!area) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`Area with id ${dto.areaId} not found`);
      }
    }

    if (dto.priceTypeId !== undefined) {
      const priceType = await this.priceTypeService.findById(dto.priceTypeId);
      if (!priceType) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`PriceType with id ${dto.priceTypeId} not found`);
      }
    }

    const entity = mapUpdateDeliveryPriceDtoToEntity(dto, existing);
    const updated = await this.deliveryPriceService.update(entity, user?.email);
    return mapDeliveryPriceToDeliveryPriceDtoSelective(updated) as DeliveryPriceDTO;
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete delivery price' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.deliveryPriceService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`DeliveryPrice with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.deliveryPriceService.delete(id);
  }
}


===== FILE 115: src\app\modules\delivery-price\delivery-price.entity.ts =====

import { BaseEntity } from 'src/core/utils/base.entity';
import { Column, Entity, Index, JoinColumn, ManyToOne, Unique } from 'typeorm';
import { Client } from '../factory/client.entity';
import { Area } from '../area/area.entity';
import { PriceType } from '../price-type/price-type.entity';

@Entity('delivery_prices')
@Unique(['client', 'area', 'priceType', 'validFrom'])
@Index(['client', 'area', 'validFrom', 'validTo'])
export class DeliveryPrice extends BaseEntity {
  @ManyToOne(() => Client, (client) => client.prices, { nullable: false })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'client_id' })
  client: Client;

  @ManyToOne(() => Area, (area) => (area as any).prices, { nullable: false })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'area_id' })
  area: Area;

  @ManyToOne(() => PriceType, { nullable: true })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'price_type_id' })
  priceType?: PriceType;

  @Column({ type: 'decimal', precision: 10, scale: 2, nullable: false })
  basePrice: number;

  @Column({ type: 'decimal', precision: 10, scale: 2, default: 0 })
  additionalFees: number = 0;

  @Column({ type: 'decimal', precision: 10, scale: 2, default: 0 })
  taxPrice: number = 0;

  @Column({ type: 'decimal', precision: 10, scale: 2, nullable: true })
  totalPrice?: number;

  @Column({ type: 'date' })
  validFrom: Date;

  @Column({ type: 'date' })
  validTo: Date;

  @Column({ type: 'text', nullable: true })
  notes?: string;
}


===== FILE 116: src\app\modules\delivery-price\delivery-price.mapper.ts =====

import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { DeliveryPrice } from './delivery-price.entity';
import { DeliveryPriceDTO } from './dtos/delivery-price.dto';
import { CreateDeliveryPriceDTO } from './dtos/create-delivery-price.dto';
import { UpdateDeliveryPriceDTO } from './dtos/update-delivery-price.dto';
import { Client } from '../factory/client.entity';
import { Area } from '../area/area.entity';
import { PriceType } from '../price-type/price-type.entity';
import {
  AreaDeliveryPricesDTO,
  GovernmentDeliveryPricesDTO,
} from './dtos/grouped-delivery-price.dto';

const allowedDeliveryPriceDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof DeliveryPriceDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'client',
  'area',
  'priceType',
  'basePrice',
  'additionalFees',
  'taxPrice',
  'totalPrice',
  'validFrom',
  'validTo',
  'notes',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
] as const;

export function mapDeliveryPriceToDeliveryPriceDtoSelective(
  price: DeliveryPrice,
  keys?: (keyof DeliveryPriceDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<DeliveryPriceDTO>;

export function mapDeliveryPriceToDeliveryPriceDtoSelective(
  prices: DeliveryPrice[],
  keys?: (keyof DeliveryPriceDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<DeliveryPriceDTO>[];

export function mapDeliveryPriceToDeliveryPriceDtoSelective(
  data: DeliveryPrice | DeliveryPrice[],
  keys?: (keyof DeliveryPriceDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<DeliveryPriceDTO> | Partial<DeliveryPriceDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (price: DeliveryPrice): Partial<DeliveryPriceDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<DeliveryPriceDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedDeliveryPriceDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      (allowedDeliveryPriceDtoKeys as readonly string[]).includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in price && (price as any)[key] !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = (price as any)[key];
      }
    });

    // Only add client if it's in the requested keys
    if (keysToMap.includes('client' as any) && price.client) {
      (dto as any).client = {
        id: price.client.id,
        name: price.client.name,
      };
    }

    // Only add area if it's in the requested keys
    if (keysToMap.includes('area' as any) && price.area) {
      (dto as any).area = {
        id: price.area.id,
        name: price.area.name,
      };
    }

    // Only add priceType if it's in the requested keys
    if (keysToMap.includes('priceType' as any) && price.priceType) {
      (dto as any).priceType = {
        id: price.priceType.id,
        name: price.priceType.name,
        description: price.priceType.description,
      };
    }

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(data) ? data.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(data);
}

export function mapDeliveryPriceToDTO(price: DeliveryPrice): DeliveryPriceDTO {
  return mapDeliveryPriceToDeliveryPriceDtoSelective(price, [
    'id',
    'client',
    'area',
    'priceType',
    'basePrice',
    'additionalFees',
    'taxPrice',
    'totalPrice',
    'validFrom',
    'validTo',
    'notes',
    'createdBy',
    'updatedBy',
    'createdAt',
    'updatedAt',
  ]) as DeliveryPriceDTO;
}

export const mapCreateDeliveryPriceDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateDeliveryPriceDTO): DeliveryPrice => {
  const entity = new DeliveryPrice();

  if (dto.clientId !== undefined) {
    entity.client = { id: dto.clientId } as Client;
  }

  if (dto.areaId !== undefined) {
    entity.area = { id: dto.areaId } as Area;
  }

  if (dto.priceTypeId !== undefined) {
    entity.priceType = { id: dto.priceTypeId } as PriceType;
  }

  entity.basePrice = dto.basePrice;
  entity.additionalFees = dto.additionalFees ?? 0;

  (entity as any).taxPrice = dto.taxPrice ?? 0;

  const base = Number(entity.basePrice ?? 0);
  const additional = Number(entity.additionalFees ?? 0);
  const tax = Number((entity as any).taxPrice ?? 0);
  entity.totalPrice = base + additional + tax;

  entity.validFrom = dto.validFrom as any;
  entity.validTo = dto.validTo as any;
  entity.notes = dto.notes;

  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) entity.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return entity;
};

export const mapUpdateDeliveryPriceDtoToEntity = (
  dto: UpdateDeliveryPriceDTO,
  existing: DeliveryPrice,
): DeliveryPrice => {
  const entity = new DeliveryPrice();

  entity.id = existing.id;
  entity.createdAt = existing.createdAt;

  entity.client = dto.clientId !== undefined ? ({ id: dto.clientId } as Client) : existing.client;

  entity.area = dto.areaId !== undefined ? ({ id: dto.areaId } as Area) : existing.area;

  entity.priceType =
    dto.priceTypeId !== undefined ? ({ id: dto.priceTypeId } as PriceType) : existing.priceType;

  entity.basePrice = dto.basePrice ?? existing.basePrice;
  entity.additionalFees = dto.additionalFees ?? existing.additionalFees;

  (entity as any).taxPrice =
    dto.taxPrice !== undefined ? dto.taxPrice : ((existing as any).taxPrice ?? 0);

  const base = Number(entity.basePrice ?? 0);
  const additional = Number(entity.additionalFees ?? 0);
  const tax = Number((entity as any).taxPrice ?? 0);
  entity.totalPrice = base + additional + tax;

  entity.validFrom = (dto.validFrom as any) ?? existing.validFrom;
  entity.validTo = (dto.validTo as any) ?? existing.validTo;
  entity.notes = dto.notes ?? existing.notes;

  return entity;
};

export function mapDeliveryPricesGrouped(prices: DeliveryPrice[]): GovernmentDeliveryPricesDTO[] {
  const grouped: GovernmentDeliveryPricesDTO[] = [];

  prices.forEach((price) => {
    if (!price.area || !price.area.government) {
      return;
    }

    const govId = price.area.government.id;
    const govName = price.area.government.name;

    let gov = grouped.find((g) => g.id === govId);
    if (!gov) {
      gov = new GovernmentDeliveryPricesDTO();
      gov.id = govId;
      gov.name = govName;
      gov.areas = [];
      grouped.push(gov);
    }

    const areaId = price.area.id;
    const areaName = price.area.name;

    let area = gov.areas.find((a) => a.id === areaId);
    if (!area) {
      area = new AreaDeliveryPricesDTO();
      area.id = areaId;
      area.name = areaName;
      area.deliveryPrices = [];
      gov.areas.push(area);
    }

    // Map delivery price without client and area fields to avoid circular references
    const priceDto = mapDeliveryPriceToDeliveryPriceDtoSelective(price, [
      'id',
      'priceType',
      'basePrice',
      'additionalFees',
      'taxPrice',
      'totalPrice',
      'validFrom',
      'validTo',
      'notes',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]) as DeliveryPriceDTO;

    area.deliveryPrices.push(priceDto);
  });

  return grouped;
}

===== FILE 118: src\app\modules\delivery-price\delivery-price.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { DeliveryPrice } from './delivery-price.entity';
import { DeliveryPriceQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-delivery-price.dto';

@Injectable()
export class DeliveryPriceService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(DeliveryPrice)
    private readonly deliveryPriceRepository: Repository<DeliveryPrice>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<DeliveryPrice | undefined> {
    const result = await this.deliveryPriceRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<DeliveryPrice>): Promise<DeliveryPrice | undefined> {
    const result = await this.deliveryPriceRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<DeliveryPrice>): Promise<DeliveryPrice[] | undefined> {
    const result = await this.deliveryPriceRepository.find(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(
    query: DeliveryPriceQueryDTO,
    page: number,
    pageSize: number,
    sortField?: string,
    sortOrder: 'ASC' | 'DESC' = 'ASC',
  ): Promise<[DeliveryPrice[], number]> {
    const qb = this.deliveryPriceRepository
      .createQueryBuilder('price')
      .leftJoinAndSelect('price.client', 'client')
      .leftJoinAndSelect('price.area', 'area')
      .leftJoinAndSelect('price.priceType', 'priceType')
      .leftJoinAndSelect('area.government', 'government');

    if (query.clientId) {
      qb.andWhere('client.id = :clientId', { clientId: query.clientId });
    }
    if (query.areaId) {
      qb.andWhere('area.id = :areaId', { areaId: query.areaId });
    }
    if (query.priceTypeId) {
      qb.andWhere('priceType.id = :priceTypeId', { priceTypeId: query.priceTypeId });
    }

    if (sortField) {
      qb.orderBy(`price.${sortField}`, sortOrder);
    } else {
      qb.orderBy('price.createdAt', sortOrder);
    }

    qb.skip(page * pageSize).take(pageSize);

    return await qb.getManyAndCount();
  }

  async save(price: DeliveryPrice, creator?: string): Promise<DeliveryPrice> {
    const now = new Date();

    price.createdAt = price.createdAt ?? now;
    price.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      price.createdBy = price.createdBy ?? creator;
      price.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.deliveryPriceRepository.save(price);
  }

  async saveMany(prices: DeliveryPrice[], creator?: string): Promise<DeliveryPrice[]> {
    const now = new Date();

    prices.forEach((price) => {
      price.createdAt = price.createdAt ?? now;
      price.updatedAt = now;

      if (creator) {
        price.createdBy = price.createdBy ?? creator;
        price.updatedBy = creator;
      }
    });

    return await this.deliveryPriceRepository.save(prices);
  }

  async update(price: DeliveryPrice, updater?: string): Promise<DeliveryPrice> {
    const now = new Date();

    price.updatedAt = now;
    if (updater) price.updatedBy = updater;

    return await this.deliveryPriceRepository.save(price);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.deliveryPriceRepository.delete(id);
  }
}


===== FILE 119: src\app\modules\delivery-price\dtos\bulk-create-delivery-price.dto.ts =====

import { ApiProperty, ApiPropertyOptional } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import {
  IsArray,
  IsDateString,
  IsInt,
  IsNotEmpty,
  IsNumber,
  IsOptional,
  IsPositive,
  IsString,
  ValidateNested,
} from 'class-validator';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';

class BulkDeliveryPriceItemDTO {
  @ApiProperty({ description: 'معرف المنطقة', example: 1 })
  @IsInt()
  @IsPositive()
  areaId: number;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ description: 'معرف نوع التسعير', example: 1 })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @IsPositive()
  priceTypeId?: number;

  @ApiProperty({ description: 'السعر الأساسي', example: 100 })
  @IsNumber()
  basePrice: number;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ description: 'رسوم إضافية', example: 10 })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber()
  additionalFees?: number;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ description: 'ضريبة القيمة المضافة', example: 15 })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber()
  taxPrice?: number;

  @ApiProperty({ description: 'تاريخ بداية الصلاحية', example: '2024-01-01' })

===== FILE 125: src\app\modules\driver\driver.controller.ts =====

import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  Get,
  Req,
  Query,
  ParseIntPipe,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { DriverDTO } from './dtos/driver.dto';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import { UpdateDriverDTO } from './dtos/update-driver.dto';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { CreateDriverDTO } from './dtos/create-driver.dto';
import { DriverService } from './driver.service';
import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import {
  mapCreateDriverDtoToEntity,
  mapDriverToDriverDtoSelective,
  mapUpdateDriverDtoToEntity,
} from './driver.mapper';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import { DriverQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-driver.dto';
import { UserService } from '../user/user.service';
import { mapCreateContactDtoToEntity } from '../contact/contact.mapper';
import { Contact } from '../contact/contact.entity';
import { ContactService } from '../contact/contact.service';
import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';
import { withTransaction } from 'src/core/utils/transaction';

@Controller('api/drivers')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('drivers-module')
export class DriverController {
  logger = new Logger('DriversController');

  constructor(
    private readonly driverService: DriverService,
    private readonly userService: UserService,
    private readonly contactService: ContactService,
    private readonly dataSource: DataSource,
  ) {}

  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get the list of drivers paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List all drivers',
    type: DriverDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAllDrivers(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: DriverQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<UpdateDriverDTO[]> {
    const pageRequest: PageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const [results, count] = await this.driverService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      relations: ['user', 'user.contacts', 'user.salary'],
    });

    const driverDtos = mapDriverToDriverDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'licenseNumber',
      'licenseExpiryDate',
      'user',
    ]);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return driverDtos;
  }

  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get driver by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Driver found', type: DriverDTO })
  async getDriverById(@Param('id') id: number): Promise<UpdateDriverDTO> {
    const existing = await this.driverService.find({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['user', 'user.contacts', 'user.salary', 'user.attachments'],
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Driver with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapDriverToDriverDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'licenseNumber',
      'licenseExpiryDate',
      'user',
    ]);
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new driver' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: DriverDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateDriverDTO, @AuthUser() user: UserDTO): Promise<DriverDTO> {
    const existing = await this.driverService.findByFields({
      where: { licenseNumber: dto.licenseNumber },
    });
    if (existing)
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Driver with license number ${dto.licenseNumber} already exists`,
      );

    if (dto.user.email) {
      const emailCheck = await this.userService.findByFields({
        where: { email: dto.user.email },
      });

      if (emailCheck) {
        throw new BadRequestException(`User with email ${dto.user.email} already exists`);
      }
    }

    // Validate contacts for duplicate phone numbers before any DB writes
    if (dto.contacts && dto.contacts.length > 0) {
      const hasDuplicates = dto.contacts.some(
        (contact, index) => dto.contacts.findIndex((c) => c.phone === contact.phone) !== index,
      );

      if (hasDuplicates) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Duplicate contact phone numbers found');
      }
    }

    const savedDriver = await withTransaction(this.dataSource, async () => {
      const entity = await mapCreateDriverDtoToEntity(dto);
      entity.user.role = UserRole.DRIVER;
      const driver = await this.driverService.save(entity, user?.email);

      if (dto.contacts && dto.contacts.length > 0) {
        const mappedContacts = mapCreateContactDtoToEntity(
          dto.contacts.map((c) => ({ ...c, userId: driver.user.id })),
        ) as Contact[];
        await this.contactService.save(mappedContacts, user?.email);
      }

      return driver;
    });

    return savedDriver;
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update existing driver' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: DriverDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateDriverDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<UpdateDriverDTO> {
    const existing = await this.driverService.findByFields({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['user'],
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Driver with id ${id} not found`);

    // Extract and validate contacts (if provided) before any DB writes
    const contacts = (dto as any).contacts as { phone: string }[] | undefined;
    if (contacts && contacts.length > 0) {
      const hasDuplicates = contacts.some(
        (contact, index) => contacts.findIndex((c) => c.phone === contact.phone) !== index,
      );

      if (hasDuplicates) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Duplicate contact phone numbers found');
      }
    }

    const updated = await withTransaction(this.dataSource, async () => {
      dto.id = id;

      if (dto.user?.username) {
        const existingUser = await this.userService.findByFields({
          where: { username: dto.user.username },
        });
        if (existingUser && existing.user.id !== existingUser.id) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`User with username ${dto.user.username} already exists`);
        }
      }

      if (dto.user?.email) {
        const emailCheck = await this.userService.findByFields({
          where: { email: dto.user.email },
        });
        if (emailCheck && existing.user.id !== emailCheck.id) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`User with email ${dto.user.email} already exists`);
        }
      }

      if (dto.user) {
        dto.user.id = existing.user.id;
      }

      const mappedDriver = await mapUpdateDriverDtoToEntity(dto);
      const driver = await this.driverService.update(mappedDriver, user?.email);

      // Optional: update contacts (phone numbers) similar to POST transaction
      if (contacts && contacts.length > 0) {
        // Remove existing contacts for this user
        const existingContacts = (await this.contactService.find({
          where: { user: { id: existing.user.id } } as any,
        })) as Contact[] | null;

        if (existingContacts && existingContacts.length > 0) {
          for (const contact of existingContacts) {
            await this.contactService.delete(contact.id);
          }
        }

        // Create new contacts with updated phone values
        const mappedContacts = mapCreateContactDtoToEntity(
          contacts.map((c) => ({ ...c, userId: existing.user.id }) as any),
        ) as Contact[];
        await this.contactService.save(mappedContacts, user?.email);
      }

      return driver as unknown as UpdateDriverDTO;
    });

    return updated;
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete driver' })
  async delete(@Param('id') id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.driverService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Driver with id ${id} not found`);
    await this.driverService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

===== FILE 127: src\app\modules\driver\driver.mapper.ts =====

import { mapUserCreateDtoToEntity, mapUserUpdateDtoToEntity } from '../user/user.mapper';
import { Driver } from './driver.entity';
import { CreateDriverDTO } from './dtos/create-driver.dto';
import { DriverDTO } from './dtos/driver.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { UpdateDriverDTO } from './dtos/update-driver.dto';

const allowedDriverDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof DriverDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'licenseNumber',
  'licenseExpiryDate',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
  'user',
];

export function mapDriverToDriverDtoSelective(
  driver: Driver,
  keys?: (keyof DriverDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
  includeUser?: boolean,
): Partial<DriverDTO>;
export function mapDriverToDriverDtoSelective(
  drivers: Driver[],
  keys?: (keyof DriverDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
  includeUser?: boolean,
): Partial<DriverDTO>[];
export function mapDriverToDriverDtoSelective(
  driverOrDrivers: Driver | Driver[],
  keys?: (keyof DriverDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<DriverDTO> | Partial<DriverDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (driver: Driver): Partial<DriverDTO> => {
    const resultDto: Partial<DriverDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedDriverDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      (allowedDriverDtoKeys as Array<keyof DriverDTO | keyof BaseDTO>).includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in driver && driver[key as keyof Driver] !== undefined) {
        (resultDto as any)[key] = driver[key as keyof Driver];
      }
    });

    return resultDto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(driverOrDrivers)
    ? driverOrDrivers.map(mapSingle)
    : mapSingle(driverOrDrivers);
}

export const mapCreateDriverDtoToEntity = async (dto: CreateDriverDTO): Promise<Driver> => {
  const driver = new Driver();
  driver.licenseNumber = dto.licenseNumber;
  driver.licenseExpiryDate = dto.licenseExpiryDate;
  driver.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  driver.user = await mapUserCreateDtoToEntity(dto.user); // ✅ await async function

  return driver;
};

export const mapUpdateDriverDtoToEntity = async (dto: UpdateDriverDTO): Promise<Driver> => {
  const driver = new Driver();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) driver.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.licenseNumber !== undefined) driver.licenseNumber = dto.licenseNumber;
  if (dto.licenseExpiryDate !== undefined) driver.licenseExpiryDate = dto.licenseExpiryDate;
  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) driver.createdAt = dto.createdAt;
  if (dto.user !== undefined) driver.user = await mapUserUpdateDtoToEntity(dto.user);

  return driver;
};
