===== FILE 129: src\app\modules\driver\driver.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Driver } from './driver.entity';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { DriverDTO } from './dtos/driver.dto';
import { UpdateDriverDTO } from './dtos/update-driver.dto';
import { generateUniqueCode, generateUniqueUsername } from 'src/core/utils/generator';
import { User } from '../user/user.entity';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';

@Injectable()
export class DriverService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Driver)
    private driverRepository: Repository<Driver>,

    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<DriverDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.driverRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<UpdateDriverDTO>): Promise<DriverDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.driverRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<UpdateDriverDTO>): Promise<Driver | undefined> {
    const result = await this.driverRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<DriverDTO>): Promise<[Driver[], number]> {
    const resultList = await this.driverRepository.findAndCount(options);
    return resultList;
  }

  async save(driver: Driver, creator?: string): Promise<Driver> {
    // Auto-generate user code if not already assigned
    if (driver.user && !driver.user.code) {
      driver.user.code = await generateUniqueCode(this.userRepository, driver.user.role);
    }

    if (driver.user && driver.user.role === UserRole.DRIVER) {
      driver.user.username = await generateUniqueUsername(this.userRepository, UserRole.DRIVER);
    }

    if (driver.user && driver.user.role === UserRole.DRIVER_ASSISTANT) {
      driver.user.username = await generateUniqueUsername(
        this.userRepository,
        UserRole.DRIVER_ASSISTANT,
      );
    }

    // Automatically handle metadata fields
    const now = new Date();
    driver.createdAt = driver.createdAt ?? now;
    driver.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      driver.createdBy = driver.createdBy ?? creator;
      driver.updatedBy = creator;

      if (driver.user) {
        driver.user.createdBy = driver.user.createdBy ?? creator;
        driver.user.updatedBy = creator;
        driver.user.createdAt = driver.createdAt;
      }
    }

    // Save both driver and nested user
    const savedDriver = await this.driverRepository.save(driver);
    return savedDriver;
  }

  async update(driver: Driver, updater?: string): Promise<Driver> {
    const now = new Date();

    // Handle updater metadata
    if (updater) {
      driver.updatedBy = updater;
      if (driver.user) driver.user.updatedBy = updater;
    }

    driver.updatedAt = now;
    if (driver.user) driver.user.updatedAt = now;

    const updatedDriver = await this.driverRepository.save(driver);
    return updatedDriver;
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.driverRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

@Controller('api/employees')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('employees-module')
export class EmployeeController {
  logger = new Logger('EmployeeController');

  constructor(
    private readonly employeeService: EmployeeService,
    private readonly userService: UserService,
    private readonly branchService: BranchService,
  ) {}

  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get the list of employees paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List all employees',
    type: EmployeeDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAllEmployees(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: EmployeeQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<UpdateEmployeeDTO[]> {
    const pageRequest: PageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const whereConditions: FindOptionsWhere<Employee> = {};
    if (query.branchId) {
      whereConditions.branch = { id: query.branchId };
    }

    const [results, count] = await this.employeeService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      relations: ['user', 'user.contacts', 'user.salary'],
      where: whereConditions,
    });

    const employeeDtos = mapEmployeeToEmployeeDtoSelective(results, ['id', 'custody', 'user']);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return employeeDtos;
  }

  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get employee by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Employee found', type: EmployeeDTO })
  async getEmployeeById(@Param('id') id: number): Promise<UpdateEmployeeDTO> {
    const existing = await this.employeeService.find({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['user', 'user.contacts', 'user.salary', 'user.attachments'],
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Employee with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapEmployeeToEmployeeDtoSelective(existing, ['id', 'custody', 'user']);
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new employee' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: EmployeeDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateEmployeeDTO, @AuthUser() user: UserDTO): Promise<EmployeeDTO> {
    if (dto.user.email) {
      const emailCheck = await this.userService.findByFields({
        where: { email: dto.user.email },
      });

      if (emailCheck) {
        throw new BadRequestException(`User with email ${dto.user.email} already exists`);
      }
    }

    const existing = await this.branchService.findByFields({
      where: { id: dto.branchId },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new BadRequestException(`Branch with id ${dto.branchId} does not exist`);
    }

    const mappedEmployee = await mapCreateEmployeeDtoToEntity(dto);

    mappedEmployee.user.role = UserRole.DATA_ENTRY;

    return this.employeeService.save(mappedEmployee, user?.email);
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update existing employee' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: EmployeeDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateEmployeeDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<UpdateEmployeeDTO> {
    // Fetch existing employee including the user relation
    const existing = await this.employeeService.findByFields({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['user'],
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Employee with id ${id} not found`);
    }

    // Ensure the employee has an associated user
    if (!existing.user) {
      throw new BadRequestException(`Employee with id ${id} does not have an associated user`);
    }

    dto.id = id; // assign id to DTO for mapping

    // Check for username uniqueness
    if (dto.user?.username) {
      const existingUser = await this.userService.findByFields({
        where: { username: dto.user.username },
      });
      if (existingUser && existing.user.id !== existingUser.id) {
        throw new BadRequestException(`User with username ${dto.user.username} already exists`);
      }
    }

    // Check for email uniqueness
    if (dto.user?.email) {
      const emailCheck = await this.userService.findByFields({
        where: { email: dto.user.email },
      });
      if (emailCheck && existing.user.id !== emailCheck.id) {
        throw new BadRequestException(`User with email ${dto.user.email} already exists`);
      }
    }

    // Assign the existing user's ID to the DTO to update the correct record
    if (dto.user) {
      dto.user.id = existing.user.id;
    }

    // Map DTO to entity
    const mappedEmployee = await mapUpdateEmployeeDtoToEntity(dto);

    // Update the employee and nested user
    return this.employeeService.update(mappedEmployee, user?.email);
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete employee' })
  async delete(@Param('id') id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.employeeService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Employee with id ${id} not found`);
    await this.employeeService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

===== FILE 136: src\app\modules\employee\employee.mapper.ts =====

import { mapUserCreateDtoToEntity, mapUserUpdateDtoToEntity } from '../user/user.mapper';
import { Employee } from './employee.entity';
import { CreateEmployeeDTO } from './dtos/create-employee.dto';
import { EmployeeDTO } from './dtos/employee.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { UpdateEmployeeDTO } from './dtos/update-employee.dto';
import { Branch } from '../branch/branch.entity';

const allowedEmployeeDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof EmployeeDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
  'user',
];

export function mapEmployeeToEmployeeDtoSelective(
  employee: Employee,
  keys?: (keyof EmployeeDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<EmployeeDTO>;
export function mapEmployeeToEmployeeDtoSelective(
  employees: Employee[],
  keys?: (keyof EmployeeDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<EmployeeDTO>[];
export function mapEmployeeToEmployeeDtoSelective(
  employeeOrEmployees: Employee | Employee[],
  keys?: (keyof EmployeeDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<EmployeeDTO> | Partial<EmployeeDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (employee: Employee): Partial<EmployeeDTO> => {
    const resultDto: Partial<EmployeeDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedEmployeeDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      (allowedEmployeeDtoKeys as Array<keyof EmployeeDTO | keyof BaseDTO>).includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in employee && employee[key as keyof Employee] !== undefined) {
        (resultDto as any)[key] = employee[key as keyof Employee];
      }
    });

    return resultDto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(employeeOrEmployees)
    ? employeeOrEmployees.map(mapSingle)
    : mapSingle(employeeOrEmployees);
}

export const mapCreateEmployeeDtoToEntity = async (dto: CreateEmployeeDTO): Promise<Employee> => {
  const employee = new Employee();
  employee.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  // Map nested user
  employee.user = await mapUserCreateDtoToEntity(dto.user);

  if (dto.branchId !== undefined) {
    const branch = new Branch();
    branch.id = dto.branchId;
    employee.branch = branch;
  }

  return employee;
};

export const mapUpdateEmployeeDtoToEntity = async (dto: UpdateEmployeeDTO): Promise<Employee> => {
  const employee = new Employee();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) employee.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) employee.createdAt = dto.createdAt;
  if (dto.user !== undefined) employee.user = await mapUserUpdateDtoToEntity(dto.user);
  // Map branch from branchId if provided
  if (dto.branch !== undefined) {
    const branch = new Branch();
    branch.id = dto.branch.id;
    employee.branch = branch;
  }

  return employee;
};

===== FILE 138: src\app\modules\employee\employee.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Employee } from './employee.entity';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { EmployeeDTO } from './dtos/employee.dto';
import { UpdateEmployeeDTO } from './dtos/update-employee.dto';
import { generateUniqueCode, generateUniqueUsername } from 'src/core/utils/generator';
import { User } from '../user/user.entity';

@Injectable()
export class EmployeeService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Employee)
    private employeeRepository: Repository<Employee>,

    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<Employee>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<EmployeeDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.employeeRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<UpdateEmployeeDTO>): Promise<EmployeeDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.employeeRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<UpdateEmployeeDTO>): Promise<Employee | undefined> {
    const result = await this.employeeRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<EmployeeDTO>): Promise<[Employee[], number]> {
    const resultList = await this.employeeRepository.findAndCount(options);
    return resultList;
  }

  async save(employee: Employee, creator?: string): Promise<Employee> {
    // Auto-generate user code if not already assigned
    if (employee.user && !employee.user.code) {
      employee.user.code = await generateUniqueCode(this.userRepository, employee.user.role);
    }

    if (employee.user) {
      employee.user.username = await generateUniqueUsername(
        this.userRepository,
        employee.user.role,
      );
    }

    // Automatically handle metadata fields
    const now = new Date();
    employee.createdAt = employee.createdAt ?? now;
    employee.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      employee.createdBy = employee.createdBy ?? creator;
      employee.updatedBy = creator;

      if (employee.user) {
        employee.user.createdBy = employee.user.createdBy ?? creator;
        employee.user.updatedBy = creator;
        employee.user.createdAt = employee.createdAt;
      }
    }

    // Save both employee and nested user
    const savedEmployee = await this.employeeRepository.save(employee);
    return savedEmployee;
  }

  async update(employee: Employee, updater?: string): Promise<Employee> {
    const now = new Date();

    // Handle updater metadata
    if (updater) {
      employee.updatedBy = updater;
      if (employee.user) employee.user.updatedBy = updater;
    }

    employee.updatedAt = now;
    if (employee.user) employee.user.updatedAt = now;

    const updatedEmployee = await this.employeeRepository.save(employee);
    return updatedEmployee;
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.employeeRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

import {
  Controller,

  Post,
  Put,

  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  Get,
  Req,
  Query,
  ParseIntPipe,

} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { ExpenseService } from './expense.service';
import {
  CreateExpenseDTO,
  ExpenseDTO,
  ExpenseQueryDTO,
  UpdateExpenseDTO,
} from './dtos/expense.dto';
import {
  mapCreateExpenseDtoToEntity,
  mapExpenseToExpenseDtoSelective,
  mapUpdateExpenseDtoToEntity,
} from './expense.mapper';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';
import { FindOptionsWhere } from 'typeorm';
import { Expense } from './expense.entity';

@Controller('api/expenses')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('expenses-module')
export class ExpensesController {
  logger = new Logger('ExpensesController');

  constructor(private readonly expenseService: ExpenseService) {}

  // =========================
  // GET ALL (PAGINATED)
  // =========================
  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get the list of expenses paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List all expenses',
    type: ExpenseDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAllExpenses(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: ExpenseQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<ExpenseDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest: PageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const whereConditions: FindOptionsWhere<Expense> = {};

    if (query.employeeId) {
      whereConditions.employee = { id: query.employeeId };
    }
    if (query.carId) {
      whereConditions.car = { id: query.carId };
    }
    if (query.type) {
      whereConditions.type = query.type;
    }

    const [results, count] = await this.expenseService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      relations: ['employee', 'car', 'expenseAttachments'],
      where: whereConditions,
    });

    const expenseDtos = mapExpenseToExpenseDtoSelective(results, undefined, true, true, true);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return expenseDtos;
  }

  // =========================
  // GET BY ID
  // =========================
  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get expense by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Expense found', type: ExpenseDTO })
  async getExpenseById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<Partial<ExpenseDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.expenseService.findById(id);

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Expense with id ${id} not found`);
    }

    return mapExpenseToExpenseDtoSelective(existing, undefined, true, true, true);
  }

  // =========================
  // CREATE
  // =========================
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new expense' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: ExpenseDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateExpenseDTO, @AuthUser() user: UserDTO): Promise<ExpenseDTO> {
    if (!dto.type) {
      throw new BadRequestException('type is required');
    }

    // Validate foreign keys exist before attempting to save
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-call
    await this.expenseService.validateCarId((dto as any).carId);
    await this.expenseService.validateEmployeeId((dto as any).employeeId);
    await this.expenseService.validateJourneyId((dto as any).journeyId);

    const mappedExpense = mapCreateExpenseDtoToEntity(dto);

    const savedExpense = await this.expenseService.save(mappedExpense, user?.email);

    return mapExpenseToExpenseDtoSelective(savedExpense, undefined, true, true, true) as ExpenseDTO;
  }

  // =========================
  // UPDATE
  // =========================
  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update existing expense' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: ExpenseDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateExpenseDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<ExpenseDTO> {
    const existing = await this.expenseService.findByFields({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['employee', 'car', 'expenseAttachments'],
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Expense with id ${id} not found`);
    }

    // Validate foreign keys exist before attempting to update
    await this.expenseService.validateCarId((dto as any).carId);
    await this.expenseService.validateEmployeeId((dto as any).employeeId);
    await this.expenseService.validateJourneyId((dto as any).journeyId);

    const mappedExpense = mapUpdateExpenseDtoToEntity(dto, existing);
    const updated = await this.expenseService.update(mappedExpense, user?.email);
    return mapExpenseToExpenseDtoSelective(updated, undefined, true, true, true) as ExpenseDTO;
  }

  // =========================
  // DELETE
  // =========================
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete expense' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.expenseService.findById(id);

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Expense with id ${id} not found`);
    }

    await this.expenseService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

  p1: boolean,
  p2: boolean,
  options: { includeJourney?: boolean; includeEmployee?: boolean; includeCar?: boolean } = {},
  keys?: (keyof ExpenseDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<ExpenseDTO> | Partial<ExpenseDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (expense: Expense | ExpenseDTO): Partial<ExpenseDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<ExpenseDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedExpenseDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedExpenseDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      const value = (expense as any)[key];
      if (value === undefined) return;

      if ((key === 'date' || key === 'expiryDate') && value instanceof Date) {
        (dto as any)[key] = value.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        return;
      }

      if (key === 'amount') {
        const numericAmount = typeof value === 'string' ? Number(value) : value;
        (dto as any).amount = Number.isFinite(numericAmount) ? numericAmount : undefined;
        return;
      }

      if (key === 'unitPrice' || key === 'quantity') {
        const numericValue = typeof value === 'string' ? Number(value) : value;
        (dto as any)[key] = Number.isFinite(numericValue) ? numericValue : value;
        return;
      }

      (dto as any)[key] = value;
    });

    if (options.includeEmployee && expense.employee) dto.employee = expense.employee;
    if (options.includeCar && expense.car) dto.car = expense.car;

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(expenseOrList) ? expenseOrList.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(expenseOrList);
}

function createExpenseEntityByType(type: ExpenseType): Expense {
  switch (type) {
    case ExpenseType.MAINTENANCE:
      return new MaintenanceExpense();
    case ExpenseType.UTILITY:
      return new UtilityExpense();
    case ExpenseType.TAX_FEE:
      return new TaxFeeExpense();
    case ExpenseType.EXCEPTIONAL:
      return new ExceptionalExpense();
    case ExpenseType.INCENTIVE:
      return new IncentiveExpense();
    case ExpenseType.CUSTODY:
      return new CustodyExpense();
    case ExpenseType.PENALTY:
      return new PenaltyExpense();
    default:
      return new Expense();
  }
}

function mapCommonExpenseFields(target: Expense, dto: CreateExpenseDTO | UpdateExpenseDTO): void {
  if (dto.amount !== undefined) target.amount = dto.amount?.toString();
  if (dto.date !== undefined) target.date = dto.date;
  if (dto.monthlyRecurring !== undefined) target.monthlyRecurring = dto.monthlyRecurring;
  if (dto.transactionType !== undefined) target.transactionType = dto.transactionType;
  if (dto.notes !== undefined) target.notes = dto.notes;
  if ((dto as any).description && !dto.notes) target.notes = (dto as any).description;

  if ((dto as any).employeeId !== undefined) {
    const employeeId = (dto as any).employeeId as number | undefined;
    if (employeeId) {
      const employee = new Employee();
      employee.id = employeeId;
      target.employee = employee;
    } else {
      target.employee = null;
    }
  }

  if ((dto as any).carId !== undefined) {
    const carId = (dto as any).carId as number | undefined;
    if (carId) {
      const car = new Car();
      car.id = carId;
      target.car = car;
    } else {
      target.car = null;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * CREATE MAPPER
 */
export const mapCreateExpenseDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateExpenseDTO): Expense => {
  const entity = createExpenseEntityByType(dto.type);
  entity.type = dto.type;

  mapCommonExpenseFields(entity, dto);

  switch (dto.type) {
    case ExpenseType.MAINTENANCE: {
      const maintenance = entity as MaintenanceExpense;
      maintenance.maintenanceType = dto.maintenanceType!;
      maintenance.center = dto.center!;
      maintenance.partName = dto.partName!;
      maintenance.partSource = dto.partSource;
      maintenance.unitPrice =
        dto.unitPrice !== undefined && dto.unitPrice !== null ? dto.unitPrice.toString() : null;
      maintenance.quantity =
        dto.quantity !== undefined && dto.quantity !== null ? dto.quantity.toString() : null;
      maintenance.consumable = dto.consumable ?? false;
      break;
    }
    case ExpenseType.UTILITY: {
      const utility = entity as UtilityExpense;
      utility.serviceType = dto.serviceType!;
      utility.place = dto.place!;
      break;
    }
    case ExpenseType.TAX_FEE: {
      const tax = entity as TaxFeeExpense;
      tax.feeType = dto.feeType!;
      tax.expiryDate = dto.expiryDate ? new Date(dto.expiryDate) : undefined;
      break;
    }
    case ExpenseType.EXCEPTIONAL: {
      const exceptional = entity as ExceptionalExpense;
      exceptional.subType = dto.subType!;
      exceptional.beneficiary = dto.beneficiary!;
      break;
    }
  }

  return entity;
};

/**
 * UPDATE MAPPER
 */
export const mapUpdateExpenseDtoToEntity = (dto: UpdateExpenseDTO, existing: Expense): Expense => {
  // Keep the existing instance (and subtype) to avoid discriminator/type conflicts.
  mapCommonExpenseFields(existing, dto);

  // subtype updates (only if fields provided)
  switch (existing.type) {
    case ExpenseType.MAINTENANCE: {
      const maintenance = existing as MaintenanceExpense;
      if (dto.maintenanceType !== undefined) maintenance.maintenanceType = dto.maintenanceType;
      if (dto.center !== undefined) maintenance.center = dto.center;
      if (dto.partName !== undefined) maintenance.partName = dto.partName;
      if (dto.partSource !== undefined) maintenance.partSource = dto.partSource;
      if (dto.unitPrice !== undefined)
        maintenance.unitPrice = dto.unitPrice !== null ? dto.unitPrice.toString() : null;
      if (dto.quantity !== undefined)
        maintenance.quantity = dto.quantity !== null ? dto.quantity.toString() : null;
      if (dto.consumable !== undefined) maintenance.consumable = dto.consumable;
      break;
    }
    case ExpenseType.UTILITY: {
      const utility = existing as UtilityExpense;
      if (dto.serviceType !== undefined) utility.serviceType = dto.serviceType;
      if (dto.place !== undefined) utility.place = dto.place;
      break;
    }
    case ExpenseType.TAX_FEE: {
      const tax = existing as TaxFeeExpense;
      if (dto.feeType !== undefined) tax.feeType = dto.feeType;
      if (dto.expiryDate !== undefined)
        tax.expiryDate = dto.expiryDate ? new Date(dto.expiryDate) : undefined;
      break;
    }
    case ExpenseType.EXCEPTIONAL: {
      const exceptional = existing as ExceptionalExpense;
      if (dto.subType !== undefined) exceptional.subType = dto.subType;
      if (dto.beneficiary !== undefined) exceptional.beneficiary = dto.beneficiary;
      break;
    }
  }

  return existing;
};

import { Injectable, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { Expense } from './expense.entity';
import { Car } from '../car/car.entity';
import { Employee } from '../employee/employee.entity';
import { Journey } from '../journey/journey.entity';

@Injectable()
export class ExpenseService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Expense)
    private readonly expenseRepo: Repository<Expense>,
    @InjectRepository(Car)
    private readonly carRepo: Repository<Car>,
    @InjectRepository(Employee)
    private readonly employeeRepo: Repository<Employee>,
    @InjectRepository(Journey)
    private readonly journeyRepo: Repository<Journey>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<Expense | null> {
    return this.expenseRepo.findOne({ where: { id } });
  }

  async findOne(options: FindOneOptions<Expense>): Promise<Expense | null> {
    return this.expenseRepo.findOne(options);
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<Expense>): Promise<Expense | null> {
    return this.expenseRepo.findOne(options);
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<Expense>): Promise<[Expense[], number]> {
    return this.expenseRepo.findAndCount(options);
  }

  // Validation methods for foreign keys
  async validateCarId(carId: number | undefined | null): Promise<void> {
    if (!carId) return; // Optional field
    const car = await this.carRepo.findOne({ where: { id: carId } });
    if (!car) {
      throw new BadRequestException(`Car with ID ${carId} not found`);
    }
  }

  async validateEmployeeId(employeeId: number | undefined | null): Promise<void> {
    if (!employeeId) return; // Optional field
    const employee = await this.employeeRepo.findOne({ where: { id: employeeId } });
    if (!employee) {
      throw new BadRequestException(`Employee with ID ${employeeId} not found`);
    }
  }

  async validateJourneyId(journeyId: number | undefined | null): Promise<void> {
    if (!journeyId) return; // Optional field
    const journey = await this.journeyRepo.findOne({ where: { id: journeyId } });
    if (!journey) {
      throw new BadRequestException(`Journey with ID ${journeyId} not found`);
    }
  }

  async save(expense: Expense, creator?: string): Promise<Expense> {
    const now = new Date();
    expense.createdAt = expense.createdAt ?? now;
    expense.updatedAt = now;
    if (creator) {
      expense.createdBy = expense.createdBy ?? creator;
      expense.updatedBy = creator;
    }
    return this.expenseRepo.save(expense);
  }

  async update(expense: Expense, updater?: string): Promise<Expense> {
    const now = new Date();
    expense.updatedAt = now;
    if (updater) expense.updatedBy = updater;
    return this.expenseRepo.save(expense);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.expenseRepo.delete(id);
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  Get,
  ParseIntPipe,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';

import { ExpenseAttachmentService } from './expense-attachment.service';
import { ExpenseService } from '../expense/expense.service';

import { ExpenseAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/expense-attachment.dto';
import { CreateExpenseAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/create-expense-attachment.dto';
import { UpdateExpenseAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/update-expense-attachment.dto';

import {
  mapExpenseAttachmentToDtoSelective,
  mapCreateExpenseAttachmentDtoToEntity,
  mapUpdateExpenseAttachmentDtoToEntity,
} from './expense-attachment.mapper';

@Controller('api/expense-attachments')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('expense-attachments-module')
export class ExpenseAttachmentController {
  logger = new Logger('ExpenseAttachmentController');

  constructor(
    private readonly attachmentService: ExpenseAttachmentService,
    private readonly expenseService: ExpenseService,
  ) {}

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET BY ID
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get expense attachment by ID' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Expense attachment found', type: ExpenseAttachmentDTO })
  async getById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<Partial<ExpenseAttachmentDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Expense attachment with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapExpenseAttachmentToDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'expense',
      'url',
      'type',
      'notes',
      'documentExpiryDate',
      'createdAt',
      'createdBy',
    ]);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new expense attachment' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: 'Expense attachment created',
    type: ExpenseAttachmentDTO,
  })
  async create(
    @Body() dto: CreateExpenseAttachmentDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<ExpenseAttachmentDTO>> {
    const expense = await this.expenseService.findByFields({ where: { id: dto.expenseId } });
    if (!expense) throw new NotFoundException(`Expense with id ${dto.expenseId} not found`);

    const mapped = mapCreateExpenseAttachmentDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.attachmentService.save(mapped, user?.email);

    return mapExpenseAttachmentToDtoSelective(saved);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update expense attachment' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Expense attachment updated',
    type: ExpenseAttachmentDTO,
  })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateExpenseAttachmentDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<ExpenseAttachmentDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Expense attachment with id ${id} not found`);

    dto.id = id;
    const mapped = mapUpdateExpenseAttachmentDtoToEntity(dto);
    const updated = await this.attachmentService.update(mapped, user?.email);

    return mapExpenseAttachmentToDtoSelective(updated);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete expense attachment' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Expense attachment with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.attachmentService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

import { ExpenseAttachment } from './expense-attachment.entity';
import { CreateExpenseAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/create-expense-attachment.dto';
import { ExpenseAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/expense-attachment.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { UpdateExpenseAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/update-expense-attachment.dto';
import { Expense } from '../expense/expense.entity';

const allowedExpenseAttachmentDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof ExpenseAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'expense',
  'url',
  'type',
  'notes',
  'documentExpiryDate',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
];

export function mapExpenseAttachmentToDtoSelective(
  attachment: ExpenseAttachment | ExpenseAttachmentDTO,
  keys?: (keyof ExpenseAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<ExpenseAttachmentDTO>;

export function mapExpenseAttachmentToDtoSelective(
  attachments: (ExpenseAttachment | ExpenseAttachmentDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof ExpenseAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<ExpenseAttachmentDTO>[];

export function mapExpenseAttachmentToDtoSelective(
  attachmentOrAttachments:
    | ExpenseAttachment
    | ExpenseAttachmentDTO
    | (ExpenseAttachment | ExpenseAttachmentDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof ExpenseAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<ExpenseAttachmentDTO> | Partial<ExpenseAttachmentDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (
    attachment: ExpenseAttachment | ExpenseAttachmentDTO,
  ): Partial<ExpenseAttachmentDTO> => {
    const resultDto: Partial<ExpenseAttachmentDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedExpenseAttachmentDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedExpenseAttachmentDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      const value = (attachment as any)[key];
      if (value !== undefined) {
        (resultDto as any)[key] = value;
      }
    });

    return resultDto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(attachmentOrAttachments)
    ? attachmentOrAttachments.map(mapSingle)
    : mapSingle(attachmentOrAttachments);
}

export const mapCreateExpenseAttachmentDtoToEntity = (
  dto: CreateExpenseAttachmentDTO,
): ExpenseAttachment => {
  const attachment = new ExpenseAttachment();

  if (dto.expenseId) {
    attachment.expense = new Expense();
    attachment.expense.id = dto.expenseId;
  }

  attachment.url = dto.url;
  attachment.type = dto.type;
  attachment.notes = dto.notes;
  attachment.documentExpiryDate = dto.documentExpiryDate;
  attachment.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return attachment;
};

export const mapUpdateExpenseAttachmentDtoToEntity = (
  dto: UpdateExpenseAttachmentDTO,
): ExpenseAttachment => {
  const attachment = new ExpenseAttachment();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) attachment.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.url !== undefined) attachment.url = dto.url;
  if (dto.type !== undefined) attachment.type = dto.type;
  if (dto.notes !== undefined) attachment.notes = dto.notes;
  if (dto.documentExpiryDate !== undefined) attachment.documentExpiryDate = dto.documentExpiryDate;

  return attachment;
};

===== FILE 160: src\app\modules\expense-attachment\expense-attachment.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { ExpenseAttachment } from './expense-attachment.entity';
import { UpdateExpenseAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/update-expense-attachment.dto';

@Injectable()
export class ExpenseAttachmentService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(ExpenseAttachment)
    private attachmentRepository: Repository<ExpenseAttachment>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<ExpenseAttachment | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(
    options: FindOneOptions<UpdateExpenseAttachmentDTO>,
  ): Promise<ExpenseAttachment | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(
    options: FindManyOptions<UpdateExpenseAttachmentDTO>,
  ): Promise<ExpenseAttachment | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async save(attachment: ExpenseAttachment, creator?: string): Promise<ExpenseAttachment> {
    const now = new Date();
    attachment.createdAt = attachment.createdAt ?? now;
    attachment.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      attachment.createdBy = attachment.createdBy ?? creator;
      attachment.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.attachmentRepository.save(attachment);
  }

  async update(attachment: ExpenseAttachment, updater?: string): Promise<ExpenseAttachment> {
    const now = new Date();

    if (updater) {
      attachment.updatedBy = updater;
    }

    attachment.updatedAt = now;

    return await this.attachmentRepository.save(attachment);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.attachmentRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 164: src\app\modules\factory\client.controller.ts =====

import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  Get,
  Req,
  Query,
  ParseIntPipe,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';

import { ClientService } from './client.service';
import { ClientDTO } from './dtos/client.dto';
import { CreateClientDTO } from './dtos/create-client.dto';
import { UpdateClientDTO } from './dtos/update-client.dto';

import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';

import {
  mapCreateClientDtoToEntity,
  mapClientToClientDtoSelective,
  mapUpdateClientDtoToEntity,
} from './client.mapper';

import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';
import { ClientQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-client.dto';

@Controller('api/clients')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('clients-module')
export class ClientController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('ClientController');

  constructor(private readonly clientService: ClientService) {}

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET ALL (paginated)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of clients paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List of clients',
    type: ClientDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAllClients(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: ClientQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<ClientDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const [results, count] = await this.clientService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
    });

    const dtos = mapClientToClientDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'commercialRecord',
      'taxInvoice',
      'companyCode',
      'destinationsFile',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET BY ID
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get client by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Client found', type: ClientDTO })
  async getClientById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<ClientDTO> {
    const existing = await this.clientService.findByFields({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Client with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapClientToClientDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'commercialRecord',
      'taxInvoice',
      'companyCode',
      'destinationsFile',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]) as ClientDTO;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new client' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: ClientDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateClientDTO, @AuthUser() user: UserDTO): Promise<ClientDTO> {
    const existing = await this.clientService.findByFields({
      where: { commercialRecord: dto.commercialRecord },
    });

    if (existing)
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Client with commercial record ${dto.commercialRecord} already exists`,
      );

    const entity = mapCreateClientDtoToEntity(dto);
    return this.clientService.save(entity, user?.email);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update client' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: ClientDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateClientDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<ClientDTO> {
    const existing = await this.clientService.findByFields({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Client with id ${id} not found`);

    dto.id = id;

    // Check duplicate Commercial Record
    if (dto.commercialRecord) {
      const existingCR = await this.clientService.findByFields({
        where: { commercialRecord: dto.commercialRecord },
      });

      if (existingCR && existingCR.id !== id) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Client with commercial record ${dto.commercialRecord} already exists`,
        );
      }
    }

    const entity = mapUpdateClientDtoToEntity(dto);
    return this.clientService.update(entity, user?.email);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete client' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.clientService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Client with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.clientService.delete(id);
  }
}

import { BaseEntity } from 'src/core/utils/base.entity';

@Entity('clients')
@Index(['name'], { unique: true })
export class Client extends BaseEntity {
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 255, nullable: false })
  name: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100, nullable: false })
  commercialRecord: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 150, nullable: true })
  taxInvoice?: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100, nullable: true })
  companyCode: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 255, nullable: true })
  destinationsFile?: string;

  @OneToMany(() => DeliveryPrice, (price) => price.client, { cascade: ['insert', 'update'] })

===== FILE 166: src\app\modules\factory\client.mapper.ts =====

import { Client } from './client.entity';
import { ClientDTO } from './dtos/client.dto';
import { CreateClientDTO } from './dtos/create-client.dto';
import { UpdateClientDTO } from './dtos/update-client.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';

/**
 * Allowed keys for selective DTO mapping
 */
const allowedClientDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof ClientDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'name',
  'commercialRecord',
  'taxInvoice',
  'destinationsFile',
  'companyCode',

  // base dto fields
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
] as const;

/**
 * Selective mapper: maps Client → ClientDTO (single or array)
 */
export function mapClientToClientDtoSelective(
  client: Client,
  keys?: (keyof ClientDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<ClientDTO>;

export function mapClientToClientDtoSelective(
  clients: Client[],
  keys?: (keyof ClientDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<ClientDTO>[];

export function mapClientToClientDtoSelective(
  data: Client | Client[],
  keys?: (keyof ClientDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<ClientDTO> | Partial<ClientDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (client: Client): Partial<ClientDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<ClientDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedClientDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      (allowedClientDtoKeys as readonly string[]).includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in client && client[key as keyof Client] !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = client[key as keyof Client];
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(data) ? data.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(data);
}

/**
 * Create DTO → Entity
 */
export const mapCreateClientDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateClientDTO): Client => {
  const entity = new Client();

  entity.name = dto.name;
  entity.commercialRecord = dto.commercialRecord;
  entity.taxInvoice = dto.taxInvoice;
  entity.companyCode = dto.companyCode;
  entity.destinationsFile = dto.destinationsFile;

  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) entity.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return entity;
};

/**
 * Update DTO → Entity
 */
export const mapUpdateClientDtoToEntity = (dto: UpdateClientDTO): Client => {
  const entity = new Client();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) entity.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.name !== undefined) entity.name = dto.name;
  if (dto.commercialRecord !== undefined) entity.commercialRecord = dto.commercialRecord;
  if (dto.taxInvoice !== undefined) entity.taxInvoice = dto.taxInvoice;
  if (dto.companyCode !== undefined) entity.companyCode = dto.companyCode;
  if (dto.destinationsFile !== undefined) entity.destinationsFile = dto.destinationsFile;

  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) entity.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return entity;
};

===== FILE 168: src\app\modules\factory\client.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Client } from './client.entity';
import { Repository, FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions } from 'typeorm';

@Injectable()
export class ClientService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Client)
    private readonly clientRepository: Repository<Client>,
  ) {}

  // -------------------------------------------------------
  // FIND BY ID
  // -------------------------------------------------------
  async findById(id: number): Promise<Client | undefined> {
    const result = await this.clientRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------
  // GENERIC FIND ONE
  // -------------------------------------------------------
  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<Client>): Promise<Client | undefined> {
    const result = await this.clientRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------
  // GENERIC FIND MANY
  // -------------------------------------------------------
  async find(options: FindManyOptions<Client>): Promise<Client[] | undefined> {
    const result = await this.clientRepository.find(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------
  // PAGINATED FIND + COUNT
  // -------------------------------------------------------
  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<Client>): Promise<[Client[], number]> {
    return this.clientRepository.findAndCount(options);
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // -------------------------------------------------------
  async save(client: Client, creator?: string): Promise<Client> {
    const now = new Date();

    client.createdAt = client.createdAt ?? now;
    client.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      client.createdBy = client.createdBy ?? creator;
      client.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.clientRepository.save(client);
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE
  // -------------------------------------------------------
  async update(client: Client, updater?: string): Promise<Client> {
    const now = new Date();

    client.updatedAt = now;
    if (updater) client.updatedBy = updater;

    return await this.clientRepository.save(client);
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // -------------------------------------------------------
  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.clientRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

  async getGovernmentById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<GovernmentDTO> {
    const existing = await this.governmentService.findByFields({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Government with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapGovernmentToGovernmentDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]) as GovernmentDTO;
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new government' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: GovernmentDTO })
  async create(
    @Body() dto: CreateGovernmentDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<GovernmentDTO> {
    const existing = await this.governmentService.findByFields({ where: { name: dto.name } });
    if (existing) throw new BadRequestException(`Government with name ${dto.name} already exists`);

    const entity = mapCreateGovernmentDtoToEntity(dto);
    return this.governmentService.save(entity, user?.email);
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update government' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: GovernmentDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateGovernmentDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<GovernmentDTO> {
    const existing = await this.governmentService.findByFields({ where: { id } });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Government with id ${id} not found`);

    dto.id = id;

    if (dto.name) {
      const existingByName = await this.governmentService.findByFields({
        where: { name: dto.name },
      });
      if (existingByName && existingByName.id !== id) {
        throw new BadRequestException(`Government with name ${dto.name} already exists`);
      }
    }

    const entity = mapUpdateGovernmentDtoToEntity(dto);
    return this.governmentService.update(entity, user?.email);
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete government' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.governmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Government with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.governmentService.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 175: src\app\modules\government\government.mapper.ts =====

import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { Government } from './government.entity';
import { GovernmentDTO } from './dtos/government.dto';
import { CreateGovernmentDTO } from './dtos/create-government.dto';
import { UpdateGovernmentDTO } from './dtos/update-government.dto';

const allowedGovernmentDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof GovernmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'name',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
] as const;

export function mapGovernmentToGovernmentDtoSelective(
  government: Government,
  keys?: (keyof GovernmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<GovernmentDTO>;

export function mapGovernmentToGovernmentDtoSelective(
  governments: Government[],
  keys?: (keyof GovernmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<GovernmentDTO>[];

export function mapGovernmentToGovernmentDtoSelective(
  data: Government | Government[],
  keys?: (keyof GovernmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<GovernmentDTO> | Partial<GovernmentDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (government: Government): Partial<GovernmentDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<GovernmentDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedGovernmentDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      (allowedGovernmentDtoKeys as readonly string[]).includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in government && government[key as keyof Government] !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = government[key as keyof Government];
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(data) ? data.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(data);
}

export const mapCreateGovernmentDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateGovernmentDTO): Government => {
  const entity = new Government();

  entity.name = dto.name;

  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) entity.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return entity;
};

export const mapUpdateGovernmentDtoToEntity = (dto: UpdateGovernmentDTO): Government => {
  const entity = new Government();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) entity.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.name !== undefined) entity.name = dto.name;

  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) entity.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return entity;
};

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { Government } from './government.entity';

@Injectable()
export class GovernmentService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Government)
    private readonly governmentRepository: Repository<Government>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<Government | undefined> {
    const result = await this.governmentRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<Government>): Promise<Government | undefined> {
    const result = await this.governmentRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<Government>): Promise<Government[] | undefined> {
    const result = await this.governmentRepository.find(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<Government>): Promise<[Government[], number]> {
    return this.governmentRepository.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(government: Government, creator?: string): Promise<Government> {
    const now = new Date();

    government.createdAt = government.createdAt ?? now;
    government.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      government.createdBy = government.createdBy ?? creator;
      government.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.governmentRepository.save(government);
  }

  async update(government: Government, updater?: string): Promise<Government> {
    const now = new Date();

    government.updatedAt = now;
    if (updater) government.updatedBy = updater;

    return await this.governmentRepository.save(government);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.governmentRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

import { UpdateGridsDTO } from './dtos/update-grids.dto';

import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  Get,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Query,
  Req,
  Put,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';

import { GridsService } from './grid.service';
import { GridsDTO } from './dtos/grids.dto';
import { CreateGridsDTO } from './dtos/create-grids.dto';
import { mapGridsToDtoSelective, mapCreateGridsDtoToEntity } from './grid.mapper';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { GridsQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-grids.dto';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';

@Controller('api/grids')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('grids-module')
export class GridsController {
  logger = new Logger('GridsController');

  constructor(private readonly gridsService: GridsService) {}

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET ALL (paginated)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of grids paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List of grids',
    type: GridsDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAll(@Req() req: Request, @Query() query: GridsQueryDTO): Promise<Partial<GridsDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const [results, count] = await this.gridsService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
    });

    const dtos = mapGridsToDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'user',
      'pageKey',
      'columns',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET by pageKey and user
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/by-page-key/:pageKey')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get grid by pageKey and user' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Grid found',
    type: GridsDTO,
  })
  async getByPageKey(
    @Param('pageKey') pageKey: string,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<GridsDTO>> {
    const grid = await this.gridsService.findByFields({
      where: { pageKey, user: { id: user.id } },
      relations: ['user'],
    });
    if (!grid) throw new NotFoundException('Grid not found for this user and pageKey');
    return mapGridsToDtoSelective(grid);
  }
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new grid' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: 'Grid created',
    type: GridsDTO,
  })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateGridsDTO, @AuthUser() user: any): Promise<Partial<GridsDTO>> {
    const mapped = mapCreateGridsDtoToEntity(dto, user);
    const saved = await this.gridsService.save(mapped, user?.email);
    return mapGridsToDtoSelective(saved);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE by pageKey and user
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Put('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update grid by pageKey and user' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Grid updated',
    type: GridsDTO,
  })
  async updateByPageKey(
    @Body() dto: UpdateGridsDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<GridsDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.gridsService.findByFields({
      where: { pageKey: dto.pageKey, user: { id: user.id } },
      relations: ['user'],
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Grid not found for this user and pageKey');
    if (dto.columns !== undefined) existing.columns = dto.columns;
    const updated = await this.gridsService.update(existing, user?.email);
    return mapGridsToDtoSelective(updated);
  }
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete grid' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.gridsService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Grid with id ${id} not found`);
    await this.gridsService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

import { UpdateGridsDTO } from './dtos/update-grids.dto';

import { Grids } from './grid.entity';
import { CreateGridsDTO } from './dtos/create-grids.dto';
import { GridsDTO } from './dtos/grids.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';

const allowedGridsDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof GridsDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'user',
  'pageKey',
  'columns',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
];

import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';

export function mapGridsToDtoSelective(
  grids: Grids | GridsDTO,
  keys?: (keyof GridsDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<GridsDTO>;

export function mapGridsToDtoSelective(
  gridsArr: (Grids | GridsDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof GridsDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<GridsDTO>[];

export function mapGridsToDtoSelective(
  gridsOrList: Grids | GridsDTO | (Grids | GridsDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof GridsDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<GridsDTO> | Partial<GridsDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (grids: Grids | GridsDTO): Partial<GridsDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<GridsDTO> = {};
    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedGridsDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedGridsDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );
    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      let value = (grids as any)[key];
      if (key === 'user' && value) {
        // Map user entity to UserDTO if needed
        value =
          value instanceof Object && !(value instanceof UserDTO)
            ? Object.assign(new UserDTO(), value)
            : value;
      }
      if (key === 'columns' && value && typeof value === 'string') {
        // If columns is stored as a string (should be JSON), parse it
        try {
          value = JSON.parse(value);
        } catch {
          value = [];
        }
      }
      if (value !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = value;
      }
    });
    return dto;
  };
  return Array.isArray(gridsOrList) ? gridsOrList.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(gridsOrList);
}

export const mapCreateGridsDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateGridsDTO, user: any): Grids => {
  const entity = new Grids();
  entity.user = user;
  entity.pageKey = dto.pageKey;
  entity.columns = dto.columns ?? [];

  entity.columns = dto.columns ?? [];
  return entity;
};
export const mapUpdateGridsDtoToEntity = (dto: UpdateGridsDTO, entity: Grids): Grids => {
  if (dto.columns !== undefined) entity.columns = dto.columns;
  // Add more fields as needed
  return entity;
};

    const updatedEntity = mapUpdateJourneyAttachmentDtoToEntity(dto, existing);

import { Column, Entity, Index, JoinColumn, ManyToOne } from 'typeorm';
import { BaseEntity } from 'src/core/utils/base.entity';

===== FILE 195: src\app\modules\journey-attachment\journey-attachment.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { JourneyAttachment } from './journey-attachment.entity';

@Injectable()
export class JourneyAttachmentService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(JourneyAttachment)
    private readonly repo: Repository<JourneyAttachment>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<JourneyAttachment | undefined> {
    return (await this.repo.findOne({ where: { id } })) ?? undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(
    options: FindOneOptions<JourneyAttachment>,
  ): Promise<JourneyAttachment | undefined> {
    return (await this.repo.findOne(options)) ?? undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<JourneyAttachment>): Promise<JourneyAttachment[]> {
    return await this.repo.find(options);
  }

  async findAndCount(
    options: FindManyOptions<JourneyAttachment>,
  ): Promise<[JourneyAttachment[], number]> {
    return await this.repo.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(entity: JourneyAttachment, creator?: string): Promise<JourneyAttachment> {
    const now = new Date();
    entity.createdAt = entity.createdAt ?? now;
    entity.updatedAt = now;
    if (creator) {
      entity.createdBy = entity.createdBy ?? creator;
      entity.updatedBy = creator;
    }
    return await this.repo.save(entity);
  }

  async update(entity: JourneyAttachment, updater?: string): Promise<JourneyAttachment> {
    const now = new Date();
    entity.updatedAt = now;
    if (updater) entity.updatedBy = updater;
    return await this.repo.save(entity);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.repo.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 199: src\app\modules\journey-goods\journey-policy.controller.ts =====

import { JourneyAttachment } from './../journey-attachment/journey-attachment.entity';
import { GovernmentService } from './../government/government.service';
import {
  BadRequestException,
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  Logger,
  NotFoundException,
  Param,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Post,
  Put,
  Query,
  Req,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, AuthUser, Roles, RolesGuard } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import { JourneyPolicyService } from './journey-policy.service';
import { JourneyPolicyDTO } from './dtos/journey-policy.dto';
import { CreateJourneyPolicyDTO } from './dtos/create-journey-policy.dto';
import { UpdateJourneyPolicyDTO } from './dtos/update-journey-policy.dto';
import {
  mapCreateJourneyPolicyDtoToEntity,
  mapJourneyPolicyToDtoSelective,
  mapUpdateJourneyPolicyDtoToEntity,
} from './journey-policy.mapper';
import { JourneyService } from '../journey/journey.service';
import { AreaService } from '../area/area.service';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { JourneyQueryDTO } from '../journey/dtos/query-journey.dto';
import { EmployeeService } from '../employee/employee.service';
import { JourneyAttachmentService } from '../journey-attachment/journey-attachment.service';
import { JourneyAttachmentType } from 'src/core/enums/journey';
import { JourneyPolicyFormDTO } from './dtos/journey-policy-form.dto';
import { withTransaction } from 'src/core/utils/transaction';
import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';

@Controller('api/journey-policies')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('journey-policy-module')
export class JourneyPolicyController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('JourneyPolicyController');

  constructor(
    private readonly policyService: JourneyPolicyService,
    private readonly journeyService: JourneyService,
    private readonly governmentService: GovernmentService,
    private readonly areaService: AreaService,
    private readonly employeeService: EmployeeService,
    private readonly journeyAttachmentService: JourneyAttachmentService,
    private readonly dataSource: DataSource,
  ) {}

  // ---------------------------
  // GET ALL (paginated)
  // ---------------------------
  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of journey policies paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List of journey policies',
    type: JourneyPolicyDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAll(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: JourneyQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<JourneyPolicyDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    // Load with relations
    const [results, count] = await this.policyService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      relations: ['journey', 'deliveryGov', 'deliveryArea', 'employee'],
    });

    const dtos = mapJourneyPolicyToDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'journey',
      'deliveryGov',
      'deliveryArea',
      'employee',
      'createdAt',
      'createdBy',
    ]);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // GET ONE
  // ---------------------------
  @Get('journey/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get policy details for a journey' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Policy found', type: JourneyPolicyFormDTO })
  async getById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<JourneyPolicyFormDTO> {
    const existing = await this.journeyService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Journey with id ${id} not found`);

    const row = await this.policyService.getPolicyFormByJourneyId(id);

    if (!row || !row.policyform) throw new NotFoundException(`Policy with id ${id} not found`);

    // Merge main policy data with joined JSON objects so all
    // related pieces (areas, governments, employee, attachments)
    // are returned together.
    return {
      ...row.policyform,
      deliveryArea: row.deliveryArea,
      deliveryGov: row.deliveryGov,
      loadingGov: row.loadingGov,
      employee: row.employee,
      attachments: row.attachments,
    };
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // CREATE (same structure as JourneyController)
  // ---------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new journey policy' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Policy created', type: JourneyPolicyDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateJourneyPolicyDTO, @AuthUser() user: any) {
    // 1. Validate FK relations
    const journey = await this.journeyService.findById(dto.journeyId);
    if (!journey) throw new NotFoundException(`Journey with id ${dto.journeyId} not found`);

    //cheack if it has policy already
    const existingPolicy = await this.policyService.findByFields({
      where: { journey: { id: dto.journeyId } },
    });
    if (existingPolicy)
      throw new BadRequestException(`Journey with id ${dto.journeyId} already has a policy`);

    await this.validatePolicyReferences(dto.journeyId, dto);

    //

    // 2. Map to entity
    const entity = mapCreateJourneyPolicyDtoToEntity(dto);
    // link to existing journey so relation (and id) is set
    entity.journey = journey;

    // Save
    const saved = await this.policyService.save(entity, user?.email);

    if (dto.policyFile) {
      const policyAttachment = new JourneyAttachment();
      policyAttachment.journey = saved.journey;
      policyAttachment.url = dto.policyFile;
      policyAttachment.type = JourneyAttachmentType.POLICY;
      await this.journeyAttachmentService.save(policyAttachment, user?.email);
    }

    return mapJourneyPolicyToDtoSelective(saved);
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // UPDATE (same style as JourneyController)
  // ---------------------------
  @Put('journey/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update journey policy details' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Policy updated', type: JourneyPolicyDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateJourneyPolicyDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ) {
    const existing = await this.policyService.findByFields({
      where: { journey: { id } },
      relations: ['journey', 'deliveryGov', 'deliveryArea'],
    });

    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Policy with id ${id} not found`);

    // Validate new FK references using the journey id from the found policy
    await this.validatePolicyReferences(existing.journey.id, dto);

    const updated = await withTransaction(this.dataSource, async () => {
      const updatedEntity = mapUpdateJourneyPolicyDtoToEntity(dto, existing);
      const savedPolicy = await this.policyService.update(updatedEntity, user?.email);

      // Handle policy file attachment on update
      if (dto.policyFile) {
        const existingAttachment = await this.journeyAttachmentService.findByFields({
          where: {
            journey: { id: savedPolicy.journey.id },
            type: JourneyAttachmentType.POLICY,
          },
        });

        if (existingAttachment) {
          existingAttachment.url = dto.policyFile;
          await this.journeyAttachmentService.update(existingAttachment, user?.email);
        } else {
          const policyAttachment = new JourneyAttachment();
          policyAttachment.journey = savedPolicy.journey;
          policyAttachment.url = dto.policyFile;
          policyAttachment.type = JourneyAttachmentType.POLICY;
          await this.journeyAttachmentService.save(policyAttachment, user?.email);
        }
      }

      return savedPolicy;
    });

    return mapJourneyPolicyToDtoSelective(updated);
  }

  // ---------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ---------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete journey policy' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    const existing = await this.policyService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Policy with id ${id} not found`);
    await this.policyService.delete(id);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // VALIDATION HELPER
  // ============================================================

  private async validatePolicyReferences(
    journeyId: number,
    dto: CreateJourneyPolicyDTO | UpdateJourneyPolicyDTO,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const journey = await this.journeyService.findById(journeyId);
    if (!journey) throw new NotFoundException(`Journey with id ${journeyId} not found`);

    // Validate deliverySite if provided
    if (dto.deliveryAreaId !== undefined) {
      const deliverySite = await this.areaService.findById(dto.deliveryAreaId);
      if (!deliverySite)
        throw new NotFoundException(`Area (delivery site) with id ${dto.deliveryAreaId} not found`);
    }

    // Validate deliveryGov if provided
    if (dto.deliveryGovId !== undefined) {
      const deliveryGov = await this.governmentService.findById(dto.deliveryGovId);
      if (!deliveryGov)
        throw new NotFoundException(`Government with id ${dto.deliveryGovId} not found`);
    }

    // Validate employee if provided
    if (dto.employeeId !== undefined) {
      const employee = await this.employeeService.findById(dto.employeeId);
      if (!employee) throw new NotFoundException(`Employee with id ${dto.employeeId} not found`);
    }
  }
}
