// src/journey-policy/journey-policy.entity.ts
import { Column, Entity, JoinColumn, ManyToOne } from 'typeorm';
import { Journey } from '../journey/journey.entity';
import { Employee } from '../employee/employee.entity';
import { BaseEntity } from 'src/core/utils/base.entity';
import { Area } from '../area/area.entity';
import { Government } from '../government/government.entity';
import { IsDateString } from 'class-validator';

@Entity('journey_policies')
export class JourneyPolicy extends BaseEntity {
  @ManyToOne(() => Journey, { onDelete: 'CASCADE' })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'journey_id' })
  journey: Journey;

  @Column({ type: 'float', nullable: true })
  bookWeight?: number;

  @Column({ type: 'float', nullable: true })
  actualWeight?: number;

  @Column({ type: 'float', nullable: true })
  deliveryWeight?: number;

  @Column({ type: 'float', nullable: true })
  shortageQty?: number;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100, nullable: true })
  policyNo?: string;

  @Column({ type: 'date', nullable: true })
  policyDate?: Date;

  @Column({ type: 'timestamp', nullable: true })
  entryTimeFactory?: Date;

  @Column({ type: 'timestamp', nullable: true })
  exitTimeFactory?: Date;

  @ManyToOne(() => Government, { nullable: true })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'delivery_gov_id' })
  deliveryGov?: Government;

  @ManyToOne(() => Area, { nullable: true })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'delivery_area_id' })
  deliveryArea?: Area;

  @Column({ type: 'date', nullable: true })
  loadingDate?: Date;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100, nullable: true })
  loadingPermitNo?: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100, nullable: true })
  archiveNo?: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => Employee, { nullable: true })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'employee_id' })
  employee: Employee;

  // Total trip time in minutes
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 10, nullable: true })
  tripDuration?: string; // store 105 instead of interval

  @IsDateString()
  @Column({ type: 'date', nullable: true })
  tripDate?: Date;

  @Column({ type: 'float', name: 'trip_distance', nullable: true })
  tripDistance?: number;
}

  value: JourneyPolicy | JourneyPolicy[],
  keys?: (keyof JourneyPolicyDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],

export const mapCreateJourneyPolicyDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateJourneyPolicyDTO): JourneyPolicy => {

  return entity;

  if (dto.tripDistance !== undefined) existing.tripDistance = dto.tripDistance;

  if (dto.employeeId) existing.employee = { id: dto.employeeId } as Employee;

  if (dto.deliveryGovId) existing.deliveryGov = { id: dto.deliveryGovId } as Government;

import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { JourneyModule } from '../journey/journey.module';

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { JourneyPolicy } from './journey-policy.entity';
import { JourneyAttachmentType } from 'src/core/enums/journey';
import { JourneyAttachment } from '../journey-attachment/journey-attachment.entity';

@Injectable()
export class JourneyPolicyService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(JourneyPolicy)
    private readonly repo: Repository<JourneyPolicy>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<JourneyPolicy | undefined> {
    return (await this.repo.findOne({ where: { id } })) ?? undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<JourneyPolicy>): Promise<JourneyPolicy | undefined> {
    return (await this.repo.findOne(options)) ?? undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<JourneyPolicy>): Promise<JourneyPolicy[]> {
    return await this.repo.find(options);
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<JourneyPolicy>): Promise<[JourneyPolicy[], number]> {
    return await this.repo.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(entity: JourneyPolicy, creator?: string): Promise<JourneyPolicy> {
    const now = new Date();
    entity.createdAt = entity.createdAt ?? now;
    entity.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      entity.createdBy = entity.createdBy ?? creator;
      entity.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.repo.save(entity);
  }

  async update(entity: JourneyPolicy, updater?: string): Promise<JourneyPolicy> {
    const now = new Date();
    entity.updatedAt = now;

    if (updater) entity.updatedBy = updater;

    return await this.repo.save(entity);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.repo.delete(id);
  }

  async getPolicyFormByJourneyId(id: number): Promise<any> {
    const qb = this.repo.createQueryBuilder('policy');

    qb.leftJoin('policy.journey', 'journey')
      .leftJoin('policy.deliveryArea', 'deliveryArea')
      .leftJoin('policy.deliveryGov', 'deliveryGov')
      .leftJoin('policy.employee', 'employee')
      .leftJoin('employee.user', 'employeeUser')
      .leftJoin(
        JourneyAttachment,
        'attachment',
        'attachment.journey_id = journey.id AND attachment.type = :type',
        { type: JourneyAttachmentType.POLICY },
      );

    qb.select([
      // ================= POLICY =================
      `
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id', policy.id,
      'bookWeight', policy."bookWeight",
      'actualWeight', policy."actualWeight",
      'tripDate', policy."tripDate",
      'deliveryWeight', policy."deliveryWeight",
      'shortageQty', policy."shortageQty",
      'policyNo', policy."policyNo",
      'policyDate', policy."policyDate",
      'entryTimeFactory', policy."entryTimeFactory",
      'exitTimeFactory', policy."exitTimeFactory",
      'loadingDate', policy."loadingDate",
      'archiveNo', policy."archiveNo",
      'loadingPermitNo', policy."loadingPermitNo",
      'tripDuration', policy."tripDuration",
      'tripDistance', policy."trip_distance"
    ) AS policyform
    `,

      // ================= DELIVERY AREA =================
      `
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id', "deliveryArea"."id",
      'name', "deliveryArea"."name"
    ) AS "deliveryArea"
    `,

      // ================= DELIVERY GOV =================
      `
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id', "deliveryGov"."id",
      'name', "deliveryGov"."name"
    ) AS "deliveryGov"
    `,

      // ================= EMPLOYEE =================
      `
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id', "employee"."id",
      'name', concat_ws(' ', "employeeUser"."first_name", "employeeUser"."last_name")
    ) AS "employee"
    `,

      // ================= ATTACHMENT =================
      `
    jsonb_agg(
      DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
        'id', attachment.id,
        'fileName', attachment.url,
        'type', attachment.type
      )
    ) FILTER (WHERE attachment.id IS NOT NULL) AS "attachments"
    `,
    ]);

    qb.where('journey.id = :id', { id });
    qb.groupBy(`
    policy.id,
    journey.id,
    deliveryArea.id,
    deliveryGov.id,
    employee.id,
    employeeUser.id
  `);

    return qb.getRawOne();
  }

  // Detailed view using QueryBuilder with jsonb_build_object, similar style to JourneyService.getJourneyDetailsById
}

import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  Logger,
  NotFoundException,
  Param,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Post,
  Put,
  Query,
  Req,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, AuthUser, Roles, RolesGuard } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import { JourneyTransactionService } from './journey-transaction.service';
import { JourneyTransactionDTO } from './dtos/journey-transaction.dto';
import { CreateJourneyTransactionDTO } from './dtos/create-journey-transaction.dto';
import { UpdateJourneyTransactionDTO } from './dtos/update-journey-transaction.dto';
import {
  mapCreateJourneyTransactionDtoToEntity,
  mapJourneyTransactionToDtoSelective,
  mapUpdateJourneyTransactionDtoToEntity,
} from './journey-transaction.mapper';
import { JourneyService } from '../journey/journey.service';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import { JourneyTransactionsGroupedDTO } from './dtos/create-journey-transactions-grouped.dto';
import { JourneyTransactionsBulkUpdateDTO } from './dtos/update-journey-transactions-grouped.dto';
import { JourneyTransaction } from './journey-transaction.entity';
import { FindOptionsWhere, In } from 'typeorm';
import { QueryJourneyTransactionDTO } from './dtos/query-journey-transaction.dto';

@Controller('api/journey-transactions')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('journey-transactions-module')
export class JourneyTransactionController {
  logger = new Logger('JourneyTransactionController');

  constructor(
    private readonly journeyTransactionService: JourneyTransactionService,
    private readonly journeyService: JourneyService,
  ) {}

  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of journey transactions paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Transactions list',
    type: JourneyTransactionDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAll(@Req() req: Request, @Query() query: QueryJourneyTransactionDTO): Promise<any> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1), // zero-based for skip
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );
    const whereConditions: FindOptionsWhere<JourneyTransaction> = {};

    if (req.query.journeyId) {
      whereConditions.journey = { id: +req.query.journeyId };
    }

    const [results, count] = await this.journeyTransactionService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      where: whereConditions,
    });

    const dtos = mapJourneyTransactionToDtoSelective(results);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a transaction for a journey' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Transaction created', type: JourneyTransactionDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateJourneyTransactionDTO, @AuthUser() user: any) {
    const journey = await this.journeyService.findById(dto.journeyId);
    if (!journey) throw new NotFoundException(`Journey with id ${dto.journeyId} not found`);

    const alreadyExists = await this.journeyTransactionService.findByFields({
      where: {
        journey: { id: dto.journeyId },
        category: dto.category,
      },
    });

    if (alreadyExists)
      throw new NotFoundException(`Journey with id ${dto.journeyId} already has a transaction`);

    const entity = mapCreateJourneyTransactionDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.journeyTransactionService.save(entity, user?.email);

    return mapJourneyTransactionToDtoSelective(saved);
  }
  @Post('/bulk')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create or update multiple transactions for a journey' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: 'Transactions created or updated',
    type: [JourneyTransactionDTO],
  })
  async createBulk(
    @Body() payload: JourneyTransactionsGroupedDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<JourneyTransactionDTO>[]> {
    const { journeyId, transactionType, transactions } = payload;

    const journey = await this.journeyService.findById(journeyId);
    if (!journey) throw new NotFoundException(`Journey with id ${journeyId} not found`);

    // Get existing transactions for this journey
    const existingTransactions = await this.journeyTransactionService.find({
      where: { journey: { id: journeyId } },
    });

    const existingMap = new Map<string, JourneyTransaction>();
    existingTransactions.forEach((tx) => {
      existingMap.set(tx.category, tx);
    });

    const toCreate: JourneyTransaction[] = [];
    const toUpdate: JourneyTransaction[] = [];

    // Process each incoming transaction
    for (const tx of transactions) {
      const existing = existingMap.get(tx.category);

      const txWithDefaults = {
        ...tx,
        transactionType: transactionType,
        journeyId,
      };

      if (existing) {
        // Update existing transaction
        const updatedEntity = mapUpdateJourneyTransactionDtoToEntity(txWithDefaults, existing);
        toUpdate.push(updatedEntity);
      } else {
        // Create new transaction
        const newEntity = mapCreateJourneyTransactionDtoToEntity(txWithDefaults);
        toCreate.push(newEntity);
      }
    }

    await this.journeyService.update(journey, user?.email);

    // Save all changes
    const saved: JourneyTransaction[] = [];
    if (toCreate.length > 0) {
      const createdTransactions = await this.journeyTransactionService.saveMany(
        toCreate,
        user?.email,
      );
      saved.push(...createdTransactions);
    }
    if (toUpdate.length > 0) {
      const updatedTransactions = await this.journeyTransactionService.saveMany(
        toUpdate,
        user?.email,
      );
      saved.push(...updatedTransactions);
    }

    return mapJourneyTransactionToDtoSelective(saved);
  }

  @Get('/bulk/:journeyId')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get grouped transactions for a journey' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Grouped journey transactions (same shape as bulk update)',
    type: JourneyTransactionsBulkUpdateDTO,
  })
  /*************  ✨ Windsurf Command ⭐  *************/
  /**
   * Retrieves all transactions for a journey grouped by transactionType.
   * @return Promise<JourneyTransactionsBulkUpdateDTO>
   */
  /*******  74d7ff0e-755d-40a5-a29b-d6724705f26e  *******/
  async getBulkByJourney(
    @Param('journeyId', ParseIntPipe) journeyId: number,
  ): Promise<JourneyTransactionsBulkUpdateDTO> {
    const journey = await this.journeyService.findById(journeyId);
    if (!journey) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Journey with id ${journeyId} not found`);
    }

    const transactions = await this.journeyTransactionService.find({
      where: { journey: { id: journeyId } },
      order: { id: 'ASC' },
    });

    return {
      journeyId,
      transactions: transactions.map((tx) => ({
        id: tx.id,
        transactionType: tx.transactionType,
        category: tx.category,
        amount: tx.amount,
        quantity: tx.quantity,
        unitPrice: tx.unitPrice,
        placeOrService: tx.placeOrService,
        invoiceUrl: tx.invoiceUrl,
        description: tx.description,
      })),
    };
  }

  @Put('/bulk')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update multiple transactions for a journey' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Transactions updated', type: [JourneyTransactionDTO] })
  async updateBulk(
    @Body() payload: JourneyTransactionsBulkUpdateDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<JourneyTransactionDTO>[]> {
    const { journeyId, transactions } = payload;

    const journey = await this.journeyService.findById(journeyId);
    if (!journey) throw new NotFoundException(`Journey with id ${journeyId} not found`);

    // Load existing transactions for this journey by ids from payload
    const ids = Array.from(
      new Set(transactions.map((tx) => Number((tx as any).id)).filter((id) => !Number.isNaN(id))),
    );
    if (!ids.length) {
      throw new NotFoundException('No transaction ids provided for bulk update');
    }

    const existingList = await this.journeyTransactionService.find({
      where: {
        id: In(ids),
        journey: { id: journeyId },
      },
    });

    const existingMap = new Map<number, JourneyTransaction>();
    existingList.forEach((tx) => existingMap.set(tx.id, tx));

    const toUpdate: JourneyTransaction[] = [];

    for (const dto of transactions as any[]) {
      const id = dto.id as number;
      const existing = existingMap.get(id);
      if (!existing) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`Transaction with id ${id} not found for journey ${journeyId}`);
      }
      const updatedEntity = mapUpdateJourneyTransactionDtoToEntity(dto, existing);
      toUpdate.push(updatedEntity);
    }

    const saved = await this.journeyTransactionService.saveMany(toUpdate, user?.email);

    return mapJourneyTransactionToDtoSelective(saved);
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update a transaction' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Transaction updated', type: JourneyTransactionDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateJourneyTransactionDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ) {
    const existing = await this.journeyTransactionService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Transaction with id ${id} not found`);

    const updatedEntity = mapUpdateJourneyTransactionDtoToEntity(dto, existing);
    const updated = await this.journeyTransactionService.update(updatedEntity, user?.email);
    return mapJourneyTransactionToDtoSelective(updated);
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete a transaction' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.journeyTransactionService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Transaction with id ${id} not found`);
    await this.journeyTransactionService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

===== FILE 210: src\app\modules\journey-transaction\journey-transaction.mapper.ts =====

import { JourneyTransaction } from './journey-transaction.entity';
import { JourneyTransactionDTO } from './dtos/journey-transaction.dto';
import { CreateJourneyTransactionDTO } from './dtos/create-journey-transaction.dto';
import { UpdateJourneyTransactionDTO } from './dtos/update-journey-transaction.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { Journey } from '../journey/journey.entity';
import { JourneyDTO } from '../journey/dtos/journey.dto';

const allowedJourneyTransactionDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof JourneyTransactionDTO | keyof BaseDTO> =
  [
    'id',
    'transactionType',
    'category',
    'amount',
    'quantity',
    'unitPrice',
    'placeOrService',
    'invoiceUrl',
    'description',
    'createdAt',
    'updatedAt',
    'createdBy',
    'updatedBy',
  ];

export function mapJourneyTransactionToDtoSelective(
  tx: JourneyTransaction,
  keys?: (keyof JourneyTransactionDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<JourneyTransactionDTO>;
export function mapJourneyTransactionToDtoSelective(
  list: JourneyTransaction[],
  keys?: (keyof JourneyTransactionDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<JourneyTransactionDTO>[];
export function mapJourneyTransactionToDtoSelective(
  value: JourneyTransaction | JourneyTransaction[],
  keys?: (keyof JourneyTransactionDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<JourneyTransactionDTO> | Partial<JourneyTransactionDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (tx: JourneyTransaction): Partial<JourneyTransactionDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<JourneyTransactionDTO> = {};
    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedJourneyTransactionDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedJourneyTransactionDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      const value = (tx as any)[key];
      if (value !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = value;
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(value);
}

export const mapCreateJourneyTransactionDtoToEntity = (
  dto: CreateJourneyTransactionDTO,
): JourneyTransaction => {
  const entity = new JourneyTransaction();
  entity.transactionType = dto.transactionType;
  entity.category = dto.category;
  entity.amount = dto.amount;
  entity.quantity = dto.quantity;
  entity.unitPrice = dto.unitPrice;
  entity.placeOrService = dto.placeOrService;
  entity.invoiceUrl = dto.invoiceUrl;
  entity.description = dto.description;

  if (dto.journeyId) entity.journey = { id: dto.journeyId } as Journey;

  return entity;
};

export const mapCreateJourneyTransactionDtosToEntities = (
  dtos: CreateJourneyTransactionDTO[],
): JourneyTransaction[] => {
  return dtos.map((dto) => mapCreateJourneyTransactionDtoToEntity(dto));
};
export const mapUpdateJourneyTransactionDtoToEntity = (
  dto: UpdateJourneyTransactionDTO,
  existing: JourneyTransaction,
  journey?: JourneyDTO,
): JourneyTransaction => {
  if (dto.amount !== undefined) existing.amount = dto.amount;
  if (dto.quantity !== undefined) existing.quantity = dto.quantity;
  if (dto.unitPrice !== undefined) existing.unitPrice = dto.unitPrice;
  if (dto.placeOrService !== undefined) existing.placeOrService = dto.placeOrService;
  if (dto.invoiceUrl !== undefined) existing.invoiceUrl = dto.invoiceUrl;
  if (dto.description !== undefined) existing.description = dto.description;

  if (journey !== undefined) {
    existing.journey = { id: journey.id } as Journey;
  }
  return existing;
};

===== FILE 212: src\app\modules\journey-transaction\journey-transaction.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { JourneyTransaction } from './journey-transaction.entity';

@Injectable()
export class JourneyTransactionService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(JourneyTransaction)
    private readonly repo: Repository<JourneyTransaction>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<JourneyTransaction | undefined> {
    return (await this.repo.findOne({ where: { id } })) ?? undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(
    options: FindOneOptions<JourneyTransaction>,
  ): Promise<JourneyTransaction | undefined> {
    return (await this.repo.findOne(options)) ?? undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<JourneyTransaction>): Promise<JourneyTransaction[]> {
    return await this.repo.find(options);
  }

  async findAndCount(
    options: FindManyOptions<JourneyTransaction>,
  ): Promise<[JourneyTransaction[], number]> {
    return await this.repo.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(entity: JourneyTransaction, creator?: string): Promise<JourneyTransaction> {
    const now = new Date();
    entity.createdAt = entity.createdAt ?? now;
    entity.updatedAt = now;
    if (creator) {
      entity.createdBy = entity.createdBy ?? creator;
      entity.updatedBy = creator;
    }
    return await this.repo.save(entity);
  }

  async saveMany(entities: JourneyTransaction[], creator?: string): Promise<JourneyTransaction[]> {
    const now = new Date();
    entities.forEach((entity) => {
      entity.createdAt = entity.createdAt ?? now;
      entity.updatedAt = now;
      if (creator) {
        entity.createdBy = entity.createdBy ?? creator;
        entity.updatedBy = creator;
      }
    });

    return await this.repo.save(entities); // TypeORM supports saving arrays
  }

  async update(entity: JourneyTransaction, updater?: string): Promise<JourneyTransaction> {
    const now = new Date();
    entity.updatedAt = now;
    if (updater) entity.updatedBy = updater;
    return await this.repo.save(entity);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.repo.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 219: src\app\modules\owner\owner.controller.ts =====

// src/owner/owner.controller.ts
import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  Get,
  Req,
  Query,
  ParseIntPipe,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';

import { OwnerService } from './owner.service';

import { OwnerDTO } from './dtos/owner.dto';
import { CreateOwnerDTO } from './dtos/create-owner.dto';
import { UpdateOwnerDTO } from './dtos/update-owner.dto';

import {
  mapOwnerToOwnerDtoSelective,
  mapCreateOwnerDtoToEntity,
  mapUpdateOwnerDtoToEntity,
} from './owner.mapper';
import { OwnerQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-owner.dto';
import { BulkAssignOwnerDTO } from './dtos/bulk-assign.dto';
import { RelCarOwnerService } from '../rel-car-owner/rel-car-owner.services';
import { RelTrailerOwnerService } from '../rel-trailer-owner/rel-trailer-owner.services';
import { TrailerService } from '../trailer/trailer.service';
import { CarService } from '../car/car.service';
import { DataSource, In } from 'typeorm';
import { withTransaction } from 'src/core/utils/transaction';
import { RelCarOwner } from '../rel-car-owner/rel-car-owner.entity';
import { RelTrailerOwner } from '../rel-trailer-owner/rel-trailer-owner.entity';

@Controller('api/owners')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('owners-module')
export class OwnerController {
  logger = new Logger('OwnerController');

  constructor(
    private readonly ownerService: OwnerService,
    private readonly relCarOwnerService: RelCarOwnerService,
    private readonly relTrailerOwnerService: RelTrailerOwnerService,
    private readonly carService: CarService,
    private readonly trailerService: TrailerService,
    private readonly dataSource: DataSource,
  ) {}

  // GET ALL (PAGINATED)
  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of owners (paginated)' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'List all owners', type: OwnerDTO, isArray: true })
  async getAllOwners(@Req() req: Request, @Query() query: OwnerQueryDTO) {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const [results, count] = await this.ownerService.findAndCount({
      skip: pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      relations: [
        'carOwnerships',
        'carOwnerships.car',
        'trailerOwnerships',
        'trailerOwnerships.trailer',
      ],
    });

    const dtos = mapOwnerToOwnerDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'phone',
      'address',
      'email',
      'bankAccountNumber',
      'bankName',
      'transactionType',
      'trailerOwnerships',
      'carOwnerships',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
    ]);

    req.res!.setHeader('X-Total-Count', count);
    req.res!.setHeader('X-Page', pageRequest.page);
    req.res!.setHeader(
      'X-Has-Next-Page',
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size + results.length ? 'true' : 'false',
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  // GET BY ID
  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get owner by ID' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Owner found', type: OwnerDTO })
  async getOwnerById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<Partial<OwnerDTO>> {
    const owner = await this.ownerService.findOne({
      where: { id },
      relations: [
        'carOwnerships',
        'carOwnerships.car',
        'trailerOwnerships',
        'trailerOwnerships.trailer',
      ],
    });

    if (!owner) throw new NotFoundException(`Owner with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapOwnerToOwnerDtoSelective(owner, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'phone',
      'address',
      'email',
      'bankAccountNumber',
      'bankName',
      'transactionType',
      'trailerOwnerships',
      'carOwnerships',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
    ]);
  }
  // Only change in create & update:
  @Post('/')
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateOwnerDTO, @AuthUser() user: any): Promise<Partial<OwnerDTO>> {
    // Validate bank details: if one is provided, both must be provided
    if ((dto.bankAccountNumber && !dto.bankName) || (!dto.bankAccountNumber && dto.bankName)) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Both bankAccountNumber and bankName must be provided together or both must be empty',
      );
    }

    // Check for duplicate phone number in database
    const existingPhone = await this.ownerService.findByFields({ where: { phone: dto.phone } });
    if (existingPhone) {
      throw new BadRequestException(`Owner with phone number ${dto.phone} already exists`);
    }

    // Check for duplicate email in database (if provided)
    if (dto.email) {
      const existingEmail = await this.ownerService.findByFields({ where: { email: dto.email } });
      if (existingEmail) {
        throw new BadRequestException(`Owner with email ${dto.email} already exists`);
      }
    }

    // Check for duplicate bank account number in database (if provided)
    if (dto.bankAccountNumber) {
      const existingBankAccount = await this.ownerService.findByFields({
        where: { bankAccountNumber: dto.bankAccountNumber },
      });
      if (existingBankAccount) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Owner with bank account number ${dto.bankAccountNumber} already exists`,
        );
      }
    }

    const owner = mapCreateOwnerDtoToEntity(dto);

    // Validate car ownerships before transaction
    if (owner.carOwnerships && owner.carOwnerships.length > 0) {
      const carIds = owner.carOwnerships.map((rel) => rel.car.id);

      // Check for duplicates within the request array
      const hasDuplicates = carIds.length !== new Set(carIds).size;
      if (hasDuplicates) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Duplicate car ownerships found');
      }

      // Check if all car IDs exist
      for (const carId of carIds) {
        const car = await this.carService.findById(carId);
        if (!car) {
          throw new NotFoundException(`Car with id ${carId} not found`);
        }
      }
    }

    // Validate trailer ownerships before transaction
    if (owner.trailerOwnerships && owner.trailerOwnerships.length > 0) {
      const trailerIds = owner.trailerOwnerships.map((rel) => rel.trailer.id);

      // Check for duplicates within the request array
      const hasDuplicates = trailerIds.length !== new Set(trailerIds).size;
      if (hasDuplicates) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Duplicate trailer ownerships found');
      }

      // Check if all trailer IDs exist
      for (const trailerId of trailerIds) {
        const trailer = await this.trailerService.findById(trailerId);
        if (!trailer) {
          throw new NotFoundException(`Trailer with id ${trailerId} not found`);
        }
      }
    }

    // Execute save operation within transaction
    const saved = await withTransaction(this.dataSource, async () => {
      return await this.ownerService.save(owner, user?.email);
    });

    return this.getOwnerById(saved.id);
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateOwnerDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<OwnerDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.ownerService.findOne({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['carOwnerships', 'trailerOwnerships'],
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Owner ${id} not found`);

    // Validate bank details: if one is provided, both must be provided
    if ((dto.bankAccountNumber && !dto.bankName) || (!dto.bankAccountNumber && dto.bankName)) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Both bankAccountNumber and bankName must be provided together or both must be empty',
      );
    }

    // Check for duplicate phone number (only if changed)
    if (dto.phone && dto.phone !== existing.phone) {
      const existingPhone = await this.ownerService.findByFields({ where: { phone: dto.phone } });
      if (existingPhone) {
        throw new BadRequestException(`Owner with phone number ${dto.phone} already exists`);
      }
    }

    // Check for duplicate email (only if changed and provided)
    if (dto.email && dto.email !== existing.email) {
      const existingEmail = await this.ownerService.findByFields({ where: { email: dto.email } });
      if (existingEmail) {
        throw new BadRequestException(`Owner with email ${dto.email} already exists`);
      }
    }

    // Check for duplicate bank account number (only if changed and provided)
    if (dto.bankAccountNumber && dto.bankAccountNumber !== existing.bankAccountNumber) {
      const existingBankAccount = await this.ownerService.findByFields({
        where: { bankAccountNumber: dto.bankAccountNumber },
      });
      if (existingBankAccount) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Owner with bank account number ${dto.bankAccountNumber} already exists`,
        );
      }
    }

    // Validate car ownerships if provided in DTO
    if (dto.carOwnerships && dto.carOwnerships.length > 0) {
      const carIds = (dto.carOwnerships as any[]).map((rel) => rel.carId).filter(Boolean);

      // Check for duplicates within the request array
      const hasDuplicates = carIds.length !== new Set(carIds).size;
      if (hasDuplicates) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Duplicate car ownerships found');
      }

      // Check if all car IDs exist
      for (const carId of carIds) {
        const car = await this.carService.findById(carId);
        if (!car) {
          throw new NotFoundException(`Car with id ${carId} not found`);
        }
      }
    }

    // Validate trailer ownerships if provided in DTO
    if (dto.trailerOwnerships && dto.trailerOwnerships.length > 0) {
      const trailerIds = (dto.trailerOwnerships as any[])
        .map((rel) => rel.trailerId)
        .filter(Boolean);

      // Check for duplicates within the request array
      const hasDuplicates = trailerIds.length !== new Set(trailerIds).size;
      if (hasDuplicates) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Duplicate trailer ownerships found');
      }

      // Check if all trailer IDs exist
      for (const trailerId of trailerIds) {
        const trailer = await this.trailerService.findById(trailerId);
        if (!trailer) {
          throw new NotFoundException(`Trailer with id ${trailerId} not found`);
        }
      }
    }

    dto.id = id;

    // Execute update operation within transaction
    await withTransaction(this.dataSource, async () => {
      const mapped = mapUpdateOwnerDtoToEntity(dto, existing);

      // Handle car ownerships: upsert logic (update if exists, create if new)
      if (dto.carOwnerships !== undefined) {
        if (dto.carOwnerships.length > 0) {
          const carIds = (dto.carOwnerships as any[]).map((rel) => rel.carId);

          // Find existing car ownerships for this owner
          const existingCarOwnerships = await this.dataSource.getRepository(RelCarOwner).find({
            where: { owner: { id }, car: { id: In(carIds) } },
            relations: ['car'],
          });

          const existingCarMap = new Map(existingCarOwnerships.map((rel) => [rel.car.id, rel]));

          // Prepare car ownerships: update existing, create new
          mapped.carOwnerships = (dto.carOwnerships as any[]).map((input) => {
            const existing = existingCarMap.get(input.carId);
            if (existing) {
              // Update existing relationship
              existing.percentage = input.percentage ?? existing.percentage;
              existing.updatedBy = user?.email;
              return existing;
            }
            // Create new relationship
            const rel = new RelCarOwner();
            rel.car = { id: input.carId } as any;
            rel.owner = { id } as any;
            if (input.percentage !== undefined) rel.percentage = input.percentage;
            return rel;
          });
        } else {
          // Empty array means delete all car ownerships
          if (existing.carOwnerships?.length > 0) {
            const carOwnershipIds = existing.carOwnerships.map((rel) => rel.id);
            await this.dataSource.getRepository(RelCarOwner).delete({ id: In(carOwnershipIds) });
          }
          mapped.carOwnerships = [];
        }
      } else {
        // Not provided, preserve existing
        mapped.carOwnerships = existing.carOwnerships;
      }

      // Handle trailer ownerships: upsert logic (update if exists, create if new)
      if (dto.trailerOwnerships !== undefined) {
        if (dto.trailerOwnerships.length > 0) {
          const trailerIds = (dto.trailerOwnerships as any[]).map((rel) => rel.trailerId);

          // Find existing trailer ownerships for this owner
          const existingTrailerOwnerships = await this.dataSource
            .getRepository(RelTrailerOwner)
            .find({
              where: { owner: { id }, trailer: { id: In(trailerIds) } },
              relations: ['trailer'],
            });

          const existingTrailerMap = new Map(
            existingTrailerOwnerships.map((rel) => [rel.trailer.id, rel]),
          );

          // Prepare trailer ownerships: update existing, create new
          mapped.trailerOwnerships = (dto.trailerOwnerships as any[]).map((input) => {
            const existing = existingTrailerMap.get(input.trailerId);
            if (existing) {
              // Update existing relationship
              existing.percentage = input.percentage ?? existing.percentage;
              existing.updatedBy = user?.email;
              return existing;
            }
            // Create new relationship
            const rel = new RelTrailerOwner();
            rel.trailer = { id: input.trailerId } as any;
            rel.owner = { id } as any;
            if (input.percentage !== undefined) rel.percentage = input.percentage;
            return rel;
          });
        } else {
          // Empty array means delete all trailer ownerships
          if (existing.trailerOwnerships?.length > 0) {
            const trailerOwnershipIds = existing.trailerOwnerships.map((rel) => rel.id);
            await this.dataSource
              .getRepository(RelTrailerOwner)
              .delete({ id: In(trailerOwnershipIds) });
          }
          mapped.trailerOwnerships = [];
        }
      } else {
        // Not provided, preserve existing
        mapped.trailerOwnerships = existing.trailerOwnerships;
      }

      await this.ownerService.update(mapped, user?.email);
    });

    return this.getOwnerById(id);
  }

  // DELETE
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete owner' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.ownerService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Owner with id ${id} not found`);
    await this.ownerService.delete(id);
  }

  // bulk assign owners to vehicles

  @Post('/bulk-assign')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Bulk assign owners to vehicles' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Owners assigned successfully' })
  async bulkAssignOwners(@Body() assignments: BulkAssignOwnerDTO, @AuthUser() user: any) {
    if (!assignments.carId && !assignments.trailerId) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Either carId or trailerId must be provided');
    }

    if (assignments.carId && assignments.trailerId) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Only one of carId or trailerId should be provided');
    }

    // Check for duplicate owner IDs in the request
    const ownerIds = assignments.owners.map((owner) => owner.id);
    if (ownerIds.length !== new Set(ownerIds).size) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Duplicate owner IDs found in the request');
    }

    // Validate car ID exists
    if (assignments.carId) {
      const car = await this.carService.findById(assignments.carId);
      if (!car) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`Car with id ${assignments.carId} not found`);
      }
      return await this.relCarOwnerService.bulkAssignOwners(assignments, user?.email);
    }

    // Validate trailer ID exists
    if (assignments.trailerId) {
      const trailer = await this.trailerService.findById(assignments.trailerId);
      if (!trailer) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`Trailer with id ${assignments.trailerId} not found`);
      }
      return await this.relTrailerOwnerService.bulkAssignOwners(assignments, user?.email);
    }
  }
}

// src/owner/owner.entity.ts
import { Entity, Column, OneToMany } from 'typeorm';
import { BaseEntity } from 'src/core/utils/base.entity';
import { RelCarOwner } from '../rel-car-owner/rel-car-owner.entity';
import { RelTrailerOwner } from '../rel-trailer-owner/rel-trailer-owner.entity';
import { transactionType } from 'src/core/enums/transaction-types';

@Entity('owners')
export class Owner extends BaseEntity {
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100 })
  name: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 20 })
  phone: string;

  @Column({
    type: 'enum',
    enum: transactionType,
    default: transactionType.BANK,
  })
  transactionType: transactionType;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100, nullable: true })
  email: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 255, nullable: true })
  address: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 50, nullable: true })
  paymentNumber: string;

  @Column({ type: 'text', nullable: true })
  notes: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 34, nullable: true })
  bankAccountNumber: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100, nullable: true })
  bankName: string;

  @OneToMany(() => RelCarOwner, (rel) => rel.owner, { cascade: true })
  carOwnerships: RelCarOwner[];

  @OneToMany(() => RelTrailerOwner, (rel) => rel.owner, { cascade: true })
  trailerOwnerships: RelTrailerOwner[];
}


===== FILE 221: src\app\modules\owner\owner.mapper.ts =====

// src/owner/owner.mapper.ts
import { Owner } from './owner.entity';
import { OwnerDTO } from './dtos/owner.dto';
import { CreateOwnerDTO } from './dtos/create-owner.dto';
import { UpdateOwnerDTO } from './dtos/update-owner.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { Car } from '../car/car.entity';
import { Trailer } from '../trailer/trailer.entity';

import { RelCarOwner } from '../rel-car-owner/rel-car-owner.entity';
import { RelTrailerOwner } from '../rel-trailer-owner/rel-trailer-owner.entity';
import { mapCarToCarDtoSelective } from '../car/car.mapper';
import { mapTrailerToTrailerDtoSelective } from '../trailer/trailer.mapper';

const allowedOwnerDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof OwnerDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'name',
  'phone',
  'address',
  'email',
  'bankAccountNumber',
  'bankName',
  'transactionType',
  'trailerOwnerships',
  'carOwnerships',
  'trailerOwnerships',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
] as const;

/**
 * Maps Owner entity to OwnerDTO selectively
 * Supports nested car/trailer in ownerships
 */
export function mapOwnerToOwnerDtoSelective(
  owner: Owner,
  keys?: (keyof OwnerDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<OwnerDTO>;
export function mapOwnerToOwnerDtoSelective(
  owners: Owner[],
  keys?: (keyof OwnerDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<OwnerDTO>[];
export function mapOwnerToOwnerDtoSelective(
  ownerOrOwners: Owner | Owner[],
  keys = allowedOwnerDtoKeys,
): Partial<OwnerDTO> | Partial<OwnerDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (owner: Owner): Partial<OwnerDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<OwnerDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = keys.filter((k) => allowedOwnerDtoKeys.includes(k as any));

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key === 'carOwnerships' && owner.carOwnerships && owner.carOwnerships.length > 0) {
        dto.carOwnerships = owner.carOwnerships.map((rel) => ({
          id: rel.id,
          percentage: rel.percentage,
          contractUrl: rel.contractUrl,
          notes: rel.notes,
          car: mapCarToCarDtoSelective(rel.car, [
            'id',
            'code',
            'manufactureYear',
            'manufacturer',
            'model',
            'plateNumber',
          ]) as any,
        }));
      } else if (
        key === 'trailerOwnerships' &&
        owner.trailerOwnerships &&
        owner.trailerOwnerships.length > 0
      ) {
        dto.trailerOwnerships = owner.trailerOwnerships.map((rel) => ({
          id: rel.id,
          percentage: rel.percentage,
          contractUrl: rel.contractUrl,
          notes: rel.notes,
          trailer: mapTrailerToTrailerDtoSelective(rel.trailer, [
            'id',
            'code',
            'manufactureYear',
            'manufacturer',
            'plateNumber',
          ]) as any,
        }));
      } else if (key in owner && owner[key as keyof Owner] !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = owner[key as keyof Owner];
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(ownerOrOwners) ? ownerOrOwners.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(ownerOrOwners);
}

/**
 * CreateOwnerDTO → Owner entity (with relations ready for cascade save)
 */
export function mapCreateOwnerDtoToEntity(dto: CreateOwnerDTO): Owner {
  const owner = new Owner();
  owner.name = dto.name;
  owner.phone = dto.phone;
  owner.email = dto.email;
  owner.address = dto.address;
  owner.paymentNumber = dto.paymentNumber;
  owner.transactionType = dto.transactionType;
  owner.notes = dto.notes;
  owner.bankAccountNumber = dto.bankAccountNumber;
  owner.bankName = dto.bankName;

  // Map car ownerships
  if (dto.carOwnerships?.length) {
    owner.carOwnerships = dto.carOwnerships.map((input) => {
      const rel = new RelCarOwner();
      rel.car = { id: input.carId } as Car;
      rel.percentage = input.percentage;
      return rel;
    });
  }

  // Map trailer ownerships
  if (dto.trailerOwnerships?.length) {
    owner.trailerOwnerships = dto.trailerOwnerships.map((input) => {
      const rel = new RelTrailerOwner();
      rel.trailer = { id: input.trailerId } as Trailer;
      rel.percentage = input.percentage;
      return rel;
    });
  }

  return owner;
}

/**
 * UpdateOwnerDTO → Existing Owner entity (full replace of ownerships)
 */
export function mapUpdateOwnerDtoToEntity(dto: UpdateOwnerDTO, existing: Owner): Owner {
  if (dto.name !== undefined) existing.name = dto.name;
  if (dto.phone !== undefined) existing.phone = dto.phone;
  if (dto.email !== undefined) existing.email = dto.email;
  if (dto.address !== undefined) existing.address = dto.address;
  if (dto.transactionType !== undefined) existing.transactionType = dto.transactionType;
  if (dto.paymentNumber !== undefined) existing.paymentNumber = dto.paymentNumber;
  if (dto.notes !== undefined) existing.notes = dto.notes;
  if (dto.bankAccountNumber !== undefined) existing.bankAccountNumber = dto.bankAccountNumber;
  if (dto.bankName !== undefined) existing.bankName = dto.bankName;

  if (dto.carOwnerships !== undefined) {
    // Full replace ownerships (cleanest with cascade: true)
    existing.carOwnerships = (dto.carOwnerships || []).map((input) => {
      const rel = new RelCarOwner();
      if (input.id) rel.id = input.id; // Keep ID if updating existing
      if (input.carId) rel.car = { id: input.carId } as Car;
      if (input.percentage !== undefined) rel.percentage = input.percentage;
      return rel;
    });
  }

  if (dto.trailerOwnerships !== undefined) {
    // Full replace ownerships (cleanest with cascade: true)
    existing.trailerOwnerships = (dto.trailerOwnerships || []).map((input) => {
      const rel = new RelTrailerOwner();
      if (input.id) rel.id = input.id; // Keep ID if updating existing
      if (input.trailerId) rel.trailer = { id: input.trailerId } as Trailer;
      if (input.percentage !== undefined) rel.percentage = input.percentage;
      return rel;
    });
  }

  return existing;
}

===== FILE 223: src\app\modules\owner\owner.service.ts =====

// src/owner/owner.service.ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { Owner } from './owner.entity';

@Injectable()
export class OwnerService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Owner)
    private ownerRepo: Repository<Owner>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number) {
    return this.ownerRepo.findOne({ where: { id } });
  }

  async findOne(options: FindOneOptions<Owner>) {
    return this.ownerRepo.findOne(options);
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<Owner>) {
    return this.ownerRepo.findOne(options);
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<Owner>) {
    return this.ownerRepo.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(owner: Owner, creator?: string): Promise<Owner> {
    const now = new Date();
    owner.createdAt = owner.createdAt ?? now;
    owner.updatedAt = now;
    if (creator) {
      owner.createdBy = owner.createdBy ?? creator;
      owner.updatedBy = creator;
    }
    return this.ownerRepo.save(owner); // TypeORM handles cascade!
  }

  async update(owner: Owner, updater?: string): Promise<Owner> {
    const now = new Date();
    if (updater) owner.updatedBy = updater;
    owner.updatedAt = now;
    return this.ownerRepo.save(owner);
  }

  async delete(id: number) {
    await this.ownerRepo.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 229: src\app\modules\price-type\price-type.controller.ts =====

import {
  BadRequestException,
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  Logger,
  NotFoundException,
  Param,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Post,
  Put,
  Query,
  Req,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, AuthUser, Roles, RolesGuard } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';

import { PriceTypeService } from './price-type.service';
import { PriceTypeDTO } from './dtos/price-type.dto';
import { CreatePriceTypeDTO } from './dtos/create-price-type.dto';
import { UpdatePriceTypeDTO } from './dtos/update-price-type.dto';
import { PriceTypeQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-price-type.dto';
import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';
import {
  mapCreatePriceTypeDtoToEntity,
  mapPriceTypeToPriceTypeDtoSelective,
  mapUpdatePriceTypeDtoToEntity,
} from './price-type.mapper';
import { PriceType } from './price-type.entity';
import { FindOptionsWhere } from 'typeorm';

@Controller('api/price-types')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('price-types-module')
export class PriceTypeController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('PriceTypeController');

  constructor(private readonly priceTypeService: PriceTypeService) {}

  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of price types paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List of price types',
    type: PriceTypeDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAllPriceTypes(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: PriceTypeQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<PriceTypeDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const whereConditions: FindOptionsWhere<PriceType> = {};
    if (query.name) {
      whereConditions.name = query.name;
    }

    const [results, count] = await this.priceTypeService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      where: whereConditions,
    });

    const dtos = mapPriceTypeToPriceTypeDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'description',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get price type by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Price type found', type: PriceTypeDTO })
  async getPriceTypeById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<PriceTypeDTO> {
    const existing = await this.priceTypeService.findByFields({
      where: { id },
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`PriceType with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapPriceTypeToPriceTypeDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'description',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]) as PriceTypeDTO;
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new price type' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: PriceTypeDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreatePriceTypeDTO, @AuthUser() user: UserDTO): Promise<PriceTypeDTO> {
    if (!dto.name) {
      throw new BadRequestException('name is required');
    }

    const entity = mapCreatePriceTypeDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.priceTypeService.save(entity, user?.email);
    return mapPriceTypeToPriceTypeDtoSelective(saved) as PriceTypeDTO;
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update price type' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: PriceTypeDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdatePriceTypeDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<PriceTypeDTO> {
    const existing = await this.priceTypeService.findByFields({
      where: { id },
    });
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`PriceType with id ${id} not found`);

    const entity = mapUpdatePriceTypeDtoToEntity(dto, existing);
    const updated = await this.priceTypeService.update(entity, user?.email);
    return mapPriceTypeToPriceTypeDtoSelective(updated) as PriceTypeDTO;
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete price type' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.priceTypeService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`PriceType with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.priceTypeService.delete(id);
  }
}

import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { PriceType } from './price-type.entity';
import { PriceTypeDTO } from './dtos/price-type.dto';
import { CreatePriceTypeDTO } from './dtos/create-price-type.dto';
import { UpdatePriceTypeDTO } from './dtos/update-price-type.dto';

const allowedPriceTypeDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof PriceTypeDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'name',
  'description',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
] as const;

export function mapPriceTypeToPriceTypeDtoSelective(
  priceType: PriceType,
  keys?: (keyof PriceTypeDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<PriceTypeDTO>;

export function mapPriceTypeToPriceTypeDtoSelective(
  priceTypes: PriceType[],
  keys?: (keyof PriceTypeDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<PriceTypeDTO>[];

export function mapPriceTypeToPriceTypeDtoSelective(
  data: PriceType | PriceType[],
  keys?: (keyof PriceTypeDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<PriceTypeDTO> | Partial<PriceTypeDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (priceType: PriceType): Partial<PriceTypeDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<PriceTypeDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedPriceTypeDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      (allowedPriceTypeDtoKeys as readonly string[]).includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in priceType && priceType[key as keyof PriceType] !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = priceType[key as keyof PriceType];
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(data) ? data.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(data);
}

export const mapCreatePriceTypeDtoToEntity = (dto: CreatePriceTypeDTO): PriceType => {
  const entity = new PriceType();

  entity.name = dto.name;
  entity.description = dto.description;

  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) entity.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return entity;
};

export const mapUpdatePriceTypeDtoToEntity = (
  dto: UpdatePriceTypeDTO,
  existing: PriceType,
): PriceType => {
  const entity = new PriceType();

  entity.id = existing.id;
  entity.createdAt = existing.createdAt;

  entity.name = dto.name ?? existing.name;
  entity.description = dto.description ?? existing.description;

  return entity;
};

===== FILE 233: src\app\modules\price-type\price-type.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { PriceType } from './price-type.entity';

@Injectable()
export class PriceTypeService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(PriceType)
    private readonly priceTypeRepository: Repository<PriceType>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<PriceType | undefined> {
    const result = await this.priceTypeRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<PriceType>): Promise<PriceType | undefined> {
    const result = await this.priceTypeRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<PriceType>): Promise<PriceType[] | undefined> {
    const result = await this.priceTypeRepository.find(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<PriceType>): Promise<[PriceType[], number]> {
    return this.priceTypeRepository.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(priceType: PriceType, creator?: string): Promise<PriceType> {
    const now = new Date();

    priceType.createdAt = priceType.createdAt ?? now;
    priceType.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      priceType.createdBy = priceType.createdBy ?? creator;
      priceType.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.priceTypeRepository.save(priceType);
  }

  async update(priceType: PriceType, updater?: string): Promise<PriceType> {
    const now = new Date();

    priceType.updatedAt = now;
    if (updater) priceType.updatedBy = updater;

    return await this.priceTypeRepository.save(priceType);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.priceTypeRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

// src/rel-car-owner/rel-car-owner.mapper.ts

import { RelCarOwner } from './rel-car-owner.entity';
import { Car } from '../car/car.entity';
import { BulkAssignOwnerDTO } from '../owner/dtos/bulk-assign.dto';
import { Owner } from '../owner/owner.entity';

export function mapBulkAssignCarOwnersToEntities(dto: BulkAssignOwnerDTO): RelCarOwner[] {
  const entities: RelCarOwner[] = [];

  dto.owners.forEach((input) => {
    const rel = new RelCarOwner();

    // Assign car by ID (no need to load it)
    rel.car = { id: dto.carId } as Car;

    // Assign owner by ID only — cascade save handled by service
    rel.owner = { id: input.id } as Owner;

    // Simple fields
    rel.percentage = input.percentage ?? null;
    rel.contractUrl = input.contractUrl ?? null;
    rel.notes = input.notes ?? null;

    entities.push(rel);
  });

  return entities;
}

===== FILE 241: src\app\modules\rel-car-owner\rel-car-owner.services.ts =====

// src/rel-car-owner/rel-car-owner.service.ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, In } from 'typeorm';
import { RelCarOwner } from './rel-car-owner.entity';
import { BulkAssignOwnerDTO } from '../owner/dtos/bulk-assign.dto';
import { mapBulkAssignCarOwnersToEntities } from './rel-car-owner.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class RelCarOwnerService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(RelCarOwner)
    private readonly relCarOwnerRepo: Repository<RelCarOwner>,
  ) {}

  async bulkAssignOwners(dto: BulkAssignOwnerDTO, user: string) {
    const relations = mapBulkAssignCarOwnersToEntities(dto);
    const ownerIds = relations.map((rel) => rel.owner.id);

    // Find existing relationships for this car and these owners
    const existingRelations = await this.relCarOwnerRepo.find({
      where: {
        car: { id: dto.carId },
        owner: { id: In(ownerIds) },
      },
      relations: ['owner'],
    });

    const existingMap = new Map(existingRelations.map((rel) => [rel.owner.id, rel]));

    // Prepare relationships: update existing, keep new ones
    const toSave = relations.map((newRel) => {
      const existing = existingMap.get(newRel.owner.id);
      if (existing) {
        // Update existing relationship
        existing.percentage = newRel.percentage;
        existing.contractUrl = newRel.contractUrl;
        existing.notes = newRel.notes;
        existing.updatedBy = user;
        return existing;
      }
      // New relationship
      newRel.createdBy = user;
      newRel.updatedBy = user;
      return newRel;
    });

    return await this.relCarOwnerRepo.save(toSave);
  }
}

===== FILE 248: src\app\modules\salary\salary.controller.ts =====

import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  Get,
  Req,
  Query,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { SalaryService } from './salary.service';
import { SalaryDTO } from './dtos/salary.dto';
import { CreateSalaryDTO } from './dtos/create-salary.dto';
import { UpdateSalaryDTO } from './dtos/update-salary.dto';
import { SalaryQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-salary.dto';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import {
  mapCreateSalaryDtoToEntity,
  mapSalaryToSalaryDtoSelective,
  mapUpdateSalaryDtoToEntity,
} from './salary.mapper';
import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';
import { UserService } from '../user/user.service';

@Controller('api/salaries')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('salaries-module')
export class SalaryController {
  logger = new Logger('SalaryController');

  constructor(
    private readonly salaryService: SalaryService,
    private readonly userService: UserService,
  ) {}

  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get the list of salaries paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List all salaries',
    type: SalaryDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAllSalaries(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: SalaryQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<SalaryDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest: PageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const [results, count] = await this.salaryService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      relations: ['user'],
    });

    const salaryDtos = mapSalaryToSalaryDtoSelective(
      results,
      ['id', 'salaryType', 'salaryAmount', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt'],
      true,
    );

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return salaryDtos;
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new salary record' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: SalaryDTO })
  async create(
    @Body() createSalaryDTO: CreateSalaryDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<SalaryDTO> {
    const existing = await this.salaryService.findByFields({
      where: { user: { id: createSalaryDTO.userId } },
    });

    if (existing) throw new BadRequestException(`Salary record already exists for this user`);

    const mappedSalary = mapCreateSalaryDtoToEntity(createSalaryDTO);

    const existingUser = await this.userService.findByFields({
      where: { id: createSalaryDTO.userId },
    });

    if (!existingUser) {
      throw new BadRequestException(`User with id ${createSalaryDTO.userId} does not exist`);
    }
    return this.salaryService.save(mappedSalary, user?.email);
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update existing salary record' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: SalaryDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id') id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateSalaryDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<UpdateSalaryDTO> {
    const existing = await this.salaryService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Salary with id ${id} not found`);

    dto.id = id;

    const mappedSalary = mapUpdateSalaryDtoToEntity(dto, existing);

    return this.salaryService.update(mappedSalary, user?.email);
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete salary record' })
  async delete(@Param('id') id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.salaryService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Salary with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.salaryService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

===== FILE 250: src\app\modules\salary\salary.mapper.ts =====

import { Salary } from './salary.entity';
import { SalaryDTO } from './dtos/salary.dto';
import { CreateSalaryDTO } from './dtos/create-salary.dto';
import { UpdateSalaryDTO } from './dtos/update-salary.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { mapUserToUserDtoSelective } from '../user/user.mapper';
import { User } from '../user/user.entity';

const allowedSalaryDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof SalaryDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'salaryType',
  'salaryAmount',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
];

/**
 * Maps Salary entity/entities to SalaryDTO selectively.
 *
 * @param salaryOrSalaries - A Salary entity or an array of them.
 * @param keys - Optional list of keys to include (filtered by allowed keys).
 * @param includeUser - Whether to include the related user (mapped with `mapUserToUserDtoSelective`).
 */
export function mapSalaryToSalaryDtoSelective(
  salary: Salary,
  keys?: (keyof SalaryDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
  includeUser?: boolean,
): Partial<SalaryDTO>;
export function mapSalaryToSalaryDtoSelective(
  salaries: Salary[],
  keys?: (keyof SalaryDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
  includeUser?: boolean,
): Partial<SalaryDTO>[];
export function mapSalaryToSalaryDtoSelective(
  salaryOrSalaries: Salary | Salary[],
  keys?: (keyof SalaryDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
  includeUser = false,
): Partial<SalaryDTO> | Partial<SalaryDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (salary: Salary): Partial<SalaryDTO> => {
    const resultDto: Partial<SalaryDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedSalaryDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedSalaryDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in salary && salary[key as keyof Salary] !== undefined) {
        (resultDto as any)[key] = salary[key as keyof Salary];
      }
    });

    // Optionally include related user
    if (includeUser && salary.user) {
      (resultDto as any).user = mapUserToUserDtoSelective(salary.user);
    }

    return resultDto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(salaryOrSalaries)
    ? salaryOrSalaries.map(mapSingle)
    : mapSingle(salaryOrSalaries);
}

/**
 * Maps CreateSalaryDTO to Salary entity.
 */
export function mapCreateSalaryDtoToEntity(dto: CreateSalaryDTO): Salary {
  const entity = new Salary();
  entity.salaryType = dto.salaryType;
  entity.salaryAmount = dto.salaryAmount;

  // If userId is provided (foreign key relation)
  if (dto.userId) {
    entity.user = new User();
    entity.user.id = dto.userId;
  }

  entity.createdBy = dto.createdBy;
  return entity;
}

/**
 * Maps UpdateSalaryDTO to an existing Salary entity.
 */
export function mapUpdateSalaryDtoToEntity(dto: UpdateSalaryDTO, existing: SalaryDTO): Salary {
  if (dto.id !== undefined) existing.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.salaryType !== undefined) existing.salaryType = dto.salaryType;
  if (dto.salaryAmount !== undefined) existing.salaryAmount = dto.salaryAmount;
  if (dto.updatedBy !== undefined) existing.updatedBy = dto.updatedBy;

  return existing as Salary;
}

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { Salary } from './salary.entity';
import { SalaryDTO } from './dtos/salary.dto';
import { UpdateSalaryDTO } from './dtos/update-salary.dto';

@Injectable()
export class SalaryService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Salary)
    private salaryRepository: Repository<Salary>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<SalaryDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.salaryRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<UpdateSalaryDTO>): Promise<SalaryDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.salaryRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<UpdateSalaryDTO>): Promise<Salary | undefined> {
    const result = await this.salaryRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<SalaryDTO>): Promise<[Salary[], number]> {
    const resultList = await this.salaryRepository.findAndCount(options);
    return resultList;
  }

  async save(salaryDTO: SalaryDTO, creator?: string): Promise<Salary> {
    const entity = this.salaryRepository.create({
      ...salaryDTO,
      createdBy: creator,
      updatedBy: creator,
      createdAt: new Date(),
    });
    return this.salaryRepository.save(entity);
  }

  async update(salaryDTO: UpdateSalaryDTO, updater?: string): Promise<UpdateSalaryDTO> {
    const entity = this.salaryRepository.create({
      ...salaryDTO,
      updatedBy: updater,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    });
    await this.salaryRepository.update({ id: salaryDTO.id }, entity);
    return salaryDTO;
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.salaryRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import { TireService } from './tire.service';
import { TireDTO } from './dtos/tire.dto';
import { UpdateTireDTO } from './dtos/update-tire.dto';
import { mapUpdateTireDtoToEntity } from './tire.mapper';
import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';

@Controller('api/tires')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('tires-module')
export class TireController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('TireController');

  constructor(private readonly tireService: TireService) {}

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update existing tire record' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Tire updated', type: TireDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id') id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateTireDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<TireDTO> {
    const existing = await this.tireService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Tire with id ${id} not found`);
    }

    // Preserve ID in DTO for mapper
    dto.id = id;

    const mappedTire = mapUpdateTireDtoToEntity(dto);

    return this.tireService.update(mappedTire, user?.email);
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete tire record' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Tire deleted' })
  async delete(@Param('id') id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.tireService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Tire with id ${id} not found`);
    }

    await this.tireService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

===== FILE 259: src\app\modules\tire\tire.mapper.ts =====

import { Tire } from './tire.entity';
import { TireDTO } from './dtos/tire.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { CreateTireDTO } from './dtos/create-tire.dto';
import { UpdateTireDTO } from './dtos/update-tire.dto';
import { Axle } from '../axle/axle.entity';

/**
 * Defines allowed keys for mapping from Tire entity to DTO.
 * Include all scalar fields and base metadata.
 */
const allowedTireDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof TireDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'serialNumber',
  'type',
  'healthPercentage',
  'location',
  'createdDate',
  'axle',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
  'deletedAt',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'deletedBy',
];

/**
 * Maps a Tire entity (or array) to TireDTO(s) with selective field inclusion.
 */
export function mapTireToTireDtoSelective(
  entity: Tire,
  keys?: (keyof TireDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): UpdateTireDTO;
export function mapTireToTireDtoSelective(
  entities: Tire[],
  keys?: (keyof TireDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): UpdateTireDTO[];
export function mapTireToTireDtoSelective(
  input: Tire | Tire[],
  keys?: (keyof TireDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): UpdateTireDTO | UpdateTireDTO[] {
  const mapSingle = (entity: Tire): UpdateTireDTO => {
    const resultDto: UpdateTireDTO = {} as UpdateTireDTO;

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedTireDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedTireDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in entity && entity[key as keyof Tire] !== undefined) {
        (resultDto as any)[key] = entity[key as keyof Tire];
      }
    });

    return resultDto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(input) ? input.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(input);
}

/**
 * Maps a CreateTireDTO to a new Tire entity.
 * Used when creating new records before saving to DB.
 */
export function mapCreateTireDtoToEntity(dto: CreateTireDTO | CreateTireDTO[]): Tire | Tire[] {
  const mapSingle = (item: CreateTireDTO): Tire => {
    const tire = new Tire();

    if (item.serialNumber !== undefined) tire.serialNumber = item.serialNumber;
    if (item.type !== undefined) tire.type = item.type;
    if (item.healthPercentage !== undefined) tire.healthPercentage = item.healthPercentage;
    if (item.location !== undefined) tire.location = item.location;
    if (item.createdDate !== undefined) tire.createdDate = item.createdDate;

    if (item.axleId) {
      tire.axle = new Axle();
      tire.axle.id = item.axleId;
    }

    return tire;
  };

  return Array.isArray(dto) ? dto.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(dto);
}

/**
 * Maps an UpdateTireDTO to an existing Tire entity.
 * Only defined fields in the DTO will update the entity.
 */
export function mapUpdateTireDtoToEntity(dto: UpdateTireDTO, existingTire?: Tire): Tire;
export function mapUpdateTireDtoToEntity(dto: UpdateTireDTO[], existingTires?: Tire[]): Tire[];
export function mapUpdateTireDtoToEntity(
  dto: UpdateTireDTO | UpdateTireDTO[],
  existing?: Tire | Tire[],
): Tire | Tire[] {
  const mapOne = (item: UpdateTireDTO, existingTire?: Tire): Tire => {
    const tire = existingTire ?? new Tire();

    if (item.id !== undefined) tire.id = item.id;
    if (item.serialNumber !== undefined) tire.serialNumber = item.serialNumber;
    if (item.type !== undefined) tire.type = item.type;
    if (item.healthPercentage !== undefined) tire.healthPercentage = item.healthPercentage;
    if (item.location !== undefined) tire.location = item.location;
    if (item.createdDate !== undefined) tire.createdDate = item.createdDate;

    if (item.axle !== undefined) tire.axle = item.axle as Axle;

    return tire;
  };

  if (Array.isArray(dto)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(existing)) {
      return dto.map((item) => mapOne(item));
    }
    return dto.map((item, index) => mapOne(item, existing[index]));
  }

  return mapOne(dto, Array.isArray(existing) ? undefined : existing);
}

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';

@Injectable()
export class TireService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Tire)
    private tireRepository: Repository<Tire>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<TireDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.tireRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

    const result = await this.tireRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

    return result || undefined;
