===== FILE 265: src\app\modules\tire-model\tire-model.controller.ts =====

import { Controller, Get, Post, Delete, Param, Query, Body, Req } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { TireModelService } from './tire-model.service';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import { Roles } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import { TireModelDTO } from './dtos/tire-model.dto';
import { TireModelQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-tire-model.dto';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { CreateTireModelDTO } from './dtos/create-tire-model.dto';
import { mapTireModelToDtoSelective } from './tire-model.mapper';

@ApiTags('Tire Models')
@Controller('api/tire-models')
export class TireModelController {
  constructor(private readonly tireModelService: TireModelService) {}

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET ALL PAGINATED
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of tire models paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    type: TireModelDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAll(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: TireModelQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<TireModelDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const where: any = {};

    if (query.name) where.name = query.name;

    const [results, count] = await this.tireModelService.findAndCount({
      where,
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
    });

    const dtos = mapTireModelToDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
    ]);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a tire model' })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateTireModelDTO, @Req() req: Request) {
    return await this.tireModelService.create(
      {
        name: dto.name,
      },
      req.user?.username,
    );
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  async delete(@Param('id') id: number) {
    await this.tireModelService.delete(id);
    return { message: 'Tire model deleted' };
  }
}

 */

export function mapTireModelToDtoSelective(
  modelOrList: TireModel | TireModelDTO | (TireModel | TireModelDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof TireModelDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TireModelDTO> | Partial<TireModelDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (model: TireModel | TireModelDTO): Partial<TireModelDTO> => {

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, FindManyOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { TireModel } from './tire-model.entity';

@Injectable()
export class TireModelService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(TireModel)
    private readonly tireModelRepo: Repository<TireModel>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<TireModel | undefined> {
    return (await this.tireModelRepo.findOne({ where: { id } })) ?? undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<TireModel>): Promise<TireModel[]> {
    return await this.tireModelRepo.find(options);
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<TireModel>): Promise<[TireModel[], number]> {
    return await this.tireModelRepo.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async create(data: Partial<TireModel>, creator?: string): Promise<TireModel> {
    const now = new Date();
    const entity = this.tireModelRepo.create({
      ...data,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      createdBy: creator,
      updatedBy: creator,
    });
    return await this.tireModelRepo.save(entity);
  }

  async update(model: TireModel, updater?: string): Promise<TireModel> {
    model.updatedAt = new Date();
    if (updater) model.updatedBy = updater;
    return await this.tireModelRepo.save(model);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.tireModelRepo.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 274: src\app\modules\trailer\trailer.controller.ts =====

// src/trailer/trailer.controller.ts
import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Get,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  Req,
  Query,
  ParseIntPipe,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';

import { TrailerService } from './trailer.service';
import { AxleService } from '../axle/axle.service';

import { TrailerDTO } from './dtos/trailer.dto';
import { CreateTrailerDTO } from './dtos/create-trailer.dto';
import { UpdateTrailerDTO } from './dtos/update-trailer.dto';
import { QueryTrailerDto } from './dtos/query-trailer.dto';

import {
  mapTrailerToTrailerDtoSelective,
  mapCreateTrailerDtoToEntity,
  mapUpdateTrailerDtoToEntity,
} from './trailer.mapper';

@Controller('api/trailers')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('trailers-module')
export class TrailerController {
  logger = new Logger('TrailerController');

  constructor(
    private readonly trailerService: TrailerService,
    private readonly axleService: AxleService,
  ) {}

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET ALL (PAGINATED)
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of trailers (paginated)' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'List all trailers', type: TrailerDTO, isArray: true })
  async getAllTrailers(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: QueryTrailerDto,
  ): Promise<Partial<TrailerDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest: PageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const [results, count] = await this.trailerService.findAndCount({
      skip: pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
    });

    const trailerDtos = mapTrailerToTrailerDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'code',
      'chaseType',
      'manufacturer',
      'status',
      'manufactureYear',
      'color',
      'maxWeight',
      'plateNumber',
      'plateLetters',
      'chassisNumber',
      'licenseNumber',
      'licenseExpiryDate',
      'notes',
      'ownerShip',
      'Ownerships',
      'createdAt',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedAt',
      'updatedBy',
    ]);

    // Pagination Headers
    req.res!.setHeader('X-Total-Count', count);
    req.res!.setHeader('X-Page', pageRequest.page);
    req.res!.setHeader(
      'X-Has-Next-Page',
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size ? 'true' : 'false',
    );

    return trailerDtos;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET BY ID
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get trailer by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Trailer found', type: TrailerDTO })
  async getTrailerById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<UpdateTrailerDTO> {
    const existing = await this.trailerService.find({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['axles', 'trailerAttachments', 'Ownerships', 'axles.tires', 'Ownerships.owner'], // match entity names
    });

    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Trailer with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapTrailerToTrailerDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'code',
      'chaseType',
      'manufacturer',
      'status',
      'manufactureYear',
      'color',
      'maxWeight',
      'plateNumber',
      'plateLetters',
      'chassisNumber',
      'licenseNumber',
      'licenseExpiryDate',
      'axleCount',
      'notes',
      'ownerShip',
      'axles',
      'Ownerships',
      'trailerAttachments',
      'createdAt',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedAt',
      'updatedBy',
    ]);
  }
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new trailer' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Trailer created', type: TrailerDTO })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateTrailerDTO, @AuthUser() user: any): Promise<Partial<TrailerDTO>> {
    // Validate axles exist
    if (dto.axles && dto.axles.length > 0) {
      for (const axleId of dto.axles) {
        const axle = await this.axleService.findByFields({ where: { id: axleId } });
        if (!axle) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`Axle with id ${axleId} does not exist`);
        }
      }
    }

    const mapped = mapCreateTrailerDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.trailerService.save(mapped, user?.email);

    return mapTrailerToTrailerDtoSelective(saved, [
      'id',
      'code',
      'chaseType',
      'manufacturer',
      'status',
      'manufactureYear',
      'color',
      'maxWeight',
      'plateNumber',
      'plateLetters',
      'chassisNumber',
      'licenseNumber',
      'licenseExpiryDate',
      'ownerShip',
      'axles',
      'notes',
      'createdAt',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedAt',
      'updatedBy',
    ]);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update trailer' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Trailer updated', type: TrailerDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateTrailerDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<TrailerDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.trailerService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Trailer with id ${id} not found`);

    dto.id = id;

    // UNIQUE: code
    if (dto.code && dto.code !== existing.code) {
      const codeCheck = await this.trailerService.findByFields({ where: { code: dto.code } });
      if (codeCheck) throw new BadRequestException(`Trailer with code ${dto.code} already exists`);
    }

    // Validate axles exist
    if (dto.axles) {
      for (const axleDto of dto.axles) {
        const axle = await this.axleService.findByFields({ where: { id: axleDto.id } });
        if (!axle) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`Axle with id ${axleDto.id} does not exist`);
        }
      }
    }

    const mapped = mapUpdateTrailerDtoToEntity(dto);
    const updated = await this.trailerService.update(mapped, user?.email);

    return updated;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete trailer' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.trailerService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Trailer with id ${id} not found`);
    await this.trailerService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

import { Entity, Column, Index, OneToMany, JoinColumn } from 'typeorm';
import { BaseEntity } from 'src/core/utils/base.entity';
import { TrailerAttachment } from '../trailer-attachment/trailer-attachment.entity';
import { Axle } from '../axle/axle.entity';
import { OwnerShipType } from 'src/core/enums/ownerShip-types';
import { RelTrailerOwner } from '../rel-trailer-owner/rel-trailer-owner.entity';
import { VeachleStatus } from 'src/core/enums/veachle-status';

@Entity('trailers')
export class Trailer extends BaseEntity {
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 50 })
  code: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100, nullable: true })
  chaseType: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100 })
  manufacturer: string;

  @Column({ type: 'enum', enum: VeachleStatus, default: VeachleStatus.UNAVILABLE })
  status: VeachleStatus;

  // Manufacturing year
  @Column({ type: 'int' })
  manufactureYear: number;

  // Trailer color
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 30 })
  color: string;

  // Maximum weight capacity
  @Column({ type: 'int' })
  maxWeight: number;

  // License plate number
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 20 })
  plateNumber: string;

  // License plate letters
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 10 })
  plateLetters: string;

  // Chassis / VIN
  @Index({ unique: true })
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 50 })
  chassisNumber: string;

  // Trailer license number
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 50 })
  licenseNumber: string;

  // License expiration date
  @Column({ type: 'date' })
  licenseExpiryDate: Date;

  @Column({ type: 'int' })
  axleCount: number;

  @Column({ type: 'text', nullable: true })
  notes?: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 50, nullable: true })
  ownerShip: OwnerShipType;

  // Trailer Attachments
  @OneToMany(() => TrailerAttachment, (att) => att.trailer, {
    cascade: true,
    eager: true,
    onDelete: 'CASCADE',
  })
  trailerAttachments?: TrailerAttachment[];

  @OneToMany(() => Axle, (axle) => axle.trailer, { cascade: true, eager: true })
  @JoinColumn()
  axles?: Axle[];

  // Trailer Owners
  @OneToMany(() => RelTrailerOwner, (rel) => rel.trailer, {
    cascade: true,
    eager: true,
  })
  Ownerships?: RelTrailerOwner[];
}


===== FILE 276: src\app\modules\trailer\trailer.mapper.ts =====

import { Trailer } from './trailer.entity';
import { TrailerDTO } from './dtos/trailer.dto';
import { CreateTrailerDTO } from './dtos/create-trailer.dto';
import { UpdateTrailerDTO } from './dtos/update-trailer.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';

/**
 * Allowed DTO keys for selective mapping.
 * Ensures security and prevents exposing extra fields.
 */
const allowedTrailerDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof TrailerDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'code',
  'chaseType',
  'manufacturer',
  'status',
  'manufactureYear',
  'color',
  'maxWeight',
  'plateNumber',
  'plateLetters',
  'chassisNumber',
  'licenseNumber',
  'licenseExpiryDate',
  'ownerShip',
  'axles',
  'Ownerships',
  'trailerAttachments',
  'axleCount',
  'notes',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
];

/**
 * Selective Trailer → TrailerDTO mapper
 */
export function mapTrailerToTrailerDtoSelective(
  trailer: Trailer,
  keys?: (keyof TrailerDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TrailerDTO>;
export function mapTrailerToTrailerDtoSelective(
  trailers: Trailer[],
  keys?: (keyof TrailerDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TrailerDTO>[];
export function mapTrailerToTrailerDtoSelective(
  trailerOrTrailers: Trailer | Trailer[],
  keys?: (keyof TrailerDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TrailerDTO> | Partial<TrailerDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (trailer: Trailer): Partial<TrailerDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<TrailerDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedTrailerDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedTrailerDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in trailer && trailer[key as keyof Trailer] !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = trailer[key as keyof Trailer];
      }

      // Special relations
      if (key === 'axles' && trailer.axles) {
        dto.axles = trailer.axles;
      }
      if (key === 'Ownerships' && trailer.Ownerships) {
        dto.Ownerships = trailer.Ownerships;
      }
      if (key === 'trailerAttachments' && trailer.trailerAttachments) {
        dto.trailerAttachments = trailer.trailerAttachments;
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(trailerOrTrailers)
    ? trailerOrTrailers.map(mapSingle)
    : mapSingle(trailerOrTrailers);
}

/**
 * CreateTrailerDTO → Trailer Entity
 */
export const mapCreateTrailerDtoToEntity = (dto: CreateTrailerDTO): Trailer => {
  const trailer = new Trailer();

  trailer.code = dto.code;
  if (dto.chaseType !== undefined) trailer.chaseType = dto.chaseType;
  trailer.manufacturer = dto.manufacturer;
  trailer.status = dto.status;
  trailer.manufactureYear = dto.manufactureYear;
  trailer.color = dto.color;
  trailer.maxWeight = dto.maxWeight;
  trailer.plateNumber = dto.plateNumber;
  trailer.plateLetters = dto.plateLetters;
  trailer.chassisNumber = dto.chassisNumber;
  trailer.licenseNumber = dto.licenseNumber;
  trailer.licenseExpiryDate = new Date(dto.licenseExpiryDate);

  // Use axleCount from request if provided, otherwise calculate from axles array
  if (dto.axleCount !== undefined) {
    trailer.axleCount = dto.axleCount;
  } else {
    trailer.axleCount = dto.axles ? dto.axles.length : 0;
  }

  if (dto.ownerShip !== undefined) {
    trailer.ownerShip = dto.ownerShip;
  }

  trailer.notes = dto.notes;

  return trailer;
};

/**
 * UpdateTrailerDTO → Trailer Entity
 */
export const mapUpdateTrailerDtoToEntity = (dto: UpdateTrailerDTO): Trailer => {
  const trailer = new Trailer();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) trailer.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.code !== undefined) trailer.code = dto.code;
  if (dto.chaseType !== undefined) trailer.chaseType = dto.chaseType;
  if (dto.manufacturer !== undefined) trailer.manufacturer = dto.manufacturer;
  if (dto.status !== undefined) trailer.status = dto.status;
  if (dto.manufactureYear !== undefined) trailer.manufactureYear = dto.manufactureYear;
  if (dto.color !== undefined) trailer.color = dto.color;
  if (dto.maxWeight !== undefined) trailer.maxWeight = dto.maxWeight;
  if (dto.plateNumber !== undefined) trailer.plateNumber = dto.plateNumber;
  if (dto.plateLetters !== undefined) trailer.plateLetters = dto.plateLetters;
  if (dto.chassisNumber !== undefined) trailer.chassisNumber = dto.chassisNumber;
  if (dto.licenseNumber !== undefined) trailer.licenseNumber = dto.licenseNumber;
  if (dto.ownerShip !== undefined) trailer.ownerShip = dto.ownerShip;

  if (dto.licenseExpiryDate !== undefined) {
    trailer.licenseExpiryDate = new Date(dto.licenseExpiryDate);
  }

  // Use axleCount from request if provided, otherwise calculate from axles array if provided
  if (dto.axleCount !== undefined) {
    trailer.axleCount = dto.axleCount;
  } else if (dto.axles !== undefined && Array.isArray(dto.axles)) {
    trailer.axleCount = dto.axles.length;
  }

  if (dto.notes !== undefined) trailer.notes = dto.notes;

  return trailer;
};

===== FILE 278: src\app\modules\trailer\trailer.service.ts =====

// src/trailer/trailer.service.ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Trailer } from './trailer.entity';
import { TrailerDTO } from './dtos/trailer.dto';
import { UpdateTrailerDTO } from './dtos/update-trailer.dto';
import { generateUniqueCode } from 'src/core/utils/generator';
import { GeneratorTypes } from 'src/core/enums/generator-types';

@Injectable()
export class TrailerService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Trailer)
    private trailerRepository: Repository<Trailer>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<TrailerDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.trailerRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<UpdateTrailerDTO>): Promise<TrailerDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.trailerRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<UpdateTrailerDTO>): Promise<Trailer | undefined> {
    const result = await this.trailerRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<TrailerDTO>): Promise<[Trailer[], number]> {
    return await this.trailerRepository.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(trailer: Trailer, creator?: string): Promise<Trailer> {
    const now = new Date();

    trailer.code = await generateUniqueCode(this.trailerRepository, GeneratorTypes.TRAILER);

    trailer.createdAt = trailer.createdAt ?? now;
    trailer.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      trailer.createdBy = trailer.createdBy ?? creator;
      trailer.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.trailerRepository.save(trailer);
  }

  async update(trailer: Trailer, updater?: string): Promise<Trailer> {
    const now = new Date();

    if (updater) {
      trailer.updatedBy = updater;
    }

    trailer.updatedAt = now;

    return await this.trailerRepository.save(trailer);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.trailerRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

import { ApiProperty, ApiPropertyOptional } from '@nestjs/swagger';

import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  Get,
  ParseIntPipe,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';

import { TrailerAttachmentService } from './trailer-attachment.service';
import { TrailerService } from '../trailer/trailer.service';

import { TrailerAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/trailer-attachment.dto';
import { CreateTrailerAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/create-trailer-attachment.dto';
import { UpdateTrailerAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/update-trailer-attachment.dto';

import {
  mapTrailerAttachmentToDtoSelective,
  mapCreateTrailerAttachmentDtoToEntity,
  mapUpdateTrailerAttachmentDtoToEntity,
} from './trailer-attachment.mapper';

@Controller('api/trailer-attachments')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('trailer-attachments-module')
export class TrailerAttachmentController {
  logger = new Logger('TrailerAttachmentController');

  constructor(
    private readonly attachmentService: TrailerAttachmentService,
    private readonly trailerService: TrailerService,
  ) {}

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET BY ID
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get trailer attachment by ID' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Trailer attachment found', type: TrailerAttachmentDTO })
  async getById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<Partial<TrailerAttachmentDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Trailer attachment with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapTrailerAttachmentToDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'trailer',
      'type',
      'documentExpiryDate',
      'url',
      'notes',
      'createdAt',
      'createdBy',
    ]);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new trailer attachment' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: 'Trailer attachment created',
    type: TrailerAttachmentDTO,
  })
  async create(
    @Body() dto: CreateTrailerAttachmentDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<TrailerAttachmentDTO>> {
    const trailer = await this.trailerService.findByFields({ where: { id: dto.trailerId } });
    if (!trailer) throw new NotFoundException(`Trailer with id ${dto.trailerId} not found`);

    const mapped = mapCreateTrailerAttachmentDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.attachmentService.save(mapped, user?.email);

    return mapTrailerAttachmentToDtoSelective(saved);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update trailer attachment' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Trailer attachment updated',
    type: TrailerAttachmentDTO,
  })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateTrailerAttachmentDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<TrailerAttachmentDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Trailer attachment with id ${id} not found`);

    dto.id = id;
    const mapped = mapUpdateTrailerAttachmentDtoToEntity(dto);
    const updated = await this.attachmentService.update(mapped, user?.email);

    return mapTrailerAttachmentToDtoSelective(updated);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete trailer attachment' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Trailer attachment with id ${id} not found`);
    await this.attachmentService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

===== FILE 285: src\app\modules\trailer-attachment\trailer-attachment.mapper.ts =====

// src/trailer-attachment/trailer-attachment.mapper.ts
import { TrailerAttachment } from './trailer-attachment.entity';
import { TrailerAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/trailer-attachment.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { CreateTrailerAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/create-trailer-attachment.dto';
import { UpdateTrailerAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/update-trailer-attachment.dto';
import { Trailer } from '../trailer/trailer.entity';

const allowedTrailerAttachmentDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof TrailerAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'trailer',
  'type',
  'documentExpiryDate',
  'url',
  'notes',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
];

export function mapTrailerAttachmentToDtoSelective(
  attachment: TrailerAttachment,
  keys?: (keyof TrailerAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TrailerAttachmentDTO>;
export function mapTrailerAttachmentToDtoSelective(
  attachments: TrailerAttachment[],
  keys?: (keyof TrailerAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TrailerAttachmentDTO>[];
export function mapTrailerAttachmentToDtoSelective(
  attachmentOrAttachments: TrailerAttachment | TrailerAttachment[],
  keys?: (keyof TrailerAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TrailerAttachmentDTO> | Partial<TrailerAttachmentDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (attachment: TrailerAttachment): Partial<TrailerAttachmentDTO> => {
    const resultDto: Partial<TrailerAttachmentDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedTrailerAttachmentDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedTrailerAttachmentDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in attachment && attachment[key as keyof TrailerAttachment] !== undefined) {
        (resultDto as any)[key] = attachment[key as keyof TrailerAttachment];
      }
    });

    return resultDto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(attachmentOrAttachments)
    ? attachmentOrAttachments.map(mapSingle)
    : mapSingle(attachmentOrAttachments);
}

export const mapCreateTrailerAttachmentDtoToEntity = (
  dto: CreateTrailerAttachmentDTO,
): TrailerAttachment => {
  const attachment = new TrailerAttachment();
  if (dto.trailerId) {
    attachment.trailer = new Trailer();
    attachment.trailer.id = dto.trailerId;
  }
  attachment.type = dto.type;
  attachment.documentExpiryDate = dto.documentExpiryDate;
  attachment.url = dto.url;
  attachment.notes = dto.notes;

  return attachment;
};

export const mapUpdateTrailerAttachmentDtoToEntity = (
  dto: UpdateTrailerAttachmentDTO,
): TrailerAttachment => {
  const attachment = new TrailerAttachment();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) attachment.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.type !== undefined) attachment.type = dto.type;
  if (dto.documentExpiryDate !== undefined) attachment.documentExpiryDate = dto.documentExpiryDate;
  if (dto.url !== undefined) attachment.url = dto.url;
  if (dto.notes !== undefined) attachment.notes = dto.notes;

  return attachment;
};

// src/trailer-attachment/trailer-attachment.service.ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { TrailerAttachment } from './trailer-attachment.entity';
import { UpdateTrailerAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/update-trailer-attachment.dto';

@Injectable()
export class TrailerAttachmentService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(TrailerAttachment)
    private attachmentRepository: Repository<TrailerAttachment>,
  ) {}

  // Return ENTITY
  async findById(id: number): Promise<TrailerAttachment | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(
    options: FindOneOptions<UpdateTrailerAttachmentDTO>,
  ): Promise<TrailerAttachment | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<TrailerAttachment>): Promise<TrailerAttachment | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async save(attachment: TrailerAttachment, creator?: string): Promise<TrailerAttachment> {
    const now = new Date();
    attachment.createdAt = attachment.createdAt ?? now;
    attachment.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      attachment.createdBy = attachment.createdBy ?? creator;
      attachment.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.attachmentRepository.save(attachment);
  }

  async update(attachment: TrailerAttachment, updater?: string): Promise<TrailerAttachment> {
    const now = new Date();
    if (updater) attachment.updatedBy = updater;
    attachment.updatedAt = now;
    return await this.attachmentRepository.save(attachment);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.attachmentRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  Get,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Query,
  Req,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';

import { TrailerManufacturerService } from './trailer-manufacturer.service';

import { TrailerManufacturerDTO } from './dtos/trailer-manufacturer.dto';
import { CreateTrailerManufacturerDTO } from './dtos/create-trailer-manufacturer.dto';

import {
  mapTrailerManufacturerToDtoSelective,
  mapCreateManufacturerDtoToEntity,
} from './trailer-manufacturer.mapper';

import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { TrailerManufacturerQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-trailer-manufacturer.dto';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';

@Controller('api/trailer-manufacturers')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('trailer-manufacturers-module')
export class TrailerManufacturerController {
  logger = new Logger('TrailerManufacturerController');

  constructor(private readonly manufacturerService: TrailerManufacturerService) {}

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET ALL (paginated)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of trailer manufacturers paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List of trailer manufacturers',
    type: TrailerManufacturerDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAllManufacturers(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: TrailerManufacturerQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<TrailerManufacturerDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const [results, count] = await this.manufacturerService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
    });

    const dtos = mapTrailerManufacturerToDtoSelective(results, [
      'id',
      'name',
      'createdBy',
      'updatedBy',
      'createdAt',
      'updatedAt',
    ]);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new trailer manufacturer' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: 'Trailer manufacturer created',
    type: TrailerManufacturerDTO,
  })
  async create(
    @Body() dto: CreateTrailerManufacturerDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<TrailerManufacturerDTO>> {
    const mapped = mapCreateManufacturerDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.manufacturerService.save(mapped, user?.email);

    return mapTrailerManufacturerToDtoSelective(saved);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete trailer manufacturer' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.manufacturerService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`Trailer manufacturer with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.manufacturerService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

import { TrailerManufacturer } from './trailer-manufacturer.entity';
import { CreateTrailerManufacturerDTO } from './dtos/create-trailer-manufacturer.dto';
import { TrailerManufacturerDTO } from './dtos/trailer-manufacturer.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';

const allowedTrailerManufacturerDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<
  keyof TrailerManufacturerDTO | keyof BaseDTO
> = ['id', 'name', 'createdBy', 'updatedBy', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt'];

/**
 * MAP TO DTO (Selective)
 */
export function mapTrailerManufacturerToDtoSelective(
  manufacturer: TrailerManufacturer | TrailerManufacturerDTO,
  keys?: (keyof TrailerManufacturerDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TrailerManufacturerDTO>;

export function mapTrailerManufacturerToDtoSelective(
  manufacturers: (TrailerManufacturer | TrailerManufacturerDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof TrailerManufacturerDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TrailerManufacturerDTO>[];

export function mapTrailerManufacturerToDtoSelective(
  manufacturerOrList:
    | TrailerManufacturer
    | TrailerManufacturerDTO
    | (TrailerManufacturer | TrailerManufacturerDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof TrailerManufacturerDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TrailerManufacturerDTO> | Partial<TrailerManufacturerDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (
    manufacturer: TrailerManufacturer | TrailerManufacturerDTO,
  ): Partial<TrailerManufacturerDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<TrailerManufacturerDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedTrailerManufacturerDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedTrailerManufacturerDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      const value = (manufacturer as any)[key];
      if (value !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = value;
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(manufacturerOrList)
    ? manufacturerOrList.map(mapSingle)
    : mapSingle(manufacturerOrList);
}

 * CREATE MAPPER
 */

  dto: CreateTrailerManufacturerDTO,
): TrailerManufacturer => {
  const entity = new TrailerManufacturer();

  entity.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return entity;
};

@Injectable()

    options: FindOneOptions<TrailerManufacturer>,

import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import { FindOptionsWhere } from 'typeorm';

import { UserDTO } from '../user/dtos/user.dto';
import { TransactionTypeService } from './transaction-type.service';
import { TransactionTypeDTO } from './dtos/transaction-type.dto';
import { CreateTransactionTypeDTO } from './dtos/create-transaction-type.dto';
import { UpdateTransactionTypeDTO } from './dtos/update-transaction-type.dto';
import { TransactionTypeQueryDTO } from './dtos/query-transaction-type.dto';
import { TransactionType } from './transaction-type.entity';
import {
  mapCreateTransactionTypeDtoToEntity,
  mapTransactionTypeToDtoSelective,
  mapUpdateTransactionTypeDtoToEntity,
} from './transaction-type.mapper';

@Controller('api/transaction-types')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('transaction-types-module')
export class TransactionTypeController {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('TransactionTypeController');

  constructor(private readonly transactionTypeService: TransactionTypeService) {}

  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of transaction types paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List of transaction types',
    type: TransactionTypeDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAll(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Query() query: TransactionTypeQueryDTO,
  ): Promise<Partial<TransactionTypeDTO>[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const where: FindOptionsWhere<TransactionType> = {};
    if (query.isActive !== undefined) where.isActive = query.isActive;

    const [results, count] = await this.transactionTypeService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      where,
    });

    const dtos = mapTransactionTypeToDtoSelective(results);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return dtos;
  }

  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get transaction type by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'TransactionType found', type: TransactionTypeDTO })
  async getById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<TransactionTypeDTO> {
    const existing = await this.transactionTypeService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`TransactionType with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapTransactionTypeToDtoSelective(existing) as TransactionTypeDTO;
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new transaction type' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Record created', type: TransactionTypeDTO })
  async create(
    @Body() dto: CreateTransactionTypeDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<TransactionTypeDTO> {
    const entity = mapCreateTransactionTypeDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.transactionTypeService.save(entity, user?.email);
    return mapTransactionTypeToDtoSelective(saved) as TransactionTypeDTO;
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update transaction type' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Record updated', type: TransactionTypeDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateTransactionTypeDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: UserDTO,
  ): Promise<TransactionTypeDTO> {
    const existing = await this.transactionTypeService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`TransactionType with id ${id} not found`);

    const entity = mapUpdateTransactionTypeDtoToEntity(dto, existing);
    const updated = await this.transactionTypeService.update(entity, user?.email);
    return mapTransactionTypeToDtoSelective(updated) as TransactionTypeDTO;
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete transaction type' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.transactionTypeService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`TransactionType with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.transactionTypeService.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 301: src\app\modules\transaction-type\transaction-type.mapper.ts =====

import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { TransactionType } from './transaction-type.entity';
import { TransactionTypeDTO } from './dtos/transaction-type.dto';
import { CreateTransactionTypeDTO } from './dtos/create-transaction-type.dto';
import { UpdateTransactionTypeDTO } from './dtos/update-transaction-type.dto';

const allowedKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof TransactionTypeDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'code',
  'name',
  'isActive',
  'metadata',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
] as const;

export function mapTransactionTypeToDtoSelective(
  txType: TransactionType,
  keys?: (keyof TransactionTypeDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TransactionTypeDTO>;

export function mapTransactionTypeToDtoSelective(
  txTypes: TransactionType[],
  keys?: (keyof TransactionTypeDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TransactionTypeDTO>[];

export function mapTransactionTypeToDtoSelective(
  data: TransactionType | TransactionType[],
  keys?: (keyof TransactionTypeDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<TransactionTypeDTO> | Partial<TransactionTypeDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (txType: TransactionType): Partial<TransactionTypeDTO> => {
    const dto: Partial<TransactionTypeDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedKeys).filter((key) =>
      (allowedKeys as readonly string[]).includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in txType && txType[key as keyof TransactionType] !== undefined) {
        (dto as any)[key] = txType[key as keyof TransactionType];
      }
    });

    return dto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(data) ? data.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(data);
}

export const mapCreateTransactionTypeDtoToEntity = (
  dto: CreateTransactionTypeDTO,
): TransactionType => {
  const entity = new TransactionType();

  entity.code = dto.code;
  entity.name = dto.name;
  entity.isActive = dto.isActive;
  entity.metadata = dto.metadata;

  return entity;
};

export const mapUpdateTransactionTypeDtoToEntity = (
  dto: UpdateTransactionTypeDTO,
  existing: TransactionType,
): TransactionType => {
  const entity = new TransactionType();

  entity.id = existing.id;
  entity.createdAt = existing.createdAt;

  entity.code = dto.code ?? existing.code;
  entity.name = dto.name ?? existing.name;
  entity.isActive = dto.isActive ?? existing.isActive;
  entity.metadata = dto.metadata ?? existing.metadata;

  return entity;
};

===== FILE 303: src\app\modules\transaction-type\transaction-type.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { TransactionType } from './transaction-type.entity';

@Injectable()
export class TransactionTypeService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(TransactionType)
    private readonly transactionTypeRepository: Repository<TransactionType>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<TransactionType | undefined> {
    const result = await this.transactionTypeRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(
    options: FindOneOptions<TransactionType>,
  ): Promise<TransactionType | undefined> {
    const result = await this.transactionTypeRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<TransactionType>): Promise<TransactionType[] | undefined> {
    const result = await this.transactionTypeRepository.find(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(
    options: FindManyOptions<TransactionType>,
  ): Promise<[TransactionType[], number]> {
    return this.transactionTypeRepository.findAndCount(options);
  }

  async save(txType: TransactionType, creator?: string): Promise<TransactionType> {
    const now = new Date();

    txType.createdAt = txType.createdAt ?? now;
    txType.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      txType.createdBy = txType.createdBy ?? creator;
      txType.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.transactionTypeRepository.save(txType);
  }

  async update(txType: TransactionType, updater?: string): Promise<TransactionType> {
    const now = new Date();

    txType.updatedAt = now;
    if (updater) txType.updatedBy = updater;

    return await this.transactionTypeRepository.save(txType);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.transactionTypeRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 310: src\app\modules\upload\upload.service.ts =====

import { PutObjectCommand, S3Client } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { getSignedUrl } from '@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner';
import { BadRequestException, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { CreatePresignedUrlDto } from './dto/create-presignedUrl.dto';
import { MimeTypeMap } from 'src/core/enums/mime-type';

@Injectable()
export class UploadService {
  private readonly s3Client: S3Client;
  private readonly bucket: string;

  constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {
    const endpoint = this.configService.get<string>('AWS_ENDPOINT'); // optional for MinIO
    const region = this.configService.getOrThrow<string>('AWS_REGION', { infer: true });
    this.bucket = this.configService.getOrThrow<string>('BUCKET_NAME');

    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-call
    this.s3Client = new S3Client({
      region,
      endpoint: endpoint || undefined,
      credentials: {
        accessKeyId: this.configService.getOrThrow('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'),
        secretAccessKey: this.configService.getOrThrow('AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'),
      },
      forcePathStyle: true, // important for MinIO
    });
  }

  async generatePresignedUrl(
    dto: CreatePresignedUrlDto,
  ): Promise<Partial<CreatePresignedUrlDto> & { url: string }> {
    const ext = this.getExtensionFromMime(dto.type);
    const key = this.generateObjectKey(dto.name, ext);
    const expiresIn = this.getExpiresInBasedOnFileSize(dto.size);

    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-call
    const command = new PutObjectCommand({
      Bucket: this.bucket,
      Key: key,
      ContentType: dto.type,
      Metadata: { 'expected-ext': ext },
    });

    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-call
    const url = await getSignedUrl(this.s3Client, command, { expiresIn });
    return { ...dto, url };
  }

  private getExtensionFromMime(mimeType: string): string {
    const entry = Object.entries(MimeTypeMap).find(([, mime]) => mime === mimeType);
    if (!entry) throw new BadRequestException(`Unsupported MIME type: ${mimeType}`);
    return entry[0].toLowerCase();
  }

  private generateObjectKey(filename: string, ext: string): string {
    const timestamp = Date.now();
    return `uploads/${ext}/${timestamp}_${filename}`;
  }

  private getExpiresInBasedOnFileSize(size: number): number {
    if (size <= 1_000_000) return 300; // 5 min
    if (size <= 10_000_000) return 600; // 10 min
    if (size <= 50_000_000) return 900; // 15 min
    if (size <= 100_000_000) return 1800; // 30 min
    return 3600; // 1 hour
  }
}

===== FILE 312: src\app\modules\user\user.controller.ts =====

import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Logger,
  Query,
  Req,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  ParseIntPipe,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { UserService } from './user.service';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserDTO } from './dtos/user.dto';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import { PageRequest } from 'src/core/utils/pagination.entity';
import { HeaderUtil } from 'src/core/utils/header-util';
import type { Request } from 'src/core/utils/request';
import { mapUserToUserDtoSelective, mapUserUpdateDtoToEntity } from './user.mapper';
import { UpdateUserDTO } from './dtos/update-user.dto';
import { User } from './user.entity';
import { UserQueryDTO } from './dtos/user-query.dto';
import { CreateUserDTO } from './dtos/create-user.dto';
import { mapUserCreateDtoToEntity } from './user.mapper';
import { FindOptionsWhere, DataSource, In, Not } from 'typeorm';
import { ContactService } from '../contact/contact.service';
import { mapCreateContactDtoToEntity } from '../contact/contact.mapper';
import { Contact } from '../contact/contact.entity';
import { withTransaction } from 'src/core/utils/transaction';

@Controller('api/users')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('users-module')
export class UserController {
  logger = new Logger('UsersController');

  constructor(
    private readonly userService: UserService,
    private readonly contactService: ContactService,
    private readonly dataSource: DataSource,
  ) {}

  @Get('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.USER)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get the list of users paginated' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'List all users',
    type: UserDTO,
    isArray: true,
  })
  async getAllUsers(@Req() req: Request, @Query() query: UserQueryDTO): Promise<UpdateUserDTO[]> {
    const pageRequest = new PageRequest(
      +(query.page ?? 1),
      +(query.pageSize ?? 10),
      query.sortField ? `${query.sortField},${query.sortOrder || 'ASC'}` : '',
    );

    const whereConditions: FindOptionsWhere<User> = {};
    if (query.role) {
      whereConditions.role = query.role;
    }

    const [results, count] = await this.userService.findAndCount({
      skip: +pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
      take: +pageRequest.size,
      order: pageRequest.sort.asOrder(),
      relations: ['contacts', 'salary'],
      where: whereConditions ?? null,
    });

    const userDtos = mapUserToUserDtoSelective(results);

    HeaderUtil.addPaginationHeaders(
      req.res!,
      count,
      pageRequest.page,
      count > pageRequest.page * pageRequest.size,
    );

    return userDtos;
  }

  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get user by id' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'User found', type: UserDTO })
  async getUserById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<UpdateUserDTO> {
    const existing = await this.userService.find({
      where: { id },
      relations: ['contacts', 'salary', 'userAttachments'],
    });

    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`User with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapUserToUserDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'email',
      'username',
      'status',
      'role',
      'firstName',
      'lastName',
      'personalId',
      'personalIdExpiryDate',
      'notes',
      'contacts',
      'salary',
      'userAttachments',
      'code',
    ]);
  }

  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new user' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: 'The record has been successfully created.',
    type: UserDTO,
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 403, description: 'Forbidden.' })
  async create(@Body() createUserDTO: CreateUserDTO, @AuthUser() user: User): Promise<UserDTO> {
    if (createUserDTO.email) {
      const emailCheck = await this.userService.findByFields({
        where: { email: createUserDTO.email },
      });

      if (emailCheck) {
        throw new BadRequestException(`User with email ${createUserDTO.email} already exists`);
      }
    }

    // Validate contacts for duplicate phone numbers in payload before any DB writes
    const contacts = (createUserDTO as any).contacts as { phone: string }[] | undefined;
    if (contacts && contacts.length > 0) {
      const hasDuplicates = contacts.some(
        (contact, index) => contacts.findIndex((c) => c.phone === contact.phone) !== index,
      );

      if (hasDuplicates) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Duplicate contact phone numbers found');
      }

      // Validate that none of these phones already exist for any user
      const phones = contacts.map((c) => c.phone);
      const contactOfOtherUser = (await this.contactService.find({
        where: { phone: In(phones) } as any,
      })) as Contact[] | null;

      if (contactOfOtherUser && contactOfOtherUser.length > 0) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Duplicate contact phone numbers found');
      }
    }

    const created = await withTransaction(this.dataSource, async () => {
      const mappedUser = await mapUserCreateDtoToEntity(createUserDTO);
      const savedUser = await this.userService.save(mappedUser as any, user?.email);

      if (contacts && contacts.length > 0) {
        const mappedContacts = mapCreateContactDtoToEntity(
          contacts.map((c) => ({ ...c, userId: savedUser.id }) as any),
        ) as Contact[];
        await this.contactService.save(mappedContacts, user?.email);
      }

      return savedUser;
    });

    return created;
  }

  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update an existing user' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'The record has been successfully updated.',
    type: UserDTO,
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 403, description: 'Forbidden.' })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() userDTO: UpdateUserDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: User,
  ): Promise<UpdateUserDTO> {
    const existing = await this.userService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`User with id ${id} not found`);
    }

    // Extract and validate contacts (if provided) before any DB writes
    const contacts = (userDTO as any).contacts as { phone: string }[] | undefined;
    if (contacts && contacts.length > 0) {
      const hasDuplicates = contacts.some(
        (contact, index) => contacts.findIndex((c) => c.phone === contact.phone) !== index,
      );

      if (hasDuplicates) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Duplicate contact phone numbers found');
      }

      // Validate that none of these phones already exist for a *different* user
      const phones = contacts.map((c) => c.phone);
      const contactOfOtherUser = (await this.contactService.find({
        where: { phone: In(phones), user: { id: Not(id) } } as any,
      })) as Contact[] | null;

      if (contactOfOtherUser && contactOfOtherUser.length > 0) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Duplicate contact phone numbers found');
      }
    }

    const updated = await withTransaction(this.dataSource, async () => {
      const mappedUser = await mapUserUpdateDtoToEntity(userDTO);

      if (mappedUser.username) {
        const usernameCheck = await this.userService.findByFields({
          where: { username: userDTO.username },
        });

        if (usernameCheck && usernameCheck.id !== id) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`User with username ${userDTO.username} already exists`);
        }
      }

      if (mappedUser.email) {
        const emailCheck = await this.userService.findByFields({
          where: { email: userDTO.email },
        });

        if (emailCheck && emailCheck.id !== id) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`User with email ${userDTO.email} already exists`);
        }
      }

      userDTO.id = id;
      const result = await this.userService.update(userDTO, user?.email);

      if (contacts && contacts.length > 0) {
        const existingContacts = (await this.contactService.find({
          where: { user: { id } } as any,
        })) as Contact[] | null;

        if (existingContacts && existingContacts.length > 0) {
          for (const contact of existingContacts) {
            await this.contactService.delete(contact.id);
          }
        }

        const mappedContacts = mapCreateContactDtoToEntity(
          contacts.map((c) => ({ ...c, userId: id }) as any),
        ) as Contact[];
        await this.contactService.save(mappedContacts, user?.email);
      }

      return result;
    });

    return updated;
  }

  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete a user' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'The record has been successfully deleted.',
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 403, description: 'Forbidden.' })
  async delete(@Param('id') id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.userService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`User with id ${id} not found`);
    }
    await this.userService.delete(existing);
  }
}

import { Entity, Column, OneToMany, OneToOne } from 'typeorm';
import { Exclude } from 'class-transformer';
import { BaseEntity } from 'src/core/utils/base.entity';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import { Contact } from '../contact/contact.entity';

import { UserStatus } from 'src/core/enums/user-status';
import { Employee } from '../employee/employee.entity';
import { UserAttachment } from '../user-attachment/user-attachment.entity';

@Entity('users')
export class User extends BaseEntity {
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 255, unique: true, nullable: true })
  email?: string;

  @Exclude()
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 255, nullable: true })
  password?: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 100, nullable: false })
  username: string;

  @Column({
    type: 'enum',
    enum: UserStatus,
    nullable: false,
    default: UserStatus.AVAILABLE,
  })
  status: UserStatus;

  @Column({ type: 'boolean', default: false, nullable: true })
  activated?: boolean;

  @Column({ name: 'image_url', type: 'varchar', length: 255, nullable: true })
  imageUrl?: string;

  @Column({ type: 'enum', enum: UserRole, default: UserRole.USER })
  role: UserRole;

  @Column({ name: 'first_name', type: 'varchar', length: 100, nullable: true })
  firstName?: string;

  @Column({ name: 'last_name', type: 'varchar', length: 100, nullable: true })
  lastName?: string;

  @Column({ name: 'personal_id', type: 'varchar', length: 50, nullable: true })
  personalId?: string;

  @Column({ name: 'personal_id_expiry_date', type: 'date', nullable: true })
  personalIdExpiryDate?: Date;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 255, nullable: true })
  notes?: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 50, nullable: true })
  code?: string;

  /** Relations **/
  @OneToMany(() => Contact, (contact) => contact.user)
  contacts?: Contact[];

  @OneToMany(() => UserAttachment, (attachment) => attachment.user)
  userAttachments?: UserAttachment[];

  @OneToOne(() => Salary, (salary) => salary.user)
  salary?: Salary;

  @OneToOne(() => Driver, (driver) => driver.user)
  driver?: Driver;

  @OneToOne(() => Employee, (employee) => employee.user)
  employee: Employee;
}

import { User } from './user.entity';
import { UserDTO } from './dtos/user.dto';
import { CreateUserDTO } from './dtos/create-user.dto';
import { UpdateUserDTO } from './dtos/update-user.dto';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';
import { transformPassword } from 'src/core/security';
import { generateRandomPassword } from 'src/core/utils/generator';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';
import { UserStatus } from 'src/core/enums/user-status';

/**
 * Allowed keys for mapping a User entity to UserDTO.
 * Excludes sensitive fields like `password`.
 */
const allowedUserDtoKeys: ReadonlyArray<keyof UserDTO | keyof BaseDTO> = [
  'id',
  'email',
  'username',
  'activated',
  'imageUrl',
  'role',
  'status',
  'firstName',
  'lastName',
  'personalId',
  'personalIdExpiryDate',
  'notes',
  'createdBy',
  'updatedBy',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
  'contacts',
  'salary',
  'userAttachments',
  'code',
];

/**
 * Maps a User or an array of Users to DTO(s) selectively.
 *
 * @param userOrUsers - User entity or array
 * @param keys - Optional list of keys to include (default: all allowed keys)
 * @returns Partial<UserDTO> | Partial<UserDTO>[]
 */
export function mapUserToUserDtoSelective(
  user: User,
  keys?: (keyof UserDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<UserDTO>;
export function mapUserToUserDtoSelective(
  users: User[],
  keys?: (keyof UserDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<UserDTO>[];
export function mapUserToUserDtoSelective(
  userOrUsers: User | User[],
  keys?: (keyof UserDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<UserDTO> | Partial<UserDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (user: User): Partial<UserDTO> => {
    const resultDto: Partial<UserDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedUserDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedUserDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      if (key in user && user[key as keyof User] !== undefined) {
        (resultDto as any)[key] = user[key as keyof User];
      }
    });

    return resultDto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(userOrUsers) ? userOrUsers.map(mapSingle) : mapSingle(userOrUsers);
}

/**
 * Maps CreateUserDTO → User entity
 * Handles hashing password and default values.
 */
export const mapUserCreateDtoToEntity = async (dto: CreateUserDTO): Promise<User> => {
  const user = new User();
  user.email = dto.email;
  user.username = dto.username;
  user.activated = dto.activated ?? false;
  user.imageUrl = dto.imageUrl;
  user.role = dto.role ?? UserRole.USER;
  user.status = dto.status ?? UserStatus.AVAILABLE;
  user.firstName = dto.firstName;
  user.lastName = dto.lastName;
  user.personalId = dto.personalId;
  user.personalIdExpiryDate = dto.personalIdExpiryDate;
  user.notes = dto.notes;
  user.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  // ✅ Use provided password or generate one
  user.password = dto.password || generateRandomPassword();

  // ✅ Always hash the final password
  await transformPassword(user);

  return user;
};

export const mapUserUpdateDtoToEntity = async (dto: UpdateUserDTO): Promise<User> => {
  const user = new User();

  // Always include id if provided
  if (dto.id !== undefined) user.id = dto.id;

  // Only update provided fields
  if (dto.email !== undefined) user.email = dto.email;
  if (dto.username !== undefined) user.username = dto.username;
  if (dto.activated !== undefined) user.activated = dto.activated;
  if (dto.imageUrl !== undefined) user.imageUrl = dto.imageUrl;
  if (dto.role !== undefined) user.role = dto.role;
  if (dto.status !== undefined) user.status = dto.status;
  if (dto.firstName !== undefined) user.firstName = dto.firstName;
  if (dto.lastName !== undefined) user.lastName = dto.lastName;
  if (dto.personalId !== undefined) user.personalId = dto.personalId;
  if (dto.personalIdExpiryDate !== undefined) user.personalIdExpiryDate = dto.personalIdExpiryDate;
  if (dto.notes !== undefined) user.notes = dto.notes;
  if (dto.createdAt !== undefined) user.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  // ✅ Update password if provided (and rehash)
  if (dto.password) {
    user.password = dto.password;
    await transformPassword(user);
  }

  return user;
};

===== FILE 316: src\app\modules\user\user.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { User } from './user.entity';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { UpdateUserDTO } from './dtos/update-user.dto';
import { UserDTO } from './dtos/user.dto';
import { transformPassword } from 'src/core/security';
import { generateUniqueCode, generateUniqueUsername } from 'src/core/utils/generator';

@Injectable()
export class UserService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<UserDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(options: FindOneOptions<UpdateUserDTO>): Promise<UserDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.userRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(options: FindManyOptions<UpdateUserDTO>): Promise<User | undefined> {
    const result = await this.userRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findAndCount(options: FindManyOptions<UserDTO>): Promise<[User[], number]> {
    const resultList = await this.userRepository.findAndCount(options);
    return resultList;
  }

  async save(userDTO: UserDTO, creator?: string): Promise<User> {
    // Generate a unique code for the user
    const userCode = await generateUniqueCode(this.userRepository, userDTO.role);
    userDTO.code = userCode;

    userDTO.username = await generateUniqueUsername(this.userRepository, userDTO.role, 'username');

    // Apply creator fields
    if (creator) {
      userDTO.createdBy ??= creator;
      userDTO.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    // Ensure creation timestamp is set
    userDTO.createdAt ??= new Date();

    // Create an entity instance (so TypeORM lifecycle hooks and defaults apply)
    const entity = this.userRepository.create(userDTO);

    // Persist the entity
    return await this.userRepository.save(entity);
  }

  async update(userDTO: UpdateUserDTO, updater?: string): Promise<UpdateUserDTO> {
    if (updater) {
      userDTO.updatedBy = updater;
      userDTO.updatedAt = new Date();
    }

    // Handle password hashing if present
    if (userDTO.password) {
      await transformPassword(userDTO);
    }

    // Strip relation fields that cannot be updated via a simple UPDATE
    // (e.g. contacts, attachments, salary). These are managed separately.
    const { contacts, userAttachments, salary, ...scalarFields } = userDTO as any;

    // Perform partial update (exclude immutable fields like createdAt)
    await this.userRepository.update(
      { id: userDTO.id },
      {
        ...scalarFields,
        updatedAt: userDTO.updatedAt,
        updatedBy: userDTO.updatedBy,
      },
    );

    return userDTO;
  }

  async delete(userDTO: UserDTO): Promise<void> {
    await this.userRepository.delete({ id: userDTO.id });
  }
}

import { ApiProperty } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { IsString, IsEmail, IsEnum, IsOptional, IsBoolean, IsDateString } from 'class-validator';
import { Exclude, Type } from 'class-transformer';
import { BaseDTO } from 'src/core/utils/base.dto';

/**
 * A User Data Transfer Object (DTO).
 */

  @ApiProperty({
    example: 'email@domain.com',
    description: 'User email address',
    uniqueItems: true,
    required: false,

    example: true,

  @ApiProperty({
    example: 'https://cdn.example.com/avatar.png',

import {
  Controller,
  Logger,
  UseGuards,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  Get,
  ParseIntPipe,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AuthGuard, Roles, RolesGuard, AuthUser } from 'src/core/security';
import { UserRole } from 'src/core/enums/user-role';

import { UserAttachmentService } from './user-attachment.service';
import { UserService } from '../user/user.service';

import { UserAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/user-attachment.dto';
import { CreateUserAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/create-user-attachment.dto';
import { UpdateUserAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/update-user-attachment.dto';

import {
  mapUserAttachmentToDtoSelective,
  mapCreateUserAttachmentDtoToEntity,
  mapUpdateUserAttachmentDtoToEntity,
} from './user-attachment.mapper';

@Controller('api/user-attachments')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(AuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
@ApiTags('user-attachments-module')
export class UserAttachmentController {
  logger = new Logger('UserAttachmentController');

  constructor(
    private readonly attachmentService: UserAttachmentService,
    private readonly userService: UserService,
  ) {}

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // GET BY ID
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get user attachment by ID' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'User attachment found', type: UserAttachmentDTO })
  async getById(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<Partial<UserAttachmentDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`User attachment with id ${id} not found`);

    return mapUserAttachmentToDtoSelective(existing, [
      'id',
      'user',
      'url',
      'type',
      'notes',
      'documentExpiryDate',
      'createdAt',
      'createdBy',
    ]);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('/')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new user attachment' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'User attachment created', type: UserAttachmentDTO })
  async create(
    @Body() dto: CreateUserAttachmentDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<UserAttachmentDTO>> {
    const existingUser = await this.userService.findByFields({ where: { id: dto.userId } });
    if (!existingUser) throw new NotFoundException(`User with id ${dto.userId} not found`);

    const mapped = mapCreateUserAttachmentDtoToEntity(dto);
    const saved = await this.attachmentService.save(mapped, user?.email);

    return mapUserAttachmentToDtoSelective(saved);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Put('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update user attachment' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'User attachment updated', type: UserAttachmentDTO })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateUserAttachmentDTO,
    @AuthUser() user: any,
  ): Promise<Partial<UserAttachmentDTO>> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`User attachment with id ${id} not found`);

    dto.id = id;
    const mapped = mapUpdateUserAttachmentDtoToEntity(dto);
    const updated = await this.attachmentService.update(mapped, user?.email);

    return mapUserAttachmentToDtoSelective(updated);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Delete('/:id')
  @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete user attachment' })
  async delete(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.attachmentService.findById(id);
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException(`User attachment with id ${id} not found`);

    await this.attachmentService.delete(existing.id);
  }
}

export function mapUserAttachmentToDtoSelective(
  attachmentOrAttachments:
    | UserAttachment
    | UserAttachmentDTO
    | (UserAttachment | UserAttachmentDTO)[],
  keys?: (keyof UserAttachmentDTO | keyof BaseDTO)[],
): Partial<UserAttachmentDTO> | Partial<UserAttachmentDTO>[] {
  const mapSingle = (
    attachment: UserAttachment | UserAttachmentDTO,
  ): Partial<UserAttachmentDTO> => {
    const resultDto: Partial<UserAttachmentDTO> = {};

    const keysToMap = (keys || allowedUserAttachmentDtoKeys).filter((key) =>
      allowedUserAttachmentDtoKeys.includes(key),
    );

    keysToMap.forEach((key) => {
      const value = (attachment as any)[key];
      if (value !== undefined) {
        (resultDto as any)[key] = value;
      }
    });

    return resultDto;
  };

  return Array.isArray(attachmentOrAttachments)
    ? attachmentOrAttachments.map(mapSingle)
    : mapSingle(attachmentOrAttachments);
}

export const mapCreateUserAttachmentDtoToEntity = (
  dto: CreateUserAttachmentDTO,
): UserAttachment => {
  const attachment = new UserAttachment();

  if (dto.userId) {
    attachment.user = new User();
    attachment.user.id = dto.userId;
  }

  attachment.url = dto.url;
  attachment.type = dto.type;
  attachment.notes = dto.notes;
  attachment.documentExpiryDate = dto.documentExpiryDate;
  attachment.createdAt = dto.createdAt;

  return attachment;
};

export const mapUpdateUserAttachmentDtoToEntity = (
  dto: UpdateUserAttachmentDTO,
): UserAttachment => {
  const attachment = new UserAttachment();

  if (dto.id !== undefined) attachment.id = dto.id;
  if (dto.url !== undefined) attachment.url = dto.url;
  if (dto.type !== undefined) attachment.type = dto.type;
  if (dto.notes !== undefined) attachment.notes = dto.notes;
  if (dto.documentExpiryDate !== undefined) attachment.documentExpiryDate = dto.documentExpiryDate;

  return attachment;
};

===== FILE 325: src\app\modules\user-attachment\user-attachment.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { FindManyOptions, FindOneOptions, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { UserAttachment } from './user-attachment.entity';
import { UserAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/user-attachment.dto';
import { UpdateUserAttachmentDTO } from './dtos/update-user-attachment.dto';

@Injectable()
export class UserAttachmentService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(UserAttachment)
    private attachmentRepository: Repository<UserAttachment>,
  ) {}

  async findById(id: number): Promise<UserAttachmentDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async findByFields(
    options: FindOneOptions<UpdateUserAttachmentDTO>,
  ): Promise<UserAttachmentDTO | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async find(
    options: FindManyOptions<UpdateUserAttachmentDTO>,
  ): Promise<UserAttachment | undefined> {
    const result = await this.attachmentRepository.findOne(options);
    return result || undefined;
  }

  async save(attachment: UserAttachment, creator?: string): Promise<UserAttachment> {
    const now = new Date();
    attachment.createdAt = attachment.createdAt ?? now;
    attachment.updatedAt = now;

    if (creator) {
      attachment.createdBy = attachment.createdBy ?? creator;
      attachment.updatedBy = creator;
    }

    return await this.attachmentRepository.save(attachment);
  }

  async update(attachment: UserAttachment, updater?: string): Promise<UserAttachment> {
    const now = new Date();

    if (updater) {
      attachment.updatedBy = updater;
    }

    attachment.updatedAt = now;

    return await this.attachmentRepository.save(attachment);
  }

  async delete(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.attachmentRepository.delete(id);
  }
}

===== FILE 329: src\config\db-config.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { TypeOrmModuleOptions, TypeOrmOptionsFactory } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import * as path from 'path';

@Injectable()
export default class PostgresTypeorm implements TypeOrmOptionsFactory {
  constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {}

  createTypeOrmOptions(): TypeOrmModuleOptions {
    const isSslEnabled = this.configService.get<boolean>('DATABASE_SSL', false);

    return {
      type: 'postgres',
      logging: this.configService.get<boolean>('DATABASE_LOGGING', true),
      synchronize: this.configService.get<boolean>('DATABASE_SYNCHRONIZE', false),
      migrationsRun: this.configService.get<boolean>('DATABASE_MIGRATIONS_RUN', true),
      entities: [path.join(__dirname, '..', '**', '*.entity.{ts,js}')],
      migrations: [path.join(__dirname, '..', 'database/migrations', '**', '*{.ts,.js}')],
      database: this.configService.get<string>('DATABASE_NAME'),
      host: this.configService.get<string>('DATABASE_HOST'),
      port: this.configService.get<number>('DATABASE_PORT'),
      username: this.configService.get<string>('DATABASE_USER'),
      password: this.configService.get<string>('DATABASE_PASSWORD'),
      ssl: isSslEnabled
        ? {
            rejectUnauthorized: false,
          }
        : undefined,
    };
  }
}

===== FILE 350: src\core\security\passport.jwt.strategy.ts =====

import { Injectable, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PassportStrategy } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { ExtractJwt, Strategy } from 'passport-jwt';
import { JwtPayload } from './interfaces/jwt-payload.interface';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/modules/auth/auth.service';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';

// const logger: Logger = new Logger('Main');

@Injectable()
export class JwtStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy) {
  constructor(
    private readonly authService: AuthService,
    configService: ConfigService,
  ) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-call
    super({
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-call
      jwtFromRequest: ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(),
      ignoreExpiration: false,
      secretOrKey: configService.get<string>('APP_SECRET_KEY'),
      // secretOrKey: 'X24aQj8aG6H2rB7HR4SZ6QFtY5ST3vwS',
      passReqToCallback: true,
    });
  }

  public async validate(request: Request, payload: JwtPayload) {
    // logger.debug('request from security: ', request);
    // logger.debug('payload security s: ', payload);
    const user = await this.authService.validateUser(payload);
    if (!user) {
      new UnauthorizedException({ message: 'user does not exist' });
    }
    return user;
  }
}


===== FILE 351: src\core\security\password-util.ts =====

import * as bcrypt from 'bcrypt';

export async function transformPassword(user: { password?: string }): Promise<void> {
  if (user.password) {
    user.password = await bcrypt.hash(user.password, 10);
  }
  return Promise.resolve();
}
