===== FILE 355: src\core\security\guards\roles.guard.ts =====

import { CanActivate, ExecutionContext, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { UserDTO } from 'src/app/modules/user/dtos/user.dto';

@Injectable()
export class RolesGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(private readonly reflector: Reflector) {}

  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    const roles = this.reflector.get<string[]>('roles', context.getHandler());

    if (!roles) {
      return true;
    }

    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<{ user: UserDTO }>();
    const user = request.user;

    if (!user || !user.role) {
      return false;
    }

    return roles.includes(user.role);
  }
}

===== FILE 362: src\core\utils\generator.ts =====

import { Repository, FindOptionsWhere } from 'typeorm';
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { UserRole } from '../enums/user-role';
import { GeneratorTypes } from '../enums/generator-types';

/**
 * Generates a unique code for any entity repository
 * @param repository TypeORM repository
 * @param type Code type (Driver, Car, etc.)
 * @param field Optional field to check uniqueness (default: 'code')
 * @param relation Optional relation path for nested field (e.g., 'user.code')
 */
export const generateUniqueCode = async <T extends Record<string, any>>(
  repository: Repository<T>,
  type: GeneratorTypes | UserRole,
  field: keyof T = 'code' as keyof T,
  relation?: string,
): Promise<string> => {
  let unique = false;
  let code: string;

  const prefixMap = {
    [UserRole.DRIVER]: 'D',
    [UserRole.DRIVER_ASSISTANT]: 'F',
    [GeneratorTypes.CAR]: 'C',
    [GeneratorTypes.TRAILER]: 'T',
    [UserRole.DATA_ENTRY]: 'E',
    [UserRole.ADMIN]: 'E',
    [UserRole.USER]: 'E',
    [UserRole.EMPLOYEE]: 'E',
  };

  if (!prefixMap[type]) throw new BadRequestException('Unknown generator type');

  do {
    code = `${prefixMap[type]}-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`;

    let where: FindOptionsWhere<T> | undefined;

    if (!relation) {
      // Normal field uniqueness
      where = { [field]: code } as FindOptionsWhere<T>;
    } else {
      // Nested relation uniqueness using query builder
      const qb = repository.createQueryBuilder('entity');

      const exists = await qb.where(`${relation} = :code`, { code }).getOne();

      unique = !exists;
      continue; // skip to next iteration
    }

    const existing = await repository.findOne({ where });
    unique = !existing;
  } while (!unique);

  return code;
};

export const generateUniqueUsername = async <T extends Record<string, any>>(
  repository: Repository<T>,
  role: UserRole,
  field: keyof T = 'username' as keyof T,
  relation?: string,
): Promise<string> => {
  let unique = false;
  let username: string;

  // Prefix mapping for each role
  const prefixMap: Record<UserRole, string> = {
    [UserRole.DRIVER]: 'dri-',
    [UserRole.DRIVER_ASSISTANT]: 'driAssistant-',
    [UserRole.DATA_ENTRY]: 'dataEntry-',
    [UserRole.ADMIN]: 'admin-',
    [UserRole.USER]: 'user-',
    [UserRole.EMPLOYEE]: 'emp-',
  };

  const prefix = prefixMap[role];
  if (!prefix) throw new BadRequestException('Unknown role for username generator');

  do {
    const random = Math.floor(10000 + Math.random() * 90000); // 5 digits
    username = `${prefix}${random}`;

    let where: FindOptionsWhere<T> | undefined;

    if (!relation) {
      where = { [field]: username } as FindOptionsWhere<T>;
      const existing = await repository.findOne({ where });
      unique = !existing;
    } else {
      const exists = await repository
        .createQueryBuilder('entity')
        .where(`${relation} = :username`, { username })
        .getOne();

      unique = !exists;
    }
  } while (!unique);

  return username;
};

/**
 * Generate a unique journey number
 * Format: JRN-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX (e.g., JRN-20251211-123456)
 * Checks against Journey repository for uniqueness
 */
export const generateUniqueJourneyNumber = async <T extends Record<string, any>>(
  repository: Repository<T>,
): Promise<string> => {
  let unique = false;
  let journeyNumber: string;

  do {
    const date = new Date();
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const random = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000);

    journeyNumber = `JRN-${year}${month}${day}-${random}`;

    const where = { delegateNumber: journeyNumber } as unknown as FindOptionsWhere<T>;
    const existing = await repository.findOne({ where });
    unique = !existing;
  } while (!unique);

  return journeyNumber;
};

/**
 * Generate a random secure password
 */
export const generateRandomPassword = (length = 10): string => {
  const chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!@#$%^&*()_+';
  return Array.from({ length }, () => chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)]).join('');
};

===== FILE 365: src\core\utils\pagination.entity.ts =====

import { BaseEntity } from './base.entity';
import { Type, Expose as JsonProperty } from 'class-transformer';

export class Sort {
  public property: string;
  public direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC';
  constructor(sort: string) {
    if (sort) {
      const [property, direction] = sort.split(',');
      this.property = property;
      // Ensure direction is valid before assigning
      const upperDirection = direction?.toUpperCase();
      this.direction = upperDirection === 'DESC' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC';
    }
  }

  asOrder(): Record<string, 'ASC' | 'DESC'> {
    const order = {};
    order[this.property] = this.direction;
    return order;
  }
}

export class PageRequest {
  @JsonProperty()
  page = 0;
  @JsonProperty()
  size = 20;
  @Type(() => Sort)
  sort: Sort = new Sort('id,ASC');

  constructor(page: number | string, size: number | string, sort: string) {
    this.page = +page - 1 || this.page;
    this.size = +size || this.size;
    this.sort = sort ? new Sort(sort) : this.sort;
  }
}

export class Page<T extends BaseEntity> {
  constructor(
    public content: T[],
    public total: number,
    public pageable: PageRequest,
  ) {}
}

===== FILE 367: src\core\utils\transaction.ts =====

import { DataSource, EntityManager } from 'typeorm';

// Generic transactional wrapper to keep controllers/services clean
export async function withTransaction<T>(
  dataSource: DataSource,
  work: (manager: EntityManager) => Promise<T>,
): Promise<T> {
  return dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
    return work(manager);
  });
}


===== FILE 368: src\core\utils\validators.ts =====

/**
 * Returns true if the array contains any duplicated value.
 * Works with primitives and objects (using strict equality ===).
 */
export function hasDuplicates<T>(items: T[] | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!items || items.length <= 1) return false;

  const seen = new Set<T>();
  for (const item of items) {
    if (seen.has(item)) return true;
    seen.add(item);
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * Throws an error if the array contains duplicates.
 * Useful inside service validation logic.
 */
export function assertNoDuplicates<T>(
  items: T[] | null | undefined,
  errorFactory: () => Error,
): void {
  if (hasDuplicates(items)) {
    throw errorFactory();
  }
}

===== FILE 370: src\database\seeders\seeder.ts =====

import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { UserSeederService } from './user/user-seeder.service';
import { AreaSeederService } from './area/area-seeder.service';
import { PriceTypeSeederService } from './price-type/price-type-seeder.service';
import { ClientSeederService } from './client/client-seeder.service';

@Injectable()
export class Seeder {
  constructor(
    private readonly logger: Logger,
    private readonly userSeederService: UserSeederService,
    private readonly areaSeederService: AreaSeederService,
    private readonly priceTypeSeederService: PriceTypeSeederService,
    private readonly clientSeederService: ClientSeederService,
  ) {}
  async seed() {
    // Seed Users
    await this.users()
      .then(() => {
        this.logger.debug('Successfully completed seeding users...');
        return true;
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        this.logger.error('Failed seeding users...');
        throw error;
      });

    // Seed Areas
    await this.areas()
      .then(() => {
        this.logger.debug('Successfully completed seeding areas...');
        return true;
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        this.logger.error('Failed seeding areas...');
        throw error;
      });

    // Seed Price Types
    await this.priceTypes()
      .then(() => {
        this.logger.debug('Successfully completed seeding price types...');
        return true;
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        this.logger.error('Failed seeding price types...');
        throw error;
      });

    // Seed Clients
    await this.clients()
      .then(() => {
        this.logger.debug('Successfully completed seeding clients...');
        return true;
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        this.logger.error('Failed seeding clients...');
        throw error;
      });
  }

  async users() {
    return await Promise.all(this.userSeederService.create())
      .then((createdUsers) => {
        // Can also use this.logger.verbose('...');
        this.logger.debug(
          'No. of users created : ' +
            // Remove all null values and return only created users.
            createdUsers.filter((nullValueOrCreatedUser) => nullValueOrCreatedUser).length,
        );
        return true;
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        throw error;
      });
  }

  async areas() {
    return await this.areaSeederService
      .create()
      .then((createdAreas) => {
        this.logger.debug(
          'No. of areas created : ' +
            createdAreas.filter((nullValueOrCreatedArea) => nullValueOrCreatedArea).length,
        );
        return true;
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        throw error;
      });
  }

  async priceTypes() {
    return await this.priceTypeSeederService
      .create()
      .then((createdPriceTypes) => {
        this.logger.debug(
          'No. of price types created : ' +
            createdPriceTypes.filter((nullValueOrCreated) => nullValueOrCreated).length,
        );
        return true;
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        throw error;
      });
  }

  async clients() {
    return await this.clientSeederService
      .create()
      .then((createdClients) => {
        this.logger.debug(
          'No. of clients created : ' +
            createdClients.filter((nullValueOrCreated) => nullValueOrCreated).length,
        );
        return true;
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        throw error;
      });
  }
}

      // أسوان
      { governmentName: 'أسوان', name: 'أسوان' },
      { governmentName: 'أسوان', name: 'توشكى' },

      // جنوب سيناء
      { governmentName: 'جنوب سيناء', name: 'رأس سدر' },
      { governmentName: 'جنوب سيناء', name: 'مطار المليز' },
    ];

    const createdAreas: (Area | null)[] = [];
    for (const areaData of areasData) {
      let gov = await this.governmentRepository.findOne({
        where: { name: areaData.governmentName },
      });

      // If government does not exist, create it first
      if (!gov) {
        const newGovernment = this.governmentRepository.create({
          name: areaData.governmentName,
        });
        gov = await this.governmentRepository.save(newGovernment);
      }

      const existingArea = await this.areaRepository.findOne({
        where: { name: areaData.name, government: { id: gov.id } },
      });
      if (existingArea) {
        createdAreas.push(null);
      } else {
        const newArea = this.areaRepository.create({
          name: areaData.name,
          government: gov,
        });
        const savedArea = await this.areaRepository.save(newArea);
        createdAreas.push(savedArea);
      }
    }
    return createdAreas;
  }
}

===== FILE 374: src\database\seeders\client\client-seeder.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Client } from 'src/app/modules/factory/client.entity';

@Injectable()
export class ClientSeederService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Client)
    private readonly clientRepository: Repository<Client>,
  ) {}

  async create(): Promise<(Client | null)[]> {
    const clientsToSeed: Array<Partial<Client> & { id: number }> = [
      {
        id: 1,
        name: 'مصنع اسمنت العريش',
        commercialRecord: 'CR-ARISH',
        companyCode: 'C-ARISH',
        taxInvoice: undefined,
        destinationsFile: undefined,
      },
      {
        id: 2,
        name: 'مصنع وطنيه',
        commercialRecord: 'CR-WATANIA',
        companyCode: 'C-WATANIA',
        taxInvoice: undefined,
        destinationsFile: undefined,
      },
    ];

    const results: (Client | null)[] = [];

    for (const data of clientsToSeed) {
      // Prefer checking by id to satisfy explicit id requirement
      const existingById = await this.clientRepository.findOne({ where: { id: data.id } });
      if (existingById) {
        // Optionally ensure name and fields are aligned
        const needsUpdate =
          existingById.name !== data.name ||
          existingById.commercialRecord !== data.commercialRecord ||
          existingById.companyCode !== data.companyCode;

        if (needsUpdate) {
          existingById.name = data.name as string;
          existingById.commercialRecord = data.commercialRecord as string;
          existingById.companyCode = data.companyCode as string;
          results.push(await this.clientRepository.save(existingById));
        } else {
          results.push(null);
        }
        continue;
      }

      // If not found by id, ensure we don't duplicate by name
      const existingByName = await this.clientRepository.findOne({
        where: { name: data.name as string },
      });
      if (existingByName) {
        // Keep existing; do not change primary id
        results.push(null);
        continue;
      }

      // Insert with explicit id value
      const client = this.clientRepository.create(data as Client);
      const saved = await this.clientRepository.save(client);
      results.push(saved);
    }

    return results;
  }
}

===== FILE 376: src\database\seeders\price-type\price-type-seeder.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { PriceType } from 'src/app/modules/price-type/price-type.entity';
import { PackingType } from 'src/core/enums/packing-type';

@Injectable()
export class PriceTypeSeederService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(PriceType)
    private readonly priceTypeRepository: Repository<PriceType>,
  ) {}

  async create(): Promise<(PriceType | null)[]> {
    const packingTypes = Object.values(PackingType);

    const results: (PriceType | null)[] = [];
    for (const packingType of packingTypes) {
      const existing = await this.priceTypeRepository.findOne({ where: { name: packingType } });
      if (existing) {
        results.push(null);
        continue;
      }

      const descriptionMap: Record<PackingType, string> = {
        [PackingType.BAGGED]: 'تسعير للمنتجات المعبأة في شكاير',
        [PackingType.JUMBO_BAG]: 'تسعير للمنتجات المعبأة في جامبو باج',
        [PackingType.SILO10]: 'تسعير شحن صوامع 10 طن',
        [PackingType.SILO12]: 'تسعير شحن صوامع 12 طن',
        [PackingType.LOOSE]: 'تسعير للمنتجات السائبة',
      };

      const priceType = this.priceTypeRepository.create({
        name: packingType,
        description: descriptionMap[packingType as PackingType],
      });
      const saved = await this.priceTypeRepository.save(priceType);
      results.push(saved);
    }

    return results;
  }
}

===== FILE 379: src\database\seeders\user\user-seeder.service.ts =====

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { users } from './data';
import { transformPassword } from 'src/core/security';
import { User } from 'src/app/modules/user/user.entity';
import { UserDTO } from 'src/app/modules/user/dtos/user.dto';

/**
 * Service dealing with user based operations.
 *
 * @class
 */
@Injectable()
export class UserSeederService {
  /**
   * Create an instance of class.
   *
   * @constructs
   *
   * @param {Repository<User>} userRepository
   */
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private readonly userRepository: Repository<User>,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Seed all users.
   *
   * @function
   */
  create(): Array<Promise<User | null>> {
    return users.map(async (user: UserDTO) => {
      return await this.userRepository
        .findOne({ where: { id: user.id } })
        .then(async (dbUser) => {
          // We check if a user already exists.
          // If it does don't create a new one.
          if (dbUser) {
            return Promise.resolve(null);
          }
          await transformPassword(user);
          return Promise.resolve(
            // or create(user).then(() => { ... });
            await this.userRepository.save(user),
          );
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          if (error instanceof Error) {
            return Promise.reject(error);
          }
          return Promise.reject(new Error('Users seeder error'));
        });
    });
  }
}
